88.name: Successor of Hero -Altar-
88.description: Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: You'll need to speak with Condram, the Elementor Priest in order to continue your journey. However, fir you'll have to complete another task.
Elementor Priest Condram is looking for something very important. It is the Perfume of Lillip, which is rumored to be somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
Find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and deliver the Stamped Scroll to Priest Condram at the Altar of Elementor in Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsDecline: You… won't? Why not? It would be a shame to let someone as gifted as you simply give up. Speak to me again when you're ready.
dialogsComplete: Ah yes, the Perfume of Lillip. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
Thank you very much, Magician. Now the relics of the Elementor Hero are safe.
dialogsFail: This is the altar where we protect the Souls of the Heroes. What can I do for you, my friend?

94.name: Obsessed with Crystals! (5)
94.description: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Mammoth.
94.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Crystals! Hmmm.... $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s! Could you please bring me some $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$!?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Mammoth.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: You did it! Hooray! Here's your reward. Come back soon!
dialogsFail: More! More!

129.name: Blessed Doll
129.description: House of Children wants Mia Dolls.
129.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: House of Children needs you to collect Mia Dolls as presents for the children. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

137.name: The Red Meteonyker
dialogsBegin: Here it is. The key has been reforged just as planned. Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsAccept: Quickly now, go and defeat the Red Meteonyker before it's too late! You must fight through the hoard of undead guardians. Good luck.
dialogsComplete: I can't believe it. You achieved the impossible.
I would say your victory calls for a celebration, but the armies of Shade are still here. There is a lot left to do in this forsaken place.
You are a lot more powerful than I thought you were. I am sure the other guardians are proud of your victory. I know I am. Thank you.
dialogsFail: Why are you still here? You must defeat the Red Meteonyker!

181.name: Successor of Hero -Guardian-
181.description: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
Deliver the Venel Heart to Wendien, the Elementor Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsAccept: Maybe the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, my friend.
dialogsDecline: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming an Elementor is complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Elementor Hero!
Lillip! Bless and guide this brave soul who is following your will! Elementor!
dialogsFail: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Elementor Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, Magician.

200.name: The Promise Ring
200.description: Meet Elaine and give him the Promise Ring
dialogsBegin: Alright, bring that ring to Elaine. It will be painful for him, but… I feel it's important that it is returned to him. Maybe he will feel something that was lost a long time ago.
I know he would rather repress all these painful memories, but the time has come to stop hiding and face our individual destinies. Please take this ring to him
dialogsAccept: I'm sure the result will be good. Go! Give that ring to Elaine.
dialogsDecline: If you don't want to do it, then I'll do it myself alright?
dialogsComplete: Why are you here again? I hope I was clear before about…
dialogsFail: Did you return the Promise Ring to Elaine yet? What are you waiting for?

202.name: Successor of Hero -Guardian-
202.description: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin: This is the Symbol of the Hero. There is only one more task to complete before you can be named a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You'll find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of the Heroes is protected.
You must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, who resides there, and retrieve his heart.
Deliver the Venel Heart to Shyniff, the Psykeeper Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsAccept: May the wisdom of the Heroes guide you, young one.
dialogsDecline: Quitting now would be foolish, young one. Give it some though and speak to me again should you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Welcome, Magician. Your journey to becoming a Psykeeper is now complete. I now appoint you, a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero!
Offerep, please guide and protect this brave soul who is following in your path, Psykeeper!
dialogsFail: I am awaiting a new Successor to the Psykeeper Hero. If that is you, I believe you may be forgetting something, young one.

232.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
232.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

234.name: Old Machinery
234.description: The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
dialogsBegin: So you want to help me fight off masquerpets, huh? Good.
The entrance to Azria was once an industrious place. It is now overrun by ancient machines. Help me bring down their numbers so other travelers may enter this place more safely.
Will you help me?
dialogsAccept: Good. Get going then. The fighting never stops.
dialogsDecline: Come back when you think you are ready.
dialogsComplete: It appears your efforts were a success. Thank you.
dialogsFail: Not enough monsters have been defeated, unfortunately. You must go back and fight.

244.name: Gems for Wands
244.description: Madrigal Magician Union wants you to collect 4 Poporam.
244.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Madrigal Magician Union wants you to collect Poporam for their wands. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

274.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
274.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

318.name: Serus Uriel
318.description: Collect 5 pieces of the broken key in the Mars Mine and return to Dr. Estly.
dialogsBegin: Now I'm sure it's what I feared. I still I can't do anything about it. I need evidence... Hmm...
(Thinking for a while, and then, suddenly...)
Yes! That's it! There must be evidence in the Mars Mine! We have to find it!
If the seal is broken, the broken pieces of the magic key must be there.
Now I know what we must do! Would you please help me once more, friend?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Collect the 5 pieces of the broken key somewhere in the Mars Mine, and return to me
dialogsDecline: Are you serious? What part of *doomed* did you not understand?
dialogsComplete: It's all clear now. It is exactly what I was afraid of. Serus Uriel has returned. The Phantom of Fear.
dialogsFail: Keep looking! The pieces of the broken key must be somewhere inside the Mars Mine!

334.name: Marbles for the Son
334.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Mayer needs orbin to make marbles for his son. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

335.name: Lucky Tool
335.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Lucky needs Hammamer to make a lucky hammer. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

356.name: Zoro's Pendant
dialogsBegin: Please take this pendant to Reonan. This will serve as a symbol of my unyielding devotion to our cause…
Oh! You have yet to collect Zoro's pendant! Go and retrieve it from him as well! Once you have done this, please take them both to Reonan.
dialogsAccept: Zoro is waiting! Please go and gather his pendant as well. I'm sure once you show him mine, he will gladly hand it over.
dialogsDecline: Please, we must get the pendants to Reonan to let him know we are ready to fight side by side!
dialogsComplete: Oh Oh! That is Elaine's pendant! So I see you were able to get him to reconsider?
dialogsFail: Hurry! I'm sure Zoro is waiting!

396.name: Successor of Hero -Guardian-
396.description: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
396.descriptionComplete: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Boneper the Knight Guardian.
dialogsBegin: This is the Mark of Heroes. It is a special sigil from the Guardian of the Knight’s Altar that denotes the wearer as a successor of Knight Hero.
You only need one more item to finally become a Knight. You will find it in Guardiane.
In Guardiane, in the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the Venel Guardian.
Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Boneper, the Knight Guardian.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck, Mercenary!
dialogsDecline: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsComplete: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Knight upon you.
Billaon, please bless and encourage this Knight as they follow your will!
dialogsFail: Only one recognized as a Knight may pass. Please turn back.

426.name: Seeing Through to the Past
426.description: Kill 10 Vice Veduque and meet Hael.
dialogsBegin: Still not ringing any bells. Though, the name is familiar… Maybe Master Radeon can tell you something about the name. He took me in over 20 years ago and has been my mentor since.
I can hardly remember what I had for breakfast. Go talk with Master Radeon alright? I'm sure he might know something…
dialogsAccept: Wow, seems like my headache is already lifting knowing I got you out of my hair. Master Radeon is on the other side of the Fountain of the Dead. Go see him!
dialogsDecline: You don’t want to do it? Alright...
dialogsComplete: Hmm? So Reonan is inquiring of Hael? It appears that it is time…
dialogsFail: Find Master Radeon and ask about the Hael's past.

433.name: Darkon's Environmental Management
433.description: You can acquire Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders.
dialogsBegin: Ahh! So you are here for Elaine? Of course I know who he is, Elaine is the president of our Environmental Group...
What? He is resigning as president? Hmm… this is a bad news... He kept things stable around here. What will happen if he is not here!
Hmm... You are right. The preservation of nature doesn't rest in the hands of one man, but with all of us… Could you please bring me some wastebaskets?
dialogsAccept: Please go and collect 10 Wastebaskets from Garbagespiders. It is the time for a brighter, cleaner Darken City!
dialogsDecline: You don't even care about it do you?. If we keep this way, there won't be any hope left.
dialogsComplete: Thank you! Now we will do our best to keep the environment clean!
dialogsFail: Wastebaskets can be found from Garbagespiders, located in the Western regions of Darkon 1.

449.name: Great Clockworks War - 2nd
449.description: Find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble and visit Dr.Estly in Northern Flaris.
dialogsBegin: Now for the final step! You've already heard about the Great Clockworks War. Actually, there was another Clockworks War after that…
That time, Clockworks was defeated and captured.
He was held at the cage where he was defeated by the allied forces of Flarine, Saint City and Darkon.
You can see the evidence of the war in Darkon 1 and at the Plain of Bubble in Flaris.
dialogsAccept: Please find 5 War Scars in Darkon 1 and the Plain of Bubble, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estly, who is in Northern Flaris.
dialogsDecline: Fine, have it your way. I guess you just aren't ready to face Clockworks.
dialogsComplete: Oh, did my brothers send you to me? Then you must be the Clockworks challenger! Please, show me the War Scars.
Hmmm… everything looks to be in order here! Here, take this book. It is a more detailed study of Clockworks. It goes into detail about his behavior.
dialogsFail: I'm waiting for someone who is supposed to be bringing me something important.

460.name: Chapter 1: Field of Bubble: The Violet Magician Troupe
460.description: Fight them to get information from them. I will meet you in Darken.
dialogsBegin: Hmm... I checked the cloth piece you brought me. It seems like the pattern on the cloth piece is the same as the one I saw on the ground.
However, there is a mystrious power in this cloth piece. I will check it out some more. By the way, have you ever heard of the Magic Troupe in Purple? I found out about them by chance.
I do not know the details, but I know that this group has something to do with the secrets of Madrigal.
I think we need more information about this Troupe. How about helping me once more? Would you do that for me?
dialogsAccept: Great! Please gather information about the Troupe and its members. You will have to fight them to get any information out of them.
dialogsDecline: You are afraid of them? I can hardly believe that. Ha ha ha.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... That was exactly what I thought... Now go back and take a rest. But please visit me again later. Thank you very much.
dialogsFail: Was it too much for you? Ah...but we need information about them.

464.name: Save the Garden! (Part 1)
464.description: You need 10 Bearer Hearts from Tombstone Bearers to save the Garden of Rhisis.
464.descriptionComplete: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsBegin: The Garden of Rhisis is dying! Could you help me?
You need 10 Bearer Hearts from Tombstone Bearers to save the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept: Thank you!
dialogsDecline: If you change your mind later, please come back to me!
dialogsComplete: Thank you! You should really talk to Janne.
dialogsFail: Come back when you have the Bearer Hearts.

489.name: Successor of Hero -Altar-
489.description: $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is in Darkon 1. Find him, get back the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and take it to Heedan in Cendil, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: Now, since you’re going to become a Ringmaster, you should see the Ringmaster Priest, Heedan, in Darkon 3.
She’s been trying to track down the Teardrop of Aenn that was stolen by Hunter X.
If you can get it back, you’d help her out a great deal.
$QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is in Darkon 1. Find him, get back the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and take it to Heedan in Cendil, Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck.
dialogsDecline: But… you must do it if you are to become a Ringmaster.
dialogsComplete: Great job, now everything is at it should be.
Thank you very much. I will do my best to keep it safe.
dialogsFail: I have given you your task, young one. Please do it.

548.name: Successor of Hero -Master-
548.description: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ellend in Darken City.
dialogsBegin: So you think you're ready to become a Ringmaster? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
I will be watching you.
dialogsAccept: Good luck!
dialogsDecline: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work! Now you're on your way to becoming a Ringmaster.
dialogsFail: Exactly 20 Drillers. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Ringmaster.

553.name: A Vagrant's First Steps (2)
553.description: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 10,000 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang, and then return to him.
dialogsBegin: I didn’t know that you could accomplish so much this fast! How wonderful! I have one more request for you. There are other monsters around Flarine. They are called Mushpangs.
Please wipe them out! If you hunt 10 Small Mushpangs and 5 normal Mushpangs, I will give you a reward. Oh, and hold onto any trophies they drop, as they will be very useful in the near future!
dialogsAccept: Yeah, I knew you could do this!
dialogsDecline: Mushpangs are very easy for you to hunt! Help protect Flarine from this menace!
dialogsComplete: It appears there is no monster that can threaten you around Flarine. It's time for you to step out into the world and show your power! Your adventure has just started!
Looks like you're a new comer. Did you pick up the items one-by-one? I'll give you a newcomer's pet for you.
dialogsFail: You didn’t hunt 15 Small Mushpang and 15 Mushpang yet.

575.name: Secret Trade
575.description: Bring the Disappearance Investigation report to the Mayor or Saint City.
dialogsBegin: I found out the common thing between them based on the data you brought me. I think it has something to do with supernatural power!
These kids were all afraid of the former mayor and their parents for some reason…
They were abandoned and kicked out of the city! Wow, that can't be true, can it?!
We have to uncover the truth in this case and make sure it never happens again. Will you help me?!
dialogsAccept: Awesome! Speak with the mayor again, and ask him to review this Disappearance Investigation.
dialogsDecline: How can you refuse to help when we are so close to discovering the truth!?
dialogsComplete: Hmm... This is very intriguing new information. Very well, I'll make a special inquiry group and check the case again. Please tell Porgo I said thanks.
dialogsFail: Saint City is being developed even today. By the way, why did Porgo tell you to meet me? Do you have something to show me?

583.name: In the Shadow of the Mountains
583.description: Kill 10 Small Volt and 15 Captain Driller, then meet with Est
dialogsBegin: While you were delivering the package, I looked further into this hero that you were inquiring about. A friend of mine, Est, seems to have more information on him.
Est is conducting research in the Gouthan Mountains, but is currently besieged by monsters. If you were to help him, he will tell you what you need.
dialogsAccept: Please head to the Gouthan Mountains in Northern Darkon and defeat 10 Small Volt and 10 Captain Driller. Then meet with Est.
dialogsDecline: Oh well, understandable. I'm not much of a fighter myself.
dialogsComplete: What!? The Volts and Drillers just suddenly disappeared! Oh, were you responsible for this?
dialogsFail: Please hurry to the Gouthan Mountains! I'm worried that if we don't act soon, something bad might happen to Est!

601.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
601.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

605.name: Stomping Grounds
605.description: Kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Given your prior victory, I have another favor to ask. An unwieldy group of bangs have really shaken things up in Northern Flaris. Can we count on you to take care of them?
dialogsAccept: Bangs can be found in North side of Flaris, near by Nyangnyang. Go kill 10 Bang & 5 Captain Bang and come back.
dialogsDecline: Your prior deeds for us are enough to earn my gratitude.
dialogsComplete: You've taken care of the issue already!? Astonishing! Now our mining operations in the mountains of Flaris may resume!
dialogsFail: Bangs can be found in Northern Flaris near the Nyangnyangs. Removing at least 10 Bangs and 5 Captain Bangs should resolve any issues.

606.name: Corrupted Cabbage Patch
606.description: Kill 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Leann and Reonan have informed me of your imminent arrival. Word of your deeds has also spread amongst our citizens. You must be quite an outstanding person for someone your age.
Oh? You want to know about Reonan? He's even sort of a mystery to me. Some say he can slay a Meteonyker with his bare hands. Tall tales aside, I have a request for you…
An army of ravenous plants are emerging and threatening the safety of our citizens. They seem to be the result of some mysterious dark magic.
dialogsAccept: Known as Wagsaac, these plants eat everything standing in their way. Please head south of Saint City and defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac.
dialogsDecline: Hmm, it appears that the stories of your selfless heroism were a little exaggerated.
dialogsComplete: It appears that the tales of your deeds are true! With the Wagsaac threat contained, our guards can once again focus on the defense of Saint City!
dialogsFail: Please defeat 10 Small Wagsaac & 5 Wagsaac South of the Town. Our guards are already at working trying to eliminate this menace and could use assistance!

618.name: Plot Begins
618.description: Deliver this to Gothante, he is the Chairman of the History Society in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: This is evidence that the continents were once one land mass. I am trusting you with this information because, well...
...we are in the same boat now. We are in danger together. Would you go through with me to the end?
dialogsAccept: Okay. Now please deliver this to Gothante. He is the chairman of the History Society in Saint City. Do not forget to be aware of the assasins.
dialogsDecline: I do not want to force you, but never forget that you are in danger.
dialogsComplete: This... This is... Bubble protect us. Martinyc has finally crossed the line. It is about time.
Thank you very much. Take this letter of recommendation and visit Hachal in Darkon 1.
I am sure he can help you. Take care!
dialogsFail: Do you want to know about the true history of Madrigal? Then I am the man to talk to.

655.name: Hey look, a flying rat! (2)
655.description: Almani asked for further help regarding the Longwings threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Longwing?
655.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for further help regarding the Longwings threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Longwing?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Longwing flying South-East of the Clockworks Cage in the mountains.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

662.name: Dangerous War
662.description: Defeat the 5 Veduque Guardians in front of Serus Uriel's Chamber and return to Dr. Estly to acquire the Mars Dungeon Key.
dialogsBegin: As long as Serus Uriel is still alive, it will be impossible to avoid all out war…
I do not want to stain Flaris with blood again. That's the last thing we need right now.
Her power can't possibly be as strong as before, otherwise she wouldn't be hiding in the mine.
I need your help again. Can you help me protect our peaceful Flaris?
dialogsAccept: I do not know exactly where it is, but there is a chamber for Serus Uriel. In front of that room, there are five guardians that protect it. Please defeat them first.
dialogsDecline: What the hell is more important than this? I really cannot understand!
dialogsComplete: Hmm... You are really great. I will appoint you as a punitive force of Serus Uriel. Here is the key. Please take it.
From now on, the conflict is with Serus Uriel. Please, head back there and use the key to open the door to her chamber.
Don't give up now, you must defeat her.
dialogsFail: Don't underestimate the 5 guardians. They are very powerful.

670.name: Duty of Assist
670.description: Travel to Madren Town, east of the High-Dwarpets, and slay Chaner. Once Chaner is defeated, speak with Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Here… take this. It's a Label of Technique. It details what I've told you today.
Now, for the final leg of your journey, apprentice. A creature called Chaner has been terrorizing the locals near the Demians in Madren Town.
Slay him, then return to Assist Instructor Kidmen in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your Assist training.
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, apprentice!
dialogsDecline: No? What a shame. Speak to me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsComplete: Chaner is… gone? Great work! Now, listen carefully. I have something very important to tell you.
The role of an Assist on the field of combat is primarily party support, however, an Assist can also prove to be a potent fighter as well.
Congratulations, my friend! You are now an Assist! Welcome to the fold!
dialogsFail: I'm waiting for word that Chaner has been destroyed. Last I heard he is still on the loose in Madren Town.

676.name: Obsessed with Crystals! (3)
676.description: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Augu.
676.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Crystals! Hmmm.... $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s! Could you please bring me some $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$!?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Augu.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: You did it! Hooray! Here's your reward. Come back soon!
dialogsFail: More! More!

692.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
692.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

693.name: Legend of Dreadpet <Big Thyred>
693.description: Travel to the Plain of bubble, defeat Organigor, and recover both the Fortress Map and the 1st book of Dread for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help. I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
Have you ever heard about the Legend of Big Thyred? No? A long long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer named Big Thyred. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
It was a cave deep underground, surrounded with this strange, bloody fog. Big Thyred investigated the cave only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Horrible Fear.
The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Big Muscle. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so the story goes…
So, here's where you come in. I need to an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Big Muscle. Feel like lending a hand?
dialogsAccept: One of those mangy Organigors ate one of my reference books. Defeat the Organigors at the Plain of Bubble and acquire the Book of Fear 1. While you're there, find the Fortress Map.
dialogsDecline: Awwww, come on! Look, I'll give you HALF of the sales from my book if you'll help. Still having second thoughts?
dialogsComplete: Oh, Rhisis! You've got the Book of Fear! Great work! Alright, sounds like you have what it takes to face Big Muscle.

Here, take this. It's Big Thyred's Heart. 

#b*You drop the heart and scream!*#nb

Hey, careful! You need that!
Take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager just southwest of here. You'll have to join a party before you face Big Muscle, it's too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsFail: Look, I know it's scary to face the Organigor, but I believe you can do it. Go, now!

718.name: Strange Collector (2)
718.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Strange Collector needs you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

723.name: Returning Home in Glory
723.description: Go to Reonan after reaching level 40.
dialogsBegin: Oh, Reonan said to return to Flarine after you had completed your duties here. Do not fret about us any longer. Go see Reonan!
dialogsAccept: Thank you for your efforts in Saint City. Your name will be forever praised here. Now, hurry on your way!
dialogsDecline: Eh? You don't want to go back? Then, plese feel free to join the illustrious ranks of our tourist industry!
dialogsComplete: I heard of your remarkable activities at Saint City from the Mayor! I have another mission for you... but it's too early right now. Reach level 40, then I will give you the next mission.
dialogsFail: Reonan is waiting for you in Flaris.

769.name: Tears of Mother
769.description: Go to Saint Hall in Saint City, and meet with Porgo.
dialogsBegin: Please help me! My daughter has been missing for so long!
My daughter disappeared a few years ago. I have reported her missing to the Public Office and tried to find her myself, but to no avail.
I have done everything I can do so far, but I'm at my wits end. I'm even asking Vagrants for help now!
Please, will you help me find my daughter?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. I think you can obtain some information from Porgo, who lives in nearby Saint Hall. He will definitely know something.
dialogsDecline: *Faints*
dialogsComplete: Hmm... JeongHwa has not given up on finding her daughter yet. What a pity, but her daughter is not the only child who has disappeared recently.
Lots of the girls from Saint City disappeared. I formed a citizen investigation team, but we failed to discover any clues.
Now I am the only one left from the team, but I am still investigating the case because we'd like to bring those kids home.
dialogsFail: I am the leader of the investigation team that was investigating the missing children. But now, I am the only one left...

826.name: Out of the Oven and into the Fire
826.description: Hunt 30 Captain Kern, acquire the Infernal Stone, then talk with Capafe.
dialogsBegin: In order to complete the process required to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we must first acquire an Infernal Stone
Please defeat 30 Captain Kerns and acquire the Infernal Stone which should be located somewhere around them.
dialogsAccept: Great! Once you have acquired the Infernal Stone, take it to Capafe and ask about the next step of the process.
dialogsDecline: If you wish Sury to return to her original state, this is the only way.
dialogsComplete: I have been waiting for you. I see that you have acquired an Infernal Stone.
dialogsFail: Please hurry, I'm sure Capafe is waiting for us!

858.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
858.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

881.name: Roots of Flavor
881.description: Hunt Antiquery and get 10 Anti Roots.
dialogsBegin: Ah~! You're the one lookin for that hero! Figured you were here to try some of my world famous cuisine!
Haven't heard of me!? Well you my friend, must have been living under a pretty big rock for some time.
Maybe while you adjust to the light, you could do me a little favor? Afterwards I promise to tell you where to find that hero you are looking for!
dialogsAccept: Thanks!! Well, I'm working on my latest masterpiece dish, but first I need 10 Anti Roots. Please go obtain some from Antiquery!
dialogsDecline: Ahh nevermind then! Figured you might do me this one favor!
dialogsComplete: Oh!! I was waiting for you. You came back earlier than I expected.
dialogsFail: Please hunt Antiquery and bring me 10 Anti Roots.

909.name: Lost Souls
909.description: Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
dialogsBegin: While we may be safe for now thanks to your help, the armies of Shade are advancing.
Shade is summoning the very dead to fight against us. Ghosts of the forgotten rulers have completely taken over the old ruins of Azria.
Bring Mawrang some of their remains so they can be studied. Maybe we can learn something.
dialogsComplete: Hm... yes... That is interesting.
dialogsFail: That may not be enough, hm.

913.name: Save the Garden! (Part 3)
913.description: Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
913.descriptionComplete: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
dialogsBegin: The Saint City sisters say that the Garden of Rhisis is dying.
Could you bring a Live Tea to Ann? You can find it the east of the Leren Mountains.
dialogsAccept: Thank you! If you help her she will give you an Earring.
dialogsDecline: The problem with the Garden of Rhisis can wait. I guess...
dialogsComplete: I will save the Garden of Rhisis with this tea! Here is an Earring to thank you.
dialogsFail: Bring a Live Tea to Ann at Saint City.

916.name: Successor of Hero - Altar
916.description: Take the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero, slay Sisif to retrieve the Jewel of the Jester Hero, and bring them both to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsBegin: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Jester Hero. Please, take it and seek the Jester Priest in Darkon 3.
The Jester Priest can be found in Magmient in Southern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Jester Hero.
There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Jester Priest. The Jewels of the Heroes adorn the Altar of Jester. One of these jewels was stolen a few days ago.
The jewels protect the soul of the Jester Hero, but they will not work if one of them is missing. The creature, Sisif, was seen near the alter a few days ago…
It is believed that this creature has stolen the jewel. Find Sisif and return the jewel to the Jester Priest, Homeit.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, Acrobat!
dialogsDecline: The jewel must be returned to the Altar of Jester. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsComplete: This is the Seal of Curenen and the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Thank you for returning this most prized artifact, Acrobat.
Now we can protect the Soul of the Hero safely. I am in your debt.
dialogsFail: I am waiting for someone who will bring me the Jewel of the Jester Hero. Do you have it?

949.name: The Moment of Truth
949.description: Return to Handel and see if she has decrypted the Parchment.
dialogsBegin: The number of Wheelems has increased so much since I last remember. If it weren't for you, I would have been Dwarpet road kill…
Has Handel finished her research? Oh! She is currently decrypting the Parchment of War? Will you hurry back to her and find if she has finished?
dialogsAccept: Tell Handel that I said thanks for her concern… If she need my help, feel free to find me at anytime!
dialogsDecline: Look I know I'm great and you would love to spend time with me, but this is sort of important!
dialogsComplete: I'm glad to see you… I have to finish decrypting the Parchment
dialogsFail: Go see Handel. She should be done with decrypting the parchment.

1001.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
1001.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

1021.name: Great Clockworks War - 1st
1021.description: Locate 5 pieces War Remnants in Darkon 2 and visit Dr. Estern at the Hill of Shade near Saint Morning
dialogsBegin: Alright, let's get started. Have you heard of the Great Clockworks War? You'll need to study it before you can challenge Clockworks.
the Great Clockworks War is the first time the people of Darkon were faced with that terrible menace, Clockworks. The people of Darkon were defeated.
They escaped to the Erons Factory. Evidence of this war can be found all over Darkon… Are you ready to continue to the next step?
dialogsAccept: Find 5 pieces of War Remnants in Darkon 2, and then visit my brother, Dr. Estern. He is at the Hill of Shade in Saint Morning.
dialogsDecline: I guess you truly aren't ready to face Clockworks. Why did you waste my time?
dialogsComplete: My brother sent you, right? Nice to meet you! My name is Dr. Estern, Dr. Est's younger brother. Why did he send... Oh, you're going to challenge Clockworks? Okay, do you have the War Remnants?
Hmm... Five, exactly! Okay, here you are. This book is about the study of Clockworks. It will be really useful in learning about your opponent.
dialogsFail: Yes? I'm sorry, I think I'm waiting for someone else.

1032.name: Corrupted Hunter
dialogsBegin: 8 legendary heroes? Hmm… Maybe… I have a person in my mind… but, I can't tell you so easily. First you must do something to show you are worthy of such information.
Foul monsters known as Trangfoma have been reported kidnapping civilians outside of the city. They are lead by a powerful lord Trangfoma. It needs to be defeated.
dialogsAccept: Please kill the Lord Trangfoma located in Eastern Darkon. He won't go down so easily so I would recommend enlisting the help of fellow warriors such as yourself.
dialogsDecline: If you don't have time for this, I don't have time to give you the information you seek…
dialogsComplete: hmm… Impressive. You are stronger than you look. I will give you everything you need to know now.
dialogsFail: Please relieve us of this threat. The Lord Trangfoma should be in Eastern Darkon.

1041.name: Enlightenment Shard
dialogsBegin: Sury is currently in a perpetual state of self doubt. Despite her unyielding dedication to her training, there is a self-realization she alone will have to make…
Go to Fera to get the Enlightenment Shard. She will tell you.
dialogsAccept: We may be able to assist her in making this realization though… Find Fera, the Billposter Priest, at the Altar of Billposter North of here. She might know of a way…
dialogsDecline: Don't refuse your destiny!
dialogsComplete: The Guardian has sent you, right? I was waiting for you…
dialogsFail: Fera is Bill Poster Priest at the Bill Poster Altar. You shall find her there. I'm sure she is already expecting you.

1052.name: Breaking the Curse (4)
1052.description: Bring the Steel Powder Cell has given you back to Reodos.
dialogsBegin: Ahh so you need me to grind these Steel Pieces you say? Piece of cake, just give me a moment.
All finished! Here you go. The machinery in Darkon is the best in all of Madrigal! Tell your friends about our services!
dialogsAccept: Well hurry on now! You obviously have something important that you require the Steel Powder for!
dialogsDecline: Well, that is a little ungrateful! And to think I did this all free of charge!
dialogsComplete: Aha! Now this is some finely ground Steel Powder!
dialogsFail: I must get back to work now! Hurry along!

1070.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
1070.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

1111.name: Like finding a Hair band in a Pumpkin Patch
1111.description: Find Marble Hair band from Pumpkin village and go back to Nersha.
dialogsBegin: Hey you... It's no use talking to my mommy right now. When she gets angry, she gets ANGRY.*giggle* Give her some time!
Since you aren't busy now, I know you would looooooove to do me a favor! *giggle* A few days ago I lost my favorite Marble Hair band outside of the town. Please please find it?
dialogsAccept: Yay! Thank you so much! You are super awesome. If I remember right, I lost it playing hide and seek with Nerco near the Pumpkin Village.
dialogsDecline: But but but, it was my favoritest… my daddy bought it for me!!!
dialogsComplete: You found my hair band!? Yay! You are the bestest ever!!! You are a real hero!
dialogsFail: Be careful! Pumpkin Village has lots of scary Mr.Pumpkins. When I saw one, I ran as fast as I could and lost my scrunchie!

1114.name: Introduction to Weapons
1114.description: Visit Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsBegin: Just like armor, weapons differ by the job. You don't have the experence to wield anything in my shop yet, but look around Madrigal, I'm sure you'll find something.
As a Vagrant, you can use a sword in one hand and a shield in the other. Equip them by double-clicking them or dragging them into the appropriate slot in your inventory.
Now you're ready to look at shields. Go see Luda next door at the Shield Shop and he'll take care of you.
dialogsAccept: Luda's Shield Shop is just next door. Have fun, kid! Stop by anytime you need a good weapon!
dialogsDecline: Look, I know it's not as exciting as axes and swords, but you'll need one just the same. Plus he's got plenty of other stuff for sale, so pay him a visit.
dialogsComplete: Haha, nice to meet ya, name's Luda! I'm in charge of shields and other equipment for Vagrants here in Madrigal. Let's get you set up to fight, shall we?

1233.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
1233.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

1280.name: Successor of Hero -Master-
1280.description: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Corel in Darken City.
dialogsBegin: So you think you're ready to become a Blade? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, warrior. I'll be watching.
dialogsDecline: Quitting already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... Good job, I knew you could do this! Now you are qualified as a successor.
Congratulations! You passed the first test.
dialogsFail: Exactly 20 Drillers, Mercenary. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Blade.

1284.name: Urgently looking for a Bandage
1284.description: A request for Grrr Bandages has gone out.
1284.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: A request for $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s has gone out. Will you accept this quest?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

1298.name: Finding the Guardians (2)
dialogsBegin: As Kumah may have told you, our power is not as strong as it once was. This place takes a toll on your strength.
I have unfortunately been trapped in this spot for a while. I can take on Meteonykers, but some powerful Berserk Meteonykers have been swarming the place in search of us guardians.
Can you help me escape? In return, I will give you the second piece of the key you will need to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker.
dialogsAccept: Why thank you, kind stranger. I will wait here for you.
dialogsDecline: Hmph. I'll just give up then...
dialogsComplete: I knew I could count on you!
There is only one piece left, in the hands of our fellow guardian Airon. She is stubborn though, and you might need to convince her... if you can find her.
dialogsFail: My dear traveler, there are still too many Berserk Meteonykers!

1300.name: Brightly Burning Flame
1300.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Bozman needs you to collect furious matches to use at his blast furnace. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

1333.name: The Frosty Beast
1333.description: The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
dialogsBegin: Now our town is stronger than ever! Unfortunately, we are still lacking a lot of resources.
Azria used to have a field of crystals that we would use for energy and magic, but these have been devoured by a crazed Augu that has gone absolutely mad.
The Glacial Augu is now overpowered from all of this crystal essence and has become nearly unstoppable. Can you help us defeat it and retrieve its crystal essence?
dialogsAccept: Good luck!
dialogsComplete: Amazing! And you did that all by yourself I bet!
Now that we have all of this crystal essence, we can enforce our town and create a magical barrier that no monster, Violet or not, can ever break through.
We thank you for all of your help! Stay safe out there.
dialogsFail: Keep trying! I believe in you!

1361.name: Guardians of the Temple
1361.description: Bring Handel the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.
dialogsBegin: This essence of Shade is concerning… After the 8 Heroes had defeated Shade, all remnants of her existence were to be purged to prevent her return.
If her essence remains, this is very bad… Stored in the Temple of Iblis is the Parchment of War. Please head there and retrieve it for me.
dialogsAccept: The Temple of Iblis is in the Southern most region of Saint Morning. The records are guarded by both Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian so please defeat them to obtain it!
dialogsDecline: We've come too far to just quit now! Please reconsider!!
dialogsComplete: You've made it back with the Parchment!
dialogsFail: Please bring the Parchment of War after defeating 10 Iblis Crashers and an Iblis Guardian.

1382.name: The Furry Menace
1382.description: Kill 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang and return to the Mayor of Flarine.
dialogsBegin: I wanted to meet you personally to thank you for all you have done for us. I don't wish to impose, but I hoped you could again call upon your courage.
Our town guard was once sizeable enough to fend off most of Shade's masquerpets. Now, with each passing day their numbers and power increases, while ours dwindles.
With that said, could you please help us to exterminate a particularly vicious group of Nyangnyang roaming the lands?
dialogsAccept: Nyangnyang can be found in Northern Flaris, right after crossing the bridge. Killing 10 Cute Nyangnyang & 5 Nyangnyang should be sufficient to aid us.
dialogsDecline: I understand your apprehension, but I do hope you will reconsider your decision.
dialogsComplete: Hah! It is as the citizens have said, you ARE truly a great warrior.
dialogsFail: The Nyangnyang roam the lands right across the bridge of Northern Flaris. Please help us to decrease their numbers!

1402.name: Vagrant Master (Assist)
1402.description: Slay 10 Small Mushpangs and 10 Small Burudengs just north of Eastern Flarine then return to Assist Drillmaster Elic.
dialogsBegin: So you want to be an Assist, huh? I don't blame you. It's the best job in Madrigal!
First, I want you to take care of a little something for me. Small Mushpangs have been eating our crops lately.
Just north of here, there are several Small Mushpangs. Slay 10 of them with 10 Small Burudengs and return to me as soon as possible.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsDecline: Having a change of heart? That's alright, come speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work! Hopefully they'll stay away from our crops now.
You've done very well so far. Keep up the good work!
dialogsFail: Hurry! There isn't much time!

1405.name: Hungry Hungry Dwarpets
1405.description: Collect 5 Syliaca Fillet and 5 Greemong Jelly, then bring them to Rankashu in the Western region of Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin: Oh! Haha, why I haven't changed yet you ask? I'm not entirely sure. I feel that the curse should have let up by now…
I do know someone who may be of assistance. His name is Rankashu, a descendent of Shamanistic Dwarpets who have lived in Darkon longer than man.
He might have some useful information pertaining to this curse and what else I need to do! Will you seek him out for me?
dialogsAccept: OH! OH! Thank you! I know that Rankashu can't resist Syliaca Fillet and Greemong Jelly. I'm sure if you brought some of these, he'd spill whatever information you wanted!
dialogsDecline: Hmph! Well, you could be missing out on a chance to not only help me, but possibly learn of the location of the other 2 heroes as well!
dialogsComplete: Well helloooo there! *sniffs* Is that Syliaca fillets and Greemong Jelly I smell? Oh! Well, of course there WOULD be a request first. Free food, HAH!
dialogsFail: Have you gathered the Syliaca fish and Greemong Jelly? You can find them by killing both Syliaca fish and Greemongs

1416.name: Facts of Mia
1416.description: Speak with the Mayor of Saint City and give him the evidence from the Mias.
dialogsBegin: Argh! Curse that darn mayor! He won't even listen to me!
What's the matter, you ask? I brought him the evidence you obtained for me. I was told it was too long ago and that nobody cares about the case anymore.
How could he be so heartless? These are children we are talking about, here! I need to find a way to get him to look at this evidence.
Would you mind helping me once more?
dialogsAccept: If you bring him the evidence instead of me, maybe he will take a look at it. I've bugged him enough about this over the years, but maybe a fresh face will do the trick!
dialogsDecline: But… please, think of the children.
dialogsComplete: Oh for Madrigal's sake! Porgo never gives up! Okay, please bring this to him and tell him never to bring this case up to me again!
dialogsFail: I tour the city everyday in order to listen the opinions of the citizens. Have a wonderful adventure in our fair city!

1434.name: Test of Strength
1434.description: Weaken the armies of the Cyclops X and defeat their lieutenant to obtain one of their life gems and bring it to me.
dialogsBegin: What brings you here?
Airon sent you? And I see you have all three pieces of the key. Then there is no time to waste.
I can reforge the key for you, but I require a lot of life source to do so.
Ever since the Red Meteonyker has been wreaking havoc in his chamber, the armies of Shade have swarmed this place. Cyclops X are everywhere, and the entrance is now kept by undead guardians.
dialogsAccept: Go on then.
dialogsComplete: Now stand back as I forge the key.
dialogsFail: This is no time to play games. Go now and finish the task. We must hurry!

1444.name: New Kind of Firework
1444.description: The Firework Producer wants Bomb Timers.
1444.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: The Fireworks Producer needs Bomb Timers to make a new kind of firework. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You get bombtimers from any type of Carrierbomb.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

1457.name: Party of Is
1457.description: Is asking you to collect Chupim for her party.
1457.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Is needs you to gather Chupim for her party. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

1568.name: Nothing Like a Home Cooked Meal
1568.description: Bring 3 Sharp Edge to Lusina by killing Red Mantis.
dialogsBegin: Thank you! You found my son and also helped my daughter. Now I can momentarily feel relieved. Let me treat you to a home cooked meal! Hold on...
Ah!!! All of my kitchen knives got rusty. I just wanted to treat you a good meal to show my appreciation... Now, I can't even feed my children!
You've helped our family so much already, but can I ask you for a favor also?
If I had some Sharp Edge pieces, I could make a knife and once again be a fit mother! Would you please gather some for me?
dialogsAccept: You are really too kind! You can collect Sharp Edge pieces by killing some Red Mantis… and pulling off their legs. Yes, yes, so it sounds a little vicious. It's ok, you will get over it! Haha!
dialogsDecline: Oh dear! Now my children shall surely starve! Children's services will take them away and I will be all alone…
dialogsComplete: How very kind of you! Hope this task wasn't too much of a burden for you. Rest a little now!
dialogsFail: Unfortunately, you won't be able to pull the legs off all the Red Mantis. Some of them are attached too tightly. Just keep killing them and you will eventually succeed!

1603.name: The Nomadic Chef
1603.description: Go find Jinitte at Nomads village in Central Darkon 3
dialogsBegin: I've heard that the warrior in question is supposedly a powerful Billposter…
If you are looking for further information on them then please go to my friend Jinitte. He has traveled the continent of Darkon extensively and knows much of its happenings.
dialogsAccept: Jinitte might just know where this hero is hiding out.
dialogsDecline: Rather hang around and help me garden? Haha I'm joking! I know you probably have much more important work to attend to!
dialogsComplete: Greetings Sir! You lookin to try my world famous cuisine!
dialogsFail: Jinitte is a famous world travelling cook. He is currently selling food at the Nomads village.

1647.name: Mutated Aibatts
1647.description: Tina has reported a new kind of Masquerpet called Zendros. Please could you kill 15 of them?
1647.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina has reported a new kind of Masquerpet called Zendros. Please could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Zendros flying between Flaris and Saint morning continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

1655.name: Successor of Hero -Helmet-
1655.description: Find Kindler and use whatever information he has to locate the Golden Helmet. Then take it, and your letter, to Hormes, the Knight Sage at the The Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements thus far. Guard it as you would your own life.
Take it to Hormes, the Knight Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
Before you go, though, I want you to find Kindler, a grave-robber. He's hiding out near the Clockworks' Cage, South of Darken City.
I believe he has information on the Golden Helmet of Billaon. Retrieve it by any means, and take it to Hormes along with your letter.
dialogsAccept: May the courage of Billaon be with you always.
dialogsDecline: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsComplete: My word! This… this is the Golden Helmet of Billaon! We thought it had been lost forever!
No one had seen it since that grave-robbing scoundrel Kindler stole it and hid it away. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
dialogsFail: You have a question? Out with it, quickly. I have no time to waste with idle chatter.

1692.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
1692.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

1696.name: Chapter 1 The Field of Bubble
1696.description: You know the Field of Bubble, right? I think we can find some evidence there. Lets go! Hurry up!
dialogsBegin: Hmm? Did Gothante tell you to visit me? Why?
Oh, I see. Iblis watch over me, what is this information!? Who could have dug up this much of the past? Only one person?
Martinyc of course. She has finally done what we all knew she would. She does not fear death like she should. The young are too fearless these days.
Aw well we all knew that the true history of Madrigal would be discovered eventually. And we all knew that Martinyc would be the one to uncover it.
By the way... Are you going to continue with this?
dialogsAccept: Good. We will go to the Field of Bubble. There is more evidence to be found there. Hurry.
dialogsDecline: What? No, you cannot stop now. You have come so far.
dialogsComplete: Ahhh you are here finally. Give me the data and letter of recommendation.
dialogsFail: This place is very strange... Hmm... Field of Bubble... What do you think about it?

1761.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
1761.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

1798.name: Entering the Dekane Mine
1798.description: Visit the Dwarpet Rankashu and get the information Cell wanted.
1798.descriptionComplete: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
dialogsBegin: You are really willing to enter the Dekane Mine?
dialogsAccept: Then visit the Dwarpet, Rankashu, in front of the Dekane Mine.
dialogsDecline: Ha ha ha. Of course not. It is far too frightening.
dialogsComplete: Here is the Mine Entrance Card. It is up to you to enter but I advise against it. You may die.
dialogsFail: Is it so hard to tell me what I want to know? Leave quickly.

1840.name: Unified Red Bang Troupe
1840.description: Locate the Red bang Troupe base in Erons Factory 2, Darkon 1, and report back to Amadolka with anything you find.
dialogsBegin: They have occupied almost half of Erons Factory. I didn't realize how strong they really were.
We are having a hard time defending this narrow entrance, they will get through here in no time unless we do something about it.
We need more information! We need a scout to survey their base and let us know what we're really up against.
You seem like a good candidate for the job. What do you say? Want to help the people of Erons Factory?
dialogsAccept: Great! I am sure their base is somewhere in the depths of Darkon 1. Let me know what you find out!
dialogsDecline: No? Fine… We will have to deal with it ourselves.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work! So now we know where exactly their base is located and what we're up against with their new leader.
dialogsFail: Have you found it yet? We don't have much time! Please, hurry!

1844.name: Successor of Hero - Guardian
1844.description: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard, in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Ranger Guardian, Kailreard.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsDecline: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsComplete: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Ranger Hero!
Wise Hynan! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and power, Ranger Hero!
dialogsFail: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.

1857.name: Sury's Dilemma
dialogsBegin: I've been training up here so long. I feel that I'm so close to achieving a heightened level of power, but there is something missing…
I don't know why… I just feel like there is something missing… and this "thing" is keeping me from realizing my true inner potential.
Could you please seek my mentor (Billposter Guardian) Capafe and explain my dilemma. He will surely understand…
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Please get advice from (Billposter Guardian) Capafe.
dialogsDecline: You can't possibly stop now. You play an important role in things to come!
dialogsComplete: Welcome, I have been expecting you.
dialogsFail: (Billposter Guardian) Capafe is located in Southern Darkon 3 along with the other Guardians.

1874.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
1874.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

1889.name: Chapter 3 Purple Magician: The Secret of the Altar
1889.description: Please check the altar until you find out something of importance.
dialogsBegin: Hmm... I have some good theories but we are going to need more information about the altar and the Magic Troupe.
I think there is something in the altar. I have a strong feeling that we could find something there if we look closely enough.
Listen. This is very important. Just stick with this until the end. Would you?
dialogsAccept: Please check the altar until you can find some evidence.
dialogsDecline: What could be more important than this? Oh fine, just go.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... Everything is written in an ancient language. But we can translate it. Thanks.
Please come back to me after the translation is over. Let me bring this book to the translator.
dialogsFail: You can check all of the 3 altars, bring any evidence you find at any of them.

1892.name: Ambition of Lord Bang
1892.description: Defeat 35 Red Bang Troupe Leaders and speak with Amadolka at the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin: The new leader of the Red Bang Troupe must be at the Erons Factory location you discovered before.
We need to strike a blow to his troupe and cripple his operations in Darkon 1.
I know what to do! You need to visit Amadolka. But first, defeat 35 Red bang Troupe Leaders southwest of the Erons Factory.
Will you help me once more, friend?
dialogsAccept: Great! Now please go and visit Amadolka, who is a guard leader at Erons Factory.
dialogsDecline: You have to believe me! A lot of people are in danger! Do you understand?
dialogsComplete: What? Really? Good job thinning the herd a bit.
Hmmm... you may prove useful.
dialogsFail: I am in charge of security in Erons Factory. Do you know Luda? How is he doing?

1895.name: The Insightful Store Owner
dialogsBegin: Oh yeah! Hah, about that… for some reason my concoction didn't seem to break the curse. Could just be a delayed effect! Heh, wishful thinking, right?
Anyway! You came at just the right time! I've heard that a man named Achaben has reported seeing who I believe to be one of the 8 missing heroes. Will you go talk with him?
dialogsAccept: Achaben is the owner of the General Shop in Darken. Please go meet with him and see what he has to say!
dialogsDecline: Still 4 more heroes to find! Lets not just call it quits now!
dialogsComplete: Greetings there! What is it I can do for you?
dialogsFail: Achaben is the owner of Common General Shop in Darken. Go see him. I will just lay low till then!

1916.name: Snack for the Children
1916.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Bolpor needs Prewing to make some snacks for the children. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

1918.name: Introduction to Shields
1918.description: Losha at the Food Shop will give me a Green Shield and 1,200 Penya when I visit her.
dialogsBegin: Hahaha! Welcome to the Shield Shop! You can buy shields, weapons, and armor for Vagrants here. I stock all the equipment that you need prior to your first job change at level 15.
Why don't you buy a Long Sword with the Penya you've collected? You can buy it by double tapping on it or dragging it into your inventory.
Also, you can sell an item by dragging it into the shop window. Pretty easy, huh? Okay, after buying it, please visit Losha at the Food Shop.
dialogsAccept: Losha at the Food Shop is staying in Eastern Flarine which is located to the east of here. You'll have to cross the bridge to get there.
dialogsDecline: What, you think it's too far? The Food Shop is very important for your journey, you should definitely check it out.
dialogsComplete: You are new to Madrigal, right? Hi! I have heard a lot about you already! Here, take this. It's a gift from Luda. Talk to me again for you next task!
dialogsFail: You should buy a Long Sword from Luda at the Shield Shop.

1976.name: Mushroom Farm of Chitller
1976.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Chitller needs you to collect Poiespore for his mushroom farm will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

1991.name: Beauty Contest Award
1991.description: The Madrigal Beauty Contest sponsor wants Eronsimint.
1991.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: The Madrigal Beauty Contest needs Eronsimint for making an award. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

2002.name: Laws of Aviation (3)
dialogsBegin: Now that you have your very own flying device, I'm going to assign you a test. That's right, a test! Just for fun of course. Hehe~
I want you to fly to the North of Saint City, and meet my associate Tina. Once you've arrived, let her know I sent you. She'll know what to do from there. I've sent countless travelers before you!
dialogsAccept: Tina is at Saint City Station. That's the most northern part of Saint City. It's the biggest Station in Madrigal, I'm sure you won't miss it!
dialogsDecline: Not ready yet? That's fine. Just let me know when you're up to the task.
dialogsComplete: What's this? Dior sent you? Another traveler taking Diors Flying test? You're the first one in a while! Just give me a moment. I'll be with you shortly.

2032.name: Show What You Can Do
2032.description: Defeat Clocks, who is caged just outside of Darken. You may need some help.
dialogsBegin: Well, it looks like you have all the information you need about Clockworks.
So, after all that, the masterpiece of Darkon was created, Clocks! What? You don't know what Clocks is?
It's like a small version of Clockworks. We made it for the people who want to challenge Clockworks, so they can practice first!
Since you're on your way to becoming the next challenger, why don't you practice a bit, first?
dialogsAccept: Clocks' Cage is outside of Darken. You'll have to defeat it, but you'll probably need some help.
dialogsDecline: I knew you were a coward! Hahaha!
dialogsComplete: Congratulations! Now, you are ready to challenge Clockworks. You better be prepared or you'll get squished!
dialogsFail: Don't be fooled by his size, Clocks is almost as powerful as Clockworks.

2039.name: No Rest for the Wicked
2039.description: Meet the Mayor of Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Oh that little brat! He is out of his mind! That’s it, when I find him he is getting a spanking more terrifying than Shade's fury!!!
Oh, by the way! The Mayor of Saint City is looking for you in hurry. I really should go find my son now. I still owe you a meal sometime so come back and see us!
dialogsAccept: Go see the Mayor of Saint City. I gotta go now. See you!
dialogsDecline: Well, that’s up to you! Either way, I have to rush off now!
dialogsComplete: Oh! There you are! I've been waiting for you!. We are in great need of your abilities!
dialogsFail: Hmm, what to spank him with? OH! You are still here? The mayor is looking for you. Please go see him!

2119.name: Mysterious Magic Material
2119.description: You can collect them from the group of Chimeradon in the Deadwallderness.
2119.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Magician Master requested you to collect Merahook which is a magic material. Will you accept this request?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Chimeradon.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

2142.name: Bone of Wagsaac
2142.description: Gather 10 Wagsaac Bones from Wagsaacs south of the Saint Tree in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Psssst! Hey... You there! Over here! Sorry for whispering, but this is a secret from the Lab of Madrigal.
In the Lab of Madrigal, a secret project is underway. This is actually a disguise I'm wearing, hahaha! This secret project has to do with cloning monsters!
Why are we cloning them? Because we can, obviously! What kind of question is that? Muahahaha! Okay, listen. I need something for our cloning study.
You think you might be able to help me out?
dialogsAccept: Perrrrfect! In the interest of furthering our studies on Wagsaac DNA, I need some of their bones. Bring me 10 Wagsaac Bones.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to do it, eh? Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsComplete: Hmmm *Sniff* *Sniff*... Yep! This is prime grade-A Wagsaac Bone right here. Good job, sport!
dialogsFail: We've got all the time in the world. Take your time. We're busy developing a mix between a Mushpang and an Aibatt. We're calling them Mushbatts!

2219.name: Raising Pets 4 (D Tier -> C Tier)
2219.description: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
dialogsBegin: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsAccept: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsDecline: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsComplete: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to C tier now!
dialogsFail: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.

2235.name: Lyangglatang
2235.description: Rooney needs you to collect Nyanyangs.
2235.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Rooney wants you to collect Nyanyangs for her party. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect nyanyang near the Giant Nyangnyang.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

2291.name: Legend of Dreadpet <Krren Dacid>
2291.description: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Pssst, hey you! I'm writing a book and I need your help! I'm having a bit of writer's block and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
Have you ever heard about the legend of Krren Dacid? A long long time ago, there was a very famous adventurer. His name was Krren Dacid. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure…
It was a huge temple in the sky. Krren investigated the temple only to become infected by a disease within the cave called Cold Fear.
The disease transformed him into a hideous monster, whom we now call Krrr. There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Krrr. So whaddya' say?
dialogsAccept: Great! One of those Gangards at the Plain of Bubble scooped up one of my reference books. Defeat the Gangards and acquire the Book of Fear 2. While you're there, try to find the Temple Map.
dialogsDecline: Oh, come on now! Tell you what, I'll give you 50% of the proceeds from the sale of my book when I release it! How does that sound? Bah!
dialogsComplete: Blessings from Bubble, you've got it! It looks like you do indeed have what it takes to face Krrr.

Here, take this. It's Krrr's Heart. 

#b*You vomit all over him*#nb

 Hey, knock it off!
If you're done being sick, take the heart to the Dreadpet Manager in Madren Town. You'll have to join a party to enter the temple, it's way too dangerous to go alone.
dialogsFail: Look, I know Ganguard's smell bad and all that, so I understand your reservations… but I really need that book.

2318.name: Time to Resign
2318.description: Go meet the Mayor of Darken and inform him of Elaine's departure.
dialogsBegin: This ring is... Where did you find this!? Yes... You are right. This ring belong to my sister. This is my only reminder of a past I've since tried to forget…
I gave this ring to her as promise to always be there for her, but I couldn't fulfill that promise… I will forever blame myself for the events that befell her…
You are right… I can't keep hiding forever. I need to take a stand. I need to prevent a situation like this from ever occurring again.
I will join alongside Zoro and Reonan. Before this, I need to wrap up some work. Could you please assist me this one last time?
dialogsAccept: I oversaw the Darkon Environmental Association. Unfortunately, if I am to prepare for battle, I will no longer be able to fulfill my duties. Could you inform the Mayor of my departure?
dialogsDecline: I would do it myself, but it will take up even more of my time…
dialogsComplete: Oh, you are that adventurer. What are you doing back this way?
dialogsFail: It will be great if the Mayor of Darken understands my decision...

2348.name: Darkon: The Mysterious Continent
2348.description: Go meet the Mayor of Darken located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have more information on the missing heroes.
