dialogsBegin: This is more urgent that I thought… I was aware of the impending return of Shade, but this soon? I'm sorry I had to hide so much from you. Here is the truth…
Handel, Hael and I share a common past. We are all reincarnations of the 8 original heroes to defeat Shade in the War of the Gods. I was the first Knight Hero...
We were all appointed by Bubble as champions of our respective classes, and led the armies of mankind against Shade and her masquerpets.
I feel it is due time for a reunification of the original 8 heroes... I know the other reincarnations are out there. I just hope we will be able to convince the rest of them. We don't have much time…
It has come to my attention that several of the other heroes are currently residing in a large continent known as Darkon. For Madrigal's sake, would you be able to track them down?
dialogsAccept: Make haste to meet the Mayor of Darkon. He sees over the main industrial town located in Darkon 2. Maybe he will have further information about the missing heroes.
dialogsDecline: I know it is a lot to take in, but you are going to have to trust me on this one. We don't have any time to waste.
dialogsComplete: Oh! Hello young adventurer. You shouldn't sneak up on a man my age, nearly gave me a heart attack. Hahaha!!
dialogsFail: You must locate the heroes of the past, so that Madrigal might have a future. Please speak with the Mayor of Darkon. I guarantee he will know something…

2358.name: Death Mine and Roaches (1)
2358.description: Bring the blood of Roaches by destroying their eggs and defeating Roach Larva.
2358.descriptionComplete: Looks like he still has a need of you.
dialogsBegin: Hmm… Is that the ring of Nevil around your finger?
Your strength has been proven then. Would you prove yourself further? The Roach is somehow connected to the death of people in the mine.
There is a mystery to be unlocked here. Would you bring me the blood of the Roach larva?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. There are two kinds of Roach - Pink and Blue. Break open their eggs and hunt down the larva.
dialogsDecline: There will be no revelation without danger.
dialogsComplete: Ahh, there is much to be learned from the blood of these Roaches.
dialogsFail: No! No! No! Bring me more information!

2490.name: Request of Lurif
2490.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Could you do me a favor? I need Phanbubble. Can you help me please?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

2538.name: Woodcutting Class
dialogsBegin: You can chop trees with an axe. Would you like to learn woodcutting?
dialogsAccept: Good. Then go out into the field and chop some. It will be a great help, whether you succeed or not.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Go out into the field and chop some. It will be a great help, whether you succeed or not.

2574.name: Successor of Hero -Altar-
2574.description: Hunt down 8 regular Wheelems (not Bouncing or Rough) and retrieve 8 Soulstones from them.
dialogsBegin: To show my gratitude, I’ll help you further along your way towards becoming a Knight.
You’ll need to visit the Altar of Knight at Magmient in Darkon 3.
Lobiet, the Knight Priest, will recognize the scroll I’ve given you…
Retrieve the 8 Soulstones from regular Wheelems and take them to Lobiet.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsDecline: I know it’s a challenge, but I assure you, the reward is worth it.
dialogsComplete: I haven’t a clue why those Wheelems took the stones, but nevertheless, thank Billaon you’ve returned them.
The Souls of the Heroes can rest, thanks to you.
dialogsFail: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?

2650.name: Before He's Road kill…
2650.description: Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems and report to Bowler.
dialogsBegin: Please you must quickly hurry to Bowler! It seems the Wheelems near him have grown increasingly aggressive and he has grown quite fearful!
Will you hurry to his aid? In the meanwhile, I will attempt to decrypt these records. I know they contain something worthwhile!!
dialogsAccept: Your assistance is truly appreciated! Hurry and defeat 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems then report to Bowler!
dialogsDecline: Oh no!! You must help him! Bowler doesn't stand a chance against those vicious Wheelems!
dialogsComplete: That was too close of a call! The Wheelems generally left me alone. For whatever reason, they suddenly grew violent and attempted to attack me while I was out near their territory.
dialogsFail: Hurry! Kill 20 Rough Wheelems & 10 Wheelems before they can reach Bowler!

2688.name: Onward Brave Fool!
2688.description: Enter the Dekane Dungeon and search for the Mysterious Woman.
dialogsBegin: Ahh I see Cell has given you the code to enter the dungeon!
Just to be warned, the monsters in the dungeon are quite terrifying! If you feel you aren't prepared for the quest, please go train some more!
Are you going to enter then and look for that woman?
dialogsAccept: Well, you are the bravest fool I've ever met. Let's hope this woman is worth all the effort! Hah!
dialogsDecline: Changed your mind? Well if you aren't busy, maybe you could go bring me some more Greemong Jelly and Syliaca Fillets! I kid I kid! Haha!
dialogsComplete: Woah! Surprised me! Shouldn't sneak up on a lady like that! Hehe.
dialogsFail: Well, are you going to head into the mine or are you reconsidering already?

2719.name: Successor of Hero - Letter
2719.description: You need to speak with Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First, though, you must retrieve the Letter of hynan from the creature, Rubo, East of Darken.
dialogsBegin: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Kimel, the Ranger Wise Man in Flaris.
However, first you must retrieve the Letter of Hynan from Rubo, a creature found to be living with Syliacas, east of Darken. Locals caim Rubo has been seen with the letter.
Once you've slain Rubo, bring the Letter of Recommendation and the Letter of Hynan to Sage Kimel at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, Acrobat.
dialogsDecline: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Ranger hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsComplete: Is that… the Letter of Hynan? My goodness, this is wonderful! Thank you so much, Acrobat!
Hynan lost this letter during the war. There were rumors that a creature named Rubo was in possession of it. Thank you for retrieving it for me.
My sincerest gratitude.
dialogsFail: I'm waiting for someone to bring me a letter. There are rumors that a creature named Rubo who lives with the Syliacas east of Darken was last seen with it.

2780.name: Raising Pets 6 (B Tier -> A Tier)
2780.description: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
dialogsBegin: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsAccept: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsDecline: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsComplete: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to A tier now!
dialogsFail: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.

2787.name: Weapons of the Magician
2787.description: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then speak with Magician Master Hee in Northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Nice work taking care of those Captain Aibatts for us. Now, on to your next task!
I need you to collect some materials for me and deliver them to Hee, the Magician Master. She will instruct you on the use of Magician weaponry.
Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts near Flarine, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Slain from Lawolf then you may speak with Hee.
The Magician Master is located just north of Flarine.
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsDecline: I see you're not quite ready to continue down the path to becoming a Magician. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Thank you for delivering the Twinkle Stones, Vagrant. Wingyei has told me a lot about you. Now, let me tell you a little something about Magician weaponry.
Magicians can use both wands and staves. A wand allows the magician to attack from a distance with a charged up attack that deals additional damage while a staff can be used as a melee weapon.
You will find that Magicians primarily rely on magic spells to deal damage. However, it is important to know how these weapons work.
dialogsFail: I am waiting for someone to deliver some materials I require for Magician weaponry.

2788.name: In Safe Hands
dialogsBegin: This Shard, it has made everything so much clearer! I have recovered the part of myself that I lost along the way. I was once Roentel, Hero Billposter…
I now see the gravity of this situation…the peril that Madrigal is truly in. I understand why Reonan is seeking us out!
First, could you perhaps complete one favor for me? I left my pendant to Capafe before I decided to isolate myself up here on this mountain to train.
dialogsAccept: Thank you yet again! Capafe should have the pendant. Go and ask her if she could return it.
dialogsDecline: This pendant is an important symbol of trust, you must acquire it!
dialogsComplete: I'm glad to hear that Sury has reached this realization.
dialogsFail: Capafe should have the pendant. Go and inquire about it.

2809.name: Mysterious Bounty Hunter
2809.description: Meet Hael and mention Reonan's name.
dialogsBegin: Level 40 eh? You've really grown since our last meeting! Hmm, have you heard of a man named "Ghost" Hael? He is one of Madrigal's best known bounty hunters.
His cold and mysterious demeanor have earned him the title "Ghost". I've heard from sources that he might be traveling through Flaris today.
Would you perhaps seek him out for me? If you tell him my name, perhaps it will jog his memory…
dialogsAccept: Appreciate it! He will be appearing at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern part of Flaris. Please find him.
dialogsDecline: What are you scared? I mean, he's not REALLY a ghost.
dialogsComplete: Sure is awfully hard to concentrate with you standing right there. What do you want?
dialogsFail: You haven't met Hael yet? He should be at the Fountain of Dead Person.

2888.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
2888.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

2912.name: Finding the Guardians
dialogsBegin: A great terror lies within this volcano. A cataclysmic maelstrom is said to have erupted this volcano and carved out these caverns.

The Red Meteonyker is one of the most dangerous Masquerpets in all of Madrigal. As a fearsome creation of Shade, I do not know of many who have survived his fiery breath. This abomination has been sealed away for many ages.
Many adventurers like yourself who battle Masquerpets in Darkon are unaware of the grave danger that lies below them. The walls are giving way and the Red Meteonyker may not be tempered much longer.

You think you can face the Red Meteonyker? I do not wish such a grim fate on anyone. However... you have survived the horrors of Darkon, so you must be very strong. Maybe I am being too skeptical. There may be some hope after all.

Many of us guardians were annihilated when sealing the Red Meteonyker away. Only three of us are left, and each of us holds a piece of the key needed to enter the lair of the Red Meteonyker. You must find them and obtain each piece.
dialogsAccept: Very well. Here is the first piece of the key. There are threats in this cavern other than the Red Meteonyker. Good luck.
dialogsDecline: Wise decision. Stay safe, traveler.
dialogsComplete: Kumah is alive? I see. And I see you have one of the three pieces of the key with you. You must be fearless for wanting to face the Red Meteonyker alone.
dialogsFail: You have not found any guardians yet? That is fine. We will find them eventually.

2917.name: Raising Pets 3 (E Tier -> D Tier)
2917.description: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
dialogsBegin: The higher the level granted for a particular tier (F, E, D, C, B, A or S), the higher the affected character statistic will be. The level granted is always random. Cool huh?
E Tier Pets such as this one have 2 levels available (1 - 2) and you achieved a random level during the last upgrade. Will you see me when your pet reaches 99.99% experience again?
dialogsAccept: Great! I'll see you when you get back. Good luck, and don't forget to feed your pet!
dialogsDecline: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsComplete: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to D tier now!
dialogsFail: Stop back by when your pet reaches 99.99% experience.

2920.name: Cracked Continent
2920.description: There are ancient altars on each continent. Please bring me 5 rocks from each contient.
dialogsBegin: Thank you very much for your help! I received plenty of money to study history thanks to you. Listen, it looks like all of the data about Madrigal is distorted.
I have been studying Madrigal history apart from the History Society and it seems that they do not want to correct the distorted history in these books.
The other day I was almost killed by renegade Blades but I cannot stop now. No matter what the History Society wants.
I will find out the true history of Madrigal, I have to. Would you please help me? The danger for you could be great however.
Will you help me regardless of the danger?
dialogsAccept: I knew you would! First, bring me 5 rocks from each of the 3 inhabited continents. Each continent has an Altar, bring me the rocks from each of these.
dialogsDecline: Thanks for listening to me anyway. I understand if you are unwilling to risk your life.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... This is exactly what I expected. I will study these some more but before you go please...
...you should be very, very careful. I am almost sure that the assassins that tried to kill me will come after you.
dialogsFail: Please bring me 5 rocks from each continent - Flaris, Darkon, and Saint Morning. Good luck!

3008.name: Look for Angelic Stone
3008.description: Hunt 60 Captain Glaphans, acquire the Angelic Stone, then take it to Capafe for transmutation.
dialogsBegin: Oh! Of course! It was an Angelic Stone that we require to complete the transmutation!
You can find Angelic Stones in Southern Darkon 3 near the Captain Glaphans. Will you please defeat them and acquire the stone?
dialogsAccept: Good! Please defeat 60 Captain Glaphan and acquire the Angelic Stone. Once the stone is in your possession, return to Capafe!
dialogsDecline: Are you giving up?
dialogsComplete: You have found the Angelic Stone! Now I can create a Shard of Enlightenment by combining both of the stones.
dialogsFail: We have no time for idle conversation. Please retrieve the stone!

3033.name: Prehistoric Birds (2)
3033.description: Almani asked for further help regarding the Gorruda threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Gorruda?
3033.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for further help regarding the Gorruda threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Gorruda?
dialogsAccept: You can find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ flying West of the Deadwallderness, over the mountains.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3059.name: Liquor for Dunkan
3059.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Dunkan needs you to collect Golden Wings to make a new liquor. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3065.name: Trials and Tribulations
3065.description: Complete the 2nd job transfer then meet with Reodos.
dialogsBegin: Oh! This pendant belonged to Reodos! So you found him after all? This is indeed great news!
I'm sure we will be able to break his curse and shall all once again be reunited. It is time we began the search for the other 4 heroes.
Before this though, it is time you continued your own personal training. It seems you are ready to accept your second job class. This will mark an important step in your path so choose wisely!
Please complete your second job quest. Once you have done this, go and meet Reodos again. Hopefully he has broken out of his curse by now.
dialogsAccept: Please go and meet Reodos as soon as you have finished with your quest!
dialogsDecline: It is imperative that you complete your second job quest. This will mark another step in your journey to becoming a true warrior!
dialogsComplete: Oh! I see you have completed your second job change quests!
dialogsFail: Best of luck in the completion of the trials that lay before you!

3079.name: Ainher's Request
dialogsBegin: The name is Ainher. Yes, try not to let the pure beauty of it make you go completely deaf. I'm sure you didn't just come all this way to learn my name though, so what DID you come here for?
Hehe, how did you know about the original 8 heroes? Ah it's ok, I've had creepier stalkers! I am the reincarnation of the original Psykeeper Hero Offerep…
I see. So Reonan looks to reunite the original heroes. If t his is the case, then something important must be going on! Unfortunately, I am rather tied down at the moment with research…
I guess if you maybe helped me to finish my research I would consider joining up. If you want to be of assistance to me, then please go talk to Drico and collect the Agony Ore.
dialogsAccept: Agony Ore is quite rare, so I'm sure Drico won't be willing to hand it over right away… But, I guess that is now your problem! Hehe.
dialogsDecline: Change your mind so quickly I see? Guess you weren't in that much of a hurry to get my help then! Hehe.
dialogsComplete: *Sniff* *Snort* Drico smell a stranger here? What stranger want? *sniff*
dialogsFail: Hurry along now! Go find Drico and retrieve the Agony Ore!

3087.name: Take to the Skies!
3087.description: Speak with Dior to claim your reward.
dialogsBegin: I knew there was something special about you. After reading this letter it seems Tina has taken a liking to you too! What does the letter say, you ask? That's a secret!
Congratulations on passing the Initial Test. I'll prepare a reward. It's an experimental fuel that gives your flying device a temporary speed boost!
dialogsAccept: When you have time come speak to me again. I'll prepare the reward for you now.
dialogsDecline: Speak to me when you get a moment. I'll prepare the reward for you.
dialogsComplete: Your reward is ready! Here you go! Come see me again once you've gained more experience. I'm sure I'll have more "Tests" for you! *wink*

3105.name: Dwarpet Kazen
dialogsBegin: What brings you here? I am sure you know of the many deaths surrounding this place.
You will not be able to find out what happened here without my help. I will tell you what you want to know if you do me a favor. What do you think?
dialogsAccept: Bring me 30 Cillin and I will tell you everything you need to know.
dialogsDecline: Pssh, some great hero, you cannot even bring me some simple stones.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I did not think you would be back so soon. Take this money as a gift.
dialogsFail: I said 30. Not 29 or 28. Bring me 30 Cillin.

3134.name: Get the Key to escape Kebaras Island
dialogsBegin: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsAccept: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsDecline: How long until you are ready to leave this place?
dialogsComplete: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsFail: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?

3170.name: Duty of Magician
3170.description: Defeat Seido near the west of Flarine. Speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze once he has been defeated.
dialogsBegin: You learn quickly, Vagrant! Perhaps you will be a great Magician one day! Here, take this. It is a Label of Technique that details what I've explained to you today.
For your final task, I want you to travel to the west of Flaris and defeat the creature known as Seido. He has been harassing some of the residents of Flarine as of late.
Once Seido is defeated, speak with Magician Instructor Lopaze in Eastern Flarine. She will conclude your training.
dialogsAccept: You've done very well so far, young one. Keep up the great work!
dialogsDecline: You've come a long way just to give up when you're so close to the end. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
As Magicians, we are most effective when attacking at long range. Many of our skills employ the power of the elements.
This allows us to take advantage of elemental vulnerabilities that our enemies may have. Congratulations, young one! You are now a Magician!
dialogsFail: I sure wish someone would take care of that Seido creature near Flarine… Oh, hello! Did you need something?

3207.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
3207.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

3247.name: Chapter 4 Their Shadow
3247.description: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsBegin: Oh, nice to see you again. I have found something based on the data you gave me. You know more than most about the Clowns at this point.

People have been talking about them for some time now. They are known as three devils that created our continents on accident and are bent on destroying them. During the Hero War, they were said to stand against the heroes of our land.

Lapranche was there, at the end of the Hero War, she was made the slave of One of the three Clown Gods. Shade, Goddess of Evil. Shade, marrying her Godly presence to the great power of Laola, attempted to destroy Bubble, God of Good, while Iblis, God of Neutrality, watched unmoved. Bubble rallied the heroes of Madrigal and stood against Shade with the strongest army our world has ever know at her back.
Poor Lapranche, the things she must have gone through And all this history has been distorted by the History Society. Curse them!
*sigh* Would you help me return this to Martinyc. She deserves to know what she helped uncover.
dialogsAccept: Here is all the data I have. Please deliver this to Martinyc.
dialogsDecline: I see, you have something important to do. Would you come back to me after finishing that?
dialogsComplete: Long time no see! Are you coming back to let me know that I was right?
Yeah! I knew it! By the way, what is that?
Oh, now I wish I had been wrong! Thank you for bringing this to me. We will see each other again. Goodbye.
dialogsFail: Have you brought something from the History Society? No? Then are you coming back just to talk to me? I am too shy for that.

3250.name: Flying Circus (2)
3250.description: Dior asked for further help regarding the Rockepeller threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Rockepeller?
3250.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Dior asked for further help regarding the Rockepeller threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Rockepeller?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Rockepeller flying between Flaris and Darkon continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3254.name: Obsessed with Crystals! (4)
3254.description: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Ghost of the Forgotten.
3254.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Crystals! Hmmm.... $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s! Could you please bring me some $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$!?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Ghost of the Forgotten.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: You did it! Hooray! Here's your reward. Come back soon!
dialogsFail: More! More!

3286.name: Flying Circus
3286.description: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
3286.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Dior asked for help with reducing the Rockepeller population as they're causing problems with transport between Darkon & Flaris. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Rockepeller flying between Flaris and Darkon continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3299.name: Unknown Situation (1)
3299.description: Flaris Pang wants you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
3299.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Flaris Pang needs you to collect Unknown Certificates. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect Unknown Certificates near the Bangs.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3316.name: Into the Dark
3316.description: Defeat Iblis Guardian and enter the altar.
dialogsBegin: Hi. I have studied the information you brought me and I have found that there is an altar in the Iblis Temple. There is also evidence that there are masquerpets guarding the altar.
Do you see? They do not want anyone to interupt the revival of Iblis. We need to do something. We need to stop them!
Are you ready for one last journey into the dark?
dialogsAccept: I knew you would be. There is a masquerpet name Iblis Guardian. If you can defeat it, you can enter the altar.
dialogsDecline: Are you serious? What could be more important than saving the world?
dialogsComplete: Great job, now you can enter the altar. I am counting on you to defeat the followers of Iblis... we all are. Go to the altar now.
dialogsFail: I do not know exactly where Iblis Guardian is. But we have to find it and destroy it.

3334.name: Billposter Hero - Sury
3334.description: Hunt 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias and then speak with Sury
dialogsBegin: I'm very close to reaching a perpetual state of enlightenment. It is crucial that you don't…
Reonan!? He sent you? You seem rather weak for someone Reonan has supposedly entrusted so much knowledge to…
We will prove just what you are capable of. If you are successful in carrying out 3 tests, then our conversation will resume…
First, please go and defeat 50 Small Luias & 35 Luias. This should be sufficient to prove to me that you are a worthy disciple of Reonan.
dialogsAccept: Well, you talk a big game. But remember, actions do speak louder than words. Lets see if you can complete the quest.
dialogsDecline: If you do not wish to undergo the quest, then move along. I need absolute concentration.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... You are definitely stronger than I previously imagined you would be…
dialogsFail: Please do not talk to me until you have defeated 20 Small Luias & 15 Luias.

3344.name: Strange Collector (6)
3344.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Strange Collector needs $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3384.name: Repressing the Past
3384.description: Kill Garbagespiders and reclaim the Promise Ring
dialogsBegin: *Reading letter* Hmm... I see. There is a reason he refuses to fight. Elaine had a sister, Hannah, for whom he cared very dearly…
She was killed during the war… Only, Elaine didn't learn of any of this until after everything was over. He blamed himself for it all…
In a fit of rage, he threw her ring, the last memento he had of her, into the air somewhere in Western Darkon 1. If you could retrieve it maybe he would reconsider?
dialogsAccept: I guarantee you a Garbagespider ate the ring. They eat anything and everything! Please head to Western Darkon and defeat Garbagespiders until you can recover the ring!
dialogsDecline: Oh… I figured you would do this for him…
dialogsComplete: Yes! Yes! This is it!
dialogsFail: I'm sure a Garbagespider has the ring! Please go and reclaim it for Elaine's sake!

3397.name: The 1st Bone Bowl
3397.description: Bring 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 black Heroka grass to Bowler the Bowl Merchant in Rhisis.
dialogsBegin: The Bone Bowl was created by a black magician a long long time ago. In a town, a woman lived with her little pet, who was named Baby.
The pet went crazy and began attacking townsfolk. As a result, both of them were kicked out of the town.
The woman came back to the town, but the people in town killed her pet! Then the black magician made a bowl out of the skull of her pet and cursed it!
The town disappeared because of the curse, and so did the bowl…but there are some that say…Well, I've already said too much.
So you want the real Bone Bowl, right? Well, you'll have to do something for me first. Nothing in this world is free, right? Hahaha!
dialogsAccept: Good! Bring me 10 Black Tombmarbles from Tombstone Bearers, 5 Black Spell Books and 5 Black Heroka Grass from somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsDecline: Hey, it's up to you. Too bad though, I could have used those items to help you with your problem…
dialogsComplete: Great job! This stuff will come in real handy!
dialogsFail: You did not bring me everything I asked. Please bring me the items I requested.

3398.name: Journal of an Adventurer (1)
3398.description: Deliver the Diary to the Mayor of Darkon.
dialogsBegin: Hello Adventurer. Although you don't know me, I must ask a favor of you. I have found something… incredible. Bring it to the Mayor of Darkon right away.
dialogsAccept: Thank you, I am in your debt.
dialogsDecline: You can not understand the implications of this quest… He needs this book!
dialogsComplete: You seem to have something important to say, what is it?
OH MY! I can't believe this! The diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt…
dialogsFail: Don’t worry about the pay. So, please hurry up.

3407.name: Bolpor's favor
3407.description: You can collect them from the group of Muffrin in the Deadwallderness.
3407.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Bolpor requested you to collect Rincruet for making some special food. Will you accept this request?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Muffrin.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3478.name: Dispatch to Saint City
3478.description: Meet Leann in front of the Cathedral in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Nonetheless, because of your work, it appears peace has finally been restored to Flarine. Alas, Madrigal is a world ripe with distress.
I have received word from a contact in Saint City that masquerpet attacks are steadily on the rise. It also seems that the concerns of the towns people go unheeded.
It looks like this could once again be your chance to prove your true worth. Make haste to Saint City and meet my contact Leann!
dialogsAccept: You can reach Saint City by flying west from this location using an Airship from Central Flarine or your own Flying device. You may also purchase a blinkwing of Saint Morning from Marche, the resident magician.
dialogsDecline: Hmm, I guess this worlds call for heroes is currently falling upon deaf ears.
dialogsComplete: Where is the savior that Reonan was talking about? I don't have time to talk to you. This is not a good time for me to guide you around!! Traveler!!.
dialogsFail: My contact's name is Leann. You can meet her in the Saint Morning square, in front of the Cathedral.

3482.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
3482.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

3496.name: The Retired Hero
dialogsBegin: Since you have my trust, I will give you another piece of information. There is another hero hiding out here in Darkon. His name is Elaine, Hero Ranger.
After the war, and our reincarnation, both Elaine and I fled up here to the mountains.
If Reonan is trying so hard to reach out to us, then I guess it might be time again. You should go to find Elaine.
dialogsAccept: He lives west of this current location. Be warned. Since the war, he has retired his weapons and become a self proclaimed pacifist. I'm not sure how willing he will be to join with the rest…
dialogsDecline: Well, you know where he is. Whenever you have the time, seek him out.
dialogsComplete: Greetings stranger! My name is Elaine. What brings you all the way up here?
dialogsFail: Elaine lives just West of this location. Please go and find him!

3512.name: Crane Repair
3512.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: The Erons Industrial Manager needs Droil to repair their crane. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3521.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
3521.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

3561.name: Mutated Aibatts (2)
3561.description: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Zendros threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Zendros?
3561.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Zendros threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Zendros?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Zendros flying between Flaris and Saint morning continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3571.name: Town Fortification
3571.description: Please bring back 20 Wood & 20 Stone. You can obtain the Wood from most kinds of Yetti and Stone from most kinds of Augu.
dialogsBegin: It seems as though the masquerpets are a greater threat than I thought. We will need to fortify our town as soon as possible.
Bring us some wood and stone. We can make good use of it and reinforce our buildings and fences.
dialogsAccept: Please bring back 20 Wood & 20 Stone. You can obtain the Wood from most kinds of Yetti and Stone from most kinds of Augu.
dialogsComplete: It appears your efforts were a success. Thank you.
dialogsFail: That will not be enough, sadly!

3577.name: Gathering of Heroes
3577.description: Reach level 70, then meet with Reodos.
dialogsBegin: Two more pendants!? Ah Elaine and Zoro. It's been awhile… Thought I might never see them again… Knowing they stand by my side, I feel a renewed sense of determination!
Now 6 heroes are gathered! I, Handel, Hael, Reodos, Zoro, Elaine are gathered. We just need to find the last 2! Before this, I feel it is time for you to hone in on your own skills!
We will need the assistance of warriors like yourself! But, you still have plenty of room to grow! Are you ready to further ascend your path to glory?
dialogsAccept: Please train to level 70, then talk with Reodos!
dialogsDecline: Real champions are born by pushing one's own skill to the limit. I know you have it in you to overcome the odds…
dialogsComplete: Oh! Impressive! You have grown quite a bit stronger since we last met!
dialogsFail: After reaching level 70, talk with Reodos

3581.name: Moth Infestation
3581.description: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
3581.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina asked for help with reducing the Mothbee population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Mothbee flying inbetween Northern Saint City & Flaris.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3612.name: Baby Meteonyker (2)
3612.description: Almani asked for further help regarding the Fafnir threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Fafnir?
3612.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for further help regarding the Fafnir threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Fafnir?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Fafnir flying near the Volcano in Darkon 3, Brekin.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3651.name: Quest for Truth
3651.description: Go find Handel in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin: Lost memory you say? Must have been hard for him wandering around so aimlessly with no true identity. We will give him time to gather his thoughts…
In the meantime, are you aware of the Garden of Rhisis? It is the landmass Northeast of Saint Morning. My friend Handel is currently conducting research there.
Her work takes much time and the constant threat of masquerpet attacks doesn't help the process. Will you please go and assist her?
dialogsAccept: You can reach the Garden of Rhisis by flying Northeast from the continent of Saint Morning. Please go there and meet up with Handel
dialogsDecline: Hah, I see! After using all those town blinkwings, you've already forgotten how to fly.
dialogsComplete: Welcome to the Garden of Rhisis. I have been expecting you. Do you understand the nature of my research?
dialogsFail: Handel is in the Northern part of the Garden of Rhisis. Please go locate her!

3676.name: Steel Knight Night!
3676.description: Kill 20 Small Steel Knights and 10 Steel Knights.
dialogsBegin: What's that!? A reunification of the 8 heroes! You happen to be looking at one of them! I am Reodos, the mighty Ele…
Well… was a mighty Elementor Hero… Shade cursed me. Trapping me in this cute furry little body was apparently the only way to contain all this power! Bwahaha!
I will have my vengeance upon Shade, she will scorn the day she ever messed with Reodos! Now I just need to figure a cure for this curse and…
Man! I can hardly hear my own thoughts with these stupid Steel Knights clanking around. Could you please get rid of some of them?
dialogsAccept: Awesome!! I'm trying to research into removing this curse but UGHHH those stupid Steel Knights! Kill like 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights. and I will be one happy unicorn, dog thing…
dialogsDecline: You can't do that for me?
dialogsComplete: Ah! Now I can collect my thoughts. What? You look at me like you've never met an Elementor before. Er… we are all a little eccentric I guess you could say.
dialogsFail: Yes, yes the Steel Knights! Please eradicate 20 Small Steel Knights & 10 Steel Knights!

3690.name: Helping injured animals
3690.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Madrigal Animal Association needs you to collect Bobands to help their injured animals. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3706.name: Time is Money
3706.description: Kill 10 Vice Veduque and meet Hael.
dialogsBegin: Wha? Someone named Reonan is looking for me? Sounds familiar but… UGH! I've got way too bad of a headache to be thinking about things right now.
Reonan... It's the first time hearing that name, but it is familiar... He said its time? Time for what, I wonder…
Regardless! I have my own goals and limited time so move along! There is a foul demon lurking in the Mars Mine with a bounty on its head JUST waiting to be claimed *sneer*
UGH! Headache…getting…worse! OK look, here's the deal. You take out that Vice Veduque, give me the reward and I will meet your Reonan. Deal?
dialogsAccept: Well, never expected you to accept THAT offer? Well anyway, go kill 10 Vice Veduque in Mars Mine then return to me!
dialogsDecline: No skin off my back! Planned to do it myself anyway. Just gotta, ya know, rest a minute or two…or three…
dialogsComplete: Hmpf killed them huh? Well aren't we proud of ourselves. Anyway, while you were in Mars Mine, I thought again about this here… Reonan, or whatever his name is.
dialogsFail: *snores* huh!? What!? I was awake, just resting my eyes!

3712.name: Unknown Situation (2)
3712.description: Flaris Pang needs unknown letters again.
3712.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Flaris Pang needs you to collect unknown letters.
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ near a bridge in north.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3761.name: Looking for the Play Script
3761.description: Look around for the machine spouting steam that is being controlled by a grave robber. You may have to use force…
dialogsBegin: Hey! I am not lying! Why on earth do you not believe me? Okay, yes, I stole the play script, but it was for revenge!
There is no evidence that I'm a liar, right? In that case, if you want to find the play script...
I think someone among them has it.
dialogsAccept: Hey! You there! Let me out of here! Help me, please!
dialogsDecline: Look, I know it's none of your business. Will you help me anyway? Please!?
dialogsComplete: Oh thank goodness! Finally I got it back! Thank you so very much!
If you would have been 5 minutes longer, I would have been fired. Whew! That was a close one!
I have a gift for you for helping me out. Please, take it.
dialogsFail: Please find it quickly. If you don't return in time, I'll be fired! I've got 5 kids to feed!

3838.name: Get the Key to escape Kebaras Island
dialogsBegin: You can warp away from here at the Warp Zone but you need the Key. Are you ready to earn it?
dialogsAccept: I will give you the Key if you can bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ Beads of Sin. You can get the beads in the empty lot beside the campsite.
dialogsDecline: You are welcome to stay for as long as you would like.
dialogsComplete: Here is the Key. Now go and never return.
dialogsFail: I will give you your freedom for only $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ beads. How could you pass on an offer like that?

3839.name: Soups On!
dialogsBegin: Well, I should hurry and get dinner going. Would you please fetch Nerco for me? I'm sure if I saw him right now, I'd kick his little butt from here to Darkon!
dialogsAccept: Thank you so much! I'm sure that crafty little liar is still where you last saw him!
dialogsDecline: Well, looks like someone is going to bed on an empty stomach then!
dialogsComplete: You again? I said I would be home soon enough! Don't tell me my mother sent you!?
dialogsFail: Please go tell Nerco to come home for dinner!

3890.name: Doll of Mia
3890.description: Speak with JeongHwa in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: What? It worked? What do you have there? Oh my… then this means… That's horrible!
Thank you very much for bringing this to me, adventurer. I need to tell JeongHwa right away.
Wait a minute, she's not going to believe me unless I have some proof. Where can I get some proof? Yes… That's it!
If her daughter is still amongst Mias, then she would still have her most prized possession. I need it in order to persuade JeongHwa. Would you bring it to me, please?
dialogsAccept: JeongHwa had a daughter whose name was Jinyoung. Jinyoung loved her doll very much. Perhaps I can convince JeongHwa if I can find her doll amongst the Mias...
dialogsDecline: You must not know what it is like to lose a child. JeongHwa may never know the truth about her daughter.
dialogsComplete: What… do you have there? My daughter's doll? My poor, sweet Jinyoung. Now I can begin to mourn. Thank you, young one. For bringing this to me.
dialogsFail: Have you found my daughter yet? Please don't give up! I'd give anything to see her again.

3902.name: Relics of a Husband
3902.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: A widow has asked that you collect Eronior so that she can re-make the ring of her husband. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

3923.name: Essence of the Gods
3923.description: Kill 15 Phantom Basques & 7 Basques and find the Bubble Trace and bring it to Bowler.
dialogsBegin: It's of no use… The stamp is just too damaged to gather much significant information. It did allude to the War of the Gods though…
I know from lore that, during this time, Bubble decided to take action against Shade and her masquerpet army. A battle occurred between the gods at this very location.
It is rumored that the essence of both gods remains in this garden till this day. Could you please find the Bubble Trace for me?
dialogsAccept: Please defeat the Basques in the North and acquire the Bubble Trace. Once you have this, take it to Bowler. He knows much more ancient lore than myself.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help me? Oh well... Then I will go myself...
dialogsComplete: Hmm? Yes I am Bowler, last keeper of the lore of this continent. WHAT!? You come bearing the Bubble Trace!?
dialogsFail: Please kill 15 Basques, acquire the Bubble Trace and take it to Bowler.

3934.name: Introduction to Armor
3934.description: Visit Boboko at the Weapon Shop.
dialogsBegin: Good to see you again! Glad to see some new faces in Madrigal, what with all the Masquerpets around. Let's see what we can do to get you ready to face them.
This is the Armor Shop. Here, you can buy the armor crafted by my family once you meet the requirements for it. There are 4 armor slots in your inventory - Helmet, Suit, Gauntlet, and Boots.
You'll find that different jobs and levels have access to different kinds of armor. 'Course, you probably already knew that. Now, go talk with my brother Boboku next door at his Weapon Shop.
dialogsAccept: I know it's loud over here, but didn't you see me pointin'? Boboku's Weapon Shop is right next door!
dialogsDecline: You sure? Well if you change your mind, nobody knows weapons like my brother Boboku.
dialogsComplete: Well hello there! Good of you to stop by. Here, take this, and the next time I see ya we'll get you up to speed on weapons.

3942.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
3942.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

3952.name: Hey look, a flying rat!
3952.description: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
3952.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for Longwings to be exterminated, as they have been attacking civilians. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Longwings flying South-East of the Clockworks Cage in the mountains.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

3977.name: Successor of Hero -Scroll-
3977.description: Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town.
dialogsBegin: Alright, so let's move on. Deliver the Magic Underwear of Power to Ryupang in Madren Town
dialogsAccept: Make haste, Magician!
dialogsDecline: Ryupang NEEDS that underwear! Please, think it over!
dialogsComplete: Hmmm… yes? What've you go there, young Magician?
The Magic Underwear of Power! Where did you find them? No matter, the important thing is that we now have this very important relic.
Take this, my friend. This Stamped Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsFail: We are the survivors of the Massacre of the Mr. Pumpkins. We became soldiers to fight back and seek our revenge. Curse those Pumpkin-heads!

3981.name: Overlord
3981.description: We must defeat these giants at once!
dialogsBegin: There is very dark and evil power behind these masquerpets. I fear my suspicions are correct.
Some of these masquerpets are being empowered by giant variants. This gives them enough power to break through our barrier!
We must defeat these giants at once!
dialogsAccept: Hurry! We do not have much time left.
dialogsDecline: Very unfortunate...
dialogsComplete: That was a close call. Thank you.
Our barrier is safe for now, but there appears to be another army approaching much closer now. This one is a far graver threat than any we have ever faced.
We must prepare for this battle. Speak to Auxilior as soon as possible.
dialogsFail: We must defeat more than that.

3997.name: The High Magician, Laola
3997.description: Go to Darkon 3 to find Laola
dialogsBegin: I've heard you are still in search of the legendary heroes, no? I've heard of a powerful warrior undergoing extensive training in Darkon 3. This might be one of the warriors for which you are searching.
I was informed of this warrior by my friend Laola, who works in Darkon 3. Please go meet with her for further details!
dialogsAccept: Laola should be at her house in the forests of Darkon 3, where she works as a gardener. Just be aware, the area is overrun with many monsters!
dialogsDecline: Too bad! Well if you are free, wanna help me complete some more deliveries?
dialogsComplete: Hey now! Who are you? Why are you coming to my flower garden without any permission?
dialogsFail: Laola will be in Darkon 3. Please go find her!

4016.name: Kids Disappeared?
4016.description: Slay 20 Small Mias and return to Porgo, in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: The case of the missing children? Hmm... Well a few years ago, a group of young, six year old girls suddenly disappeared from Saint City.
Everyone attempted to find the kids, but they all failed.
I never gave up and I kept trying to solve the case. I had discovered many things, and reported them to the Public Office.
However, they rejected my findings due to the lack of evidence. So as I was gathering evidence, I suddenly came up with an idea when I saw those strange Masquerpets; Mia.
Anyway, will you help me?
dialogsAccept: Great! Slay 20 Small Mias and tell me what you make of them.
dialogsDecline: That's a shame. I guess there's no hope for those girls…
dialogsComplete: Uh huh, yes. I see. Okay, thank you for bringing me this information, friend.
dialogsFail: I need more information, friend. Please slay 20 Small Mias and report back to me.

4117.name: Cookie Machine, Valin Baget
4117.description: Valin needs you to collect Slain for his cookie machine.
4117.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Valin needs you to collect Slain to fuel his Cookie Machine. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

4243.name: Uncovered Past
4243.description: Find the Disappearance Investigation report buried somewhere near Saint Hall and bring it to Porgo.
dialogsBegin: Yes! This is it! The report was definitely written with all the facts, but not all the facts were ever proven.
And the color of some of the pages in the report are slightly different. They must have been added later…
It must be because they are trying to keep this whole thing a secret. This is a memo that proves what has been done.
The memo instructs them to change the pages in the official report and bury the original behind Saint Hall. We're about to uncover the truth to this mystery!
You think you can give me a hand with this? We're close to finding the truth!
dialogsAccept: Thank you! If this is true, the original report was buried somewhere near Saint Hall. Please bring it to me. Hurry!
dialogsDecline: I know you don't want to get involved, but please. Think of the children.
dialogsComplete: You found it! I will do my best to uncover the truth and bring those responsible for hiding this to justice!
dialogsFail: You didn't find it? It has to be there. Check again!

4251.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
4251.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

4287.name: Prepare for Battle! (1)
4287.description: Slay Augu and gather Crystal Essence. Also obtain a hammer from a Lord Yetti.
dialogsBegin: There is no time to waste. We must strengthen our magic barrier and gather materials. Slay some Augu and gather what little Crystal Essence they may have shared from the Glacial Augu.
dialogsAccept: Once you do, bring us a hammer from a Lord Yetti. This is a formidable weapon that we can use to defend ourselves.
dialogsComplete: Let's go then.

4336.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
4336.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

4339.name: Raising Pets 5 (C Tier -> B Tier)
4339.description: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
dialogsBegin: Excellent job raising your pet so far, my friend. You two certainly look happy together!
I'm sure you've noticed by now that the higher the level granted for a particular tier, the higher the benefit to your Stats.
dialogsAccept: No pain, no gain. I'm sure you know the drill by now. Bring the experience of your pet to 99.99% and bring it back to me. I will upgrade it when your done.
dialogsDecline: Don't give up now, you're doing such a great job!
dialogsComplete: The two of you are becoming stronger together, and it looks like you guys have become pretty good friends in the process. Excellent! I will upgrade your pet to B tier now!
dialogsFail: Not quite there… your pet needs more experience. I'm sure you already knew that.

4377.name: Special Kids
4377.description: Slay Mias and Captain Mias and return to Porgo with any information you gather.
dialogsBegin: Hey! I have some new findings in the case of the missing girls!
According to this report, there is one more thing in common with the kids who disappeared from Saint City. They were all girls.
But I cannot find out what the similarity is in this report. It's really frustrating!
Will you help me find out what's going on here?
dialogsAccept: I need you to fight with Captain Mias and Mias and look for similarities between them, or anything you might find strange about them.
dialogsDecline: You won't? Please, help me. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Oh, thank you so much! You've been such a great help so far! I couldn't have made it this far without you!
dialogsFail: Have you seen any strange similarities between them? Keep looking! I'm counting on you!

4398.name: An Acrobat's Duty
4398.description: There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine. I want you to go there and put an end to him. Bring news of your victory to Tailer the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsBegin: You've learned many things since your journey began.
Now for the next step in your training. There is a creature named Shuraiture in the north of Flarine who is causing some trouble for residents there.
Shuraiture has been terrorizing some of the locals in Flaris. I want you to go there and put an end to him once and for all. Bring news of your victory to Tailer, the Acrobat Instructor in Flarine.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, you'll need it!
dialogsDecline: What's the matter? Chicken?
dialogsComplete: Shuraiture is… no more? What great news! Thank you so much! I see that you've also spoken with Tucani. Here is your reward for defeating Shuraiture.
Acrobats are very versatile. We can fight at long range or in close quarters! We also have a special ability which allows us to pull an enemy target up close.
You've done well. I sense great potential in you. Congratulations, Acrobat!
dialogsFail: Why have you come to see me? Did Tucani send you?

4424.name: Get the Portrait Back
4424.description: Travel to the Red Bang Troup camp northeast of the Mars Mine and recover the Portrait of Radion. Return it to Rudvihil once you find it.
dialogsBegin: Be careful, I hear those Red Bang Troupe members pack quite a punch. I never liked them anyway. They don't tell good jokes.
I grow tired of those who are all work and no play. Kind of like you. Do you ever just have fun? Or is everything always work, work, work?
dialogsAccept: Ugh… well unless you have something funny to say, I think our business is concluded. I need to rest now. Black Magic takes a lot out of me.
dialogsDecline: What do you mean? I'm not in a bad mood. I'm like this to everyone. Unless you can make me laugh!
dialogsComplete: Is that my portrait?! Give it here!
Wait, what? What reward? I never said anything about a reward. Begone, pest!
Let this be a lesson to you. Before helping someone, make sure you find out upfront whether or not there is a reward being offered. Hahaha!
dialogsFail: You haven't found it yet? Well keep looking!

4530.name: Successor of Hero -Guardian-
4530.description: Defeat the Cardinal Guardian in Guardiane and retrieve his heart. Then visit Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane
dialogsBegin: Here is the Symbol of the Hero. You have to complete one more task in order to be recognized as a Successor of the Hero.
There is a place called the Room of the Guardian. You can find it in Guardiane. There, the Will of Heroes is protected.
Defeat the guardian spirit, Cardinal Guardian, and retrieve his heart.
Then, deliver the heart to Romvoette, the Ringmaster Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck, Assist.
dialogsDecline: You've come all this way just to give up? This is the last step. Please, think this through.
dialogsComplete: Welcome, Assist. You've done very well! Now, I appoint you the Successor of the Ringmaster Hero!
Aenn, bless and watch over this person who is following your will, Ringmaster!
dialogsFail: I believe you've come here by mistake, Assist. Have you forgotten your task?

4550.name: Shards of Memory
4550.description: Locate the Memory shard in Northern Flaris and bring it to Ancimys
dialogsBegin: I have known Hael many years. When I first discovered him, he was laying there unconscious. I was able to nurse him back to health, but still he had no recollection of his memory. There is a way to recover it though…
I feel there might be something important lost in his past. The only way to recover it would be by using a Memory Shard. This should allow Hael to uncover his past.
First, you will need to purify the shard by bringing it to the Magic Box Ancimys. Will you retrieve the purified Memory shard and bring it to Hael?
dialogsAccept: Please locate the Memory Shard which should be somewhere around the Altar of Violet in Northern Flaris. There are Violet Magician Troupe patrolling the area.
dialogsDecline: If you wish Hael's assistance, this might be the only chance you have…
dialogsComplete: Hey! You act like you haven't seen a man trapped in a treasure chest before. Oh you come bearing Memory Shards to be purified?
Huh? You want me to show you the most powerful skill of mine? Hmm... If you want to see it, I can show you. Here! Put those pieces into my mouth. ah~~
dialogsFail: Please acquire the Memory Shard located at the Altar of Violet, and bring it to Ancimys for purification.

4556.name: Flybrigen Brigade
4556.description: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
4556.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina asked for help with reducing the Flybrigen population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Flybrigen flying between Saint Morning and Garden of Rhisis continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

4559.name: Avenge Nerky
4559.description: You can collect them from the group of Bearnerky in the Deadwallderness.
4559.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Krinton's pet Bearnerky got killed by the other Bearnerky. Krinton requested you to collect NerkyMane for revenge. Will you accept this request?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Bearnerky.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

4607.name: Successor of Hero -Altar-
4607.description: Retrieve the Poster of Skill from the Steam Walkers, then bring it to Fera in Arians, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: Head on over to Fera, the Billposter Priest. She manages their Altar in Arians, Darkon 3.
She’s been looking for the Poster of Skill which contains Shadow Avatar, Roentel’s most devastating technique.
Rumor has it that grave-robbers controlling the Steam Walkers have gotten a hold of it. Take it back from them, and get it into Fera’s hands.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, friend!
dialogsDecline: Someone with evil intentions using Shadow Avatar could lead to catastrophe. Please, reconsider!
dialogsComplete: Well done! People say that only Roentel can use this, but with Billposters like you around, who knows?
Until then though, I’ll do my best to protect it.
dialogsFail: What brings you to this holy Altar for the souls of Heroes?

4630.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
4630.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

4745.name: Arm of Assist
4745.description: Gather 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then deliver them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: You've done well so far, Vagrant. But I have another task for you if you are willing.
For your next task, I need you to gather some materials which are used to create Assist weapons.
Retrieve 10 Forforms from Mushpangs, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Maki, the Assist Master in Northern Flarine.
The Assist Master is with the Madrigal Job Masters in North-Fl. Go!
dialogsAccept: Good luck, Vagrant!
dialogsDecline: I guess some people just aren't suited to be an Assist. That's alright, young one. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Thank you for delivering the Forform, Vagrant. Now, on to your next lesson. Assist weapons include Knuckles or Sticks.
A Knuckle is a fist weapon used for close-quarters combat, and the Stick is used to perform certain Assist skills, such as healing.
It's important to remember that you must have the right weapon equipped to perform certain abilities. With enough practice, a good Assist can switch weapons in combat seamlessly.
dialogsFail: I'm sorry, I'm waiting for someone to bring something very important. Is that you? I didn't think so.

4757.name: Sury's Realization
4757.description: Hand the Shard of Enlightenment to Sury.
dialogsBegin: The process of transmutation required to create the Shard of Enlightenment will take just a moment…
It is finished. Please bring the Shard of Enlightenment to Sury as soon as you can.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. This should help bring the clarity to her thoughts that Sury requires.
dialogsDecline: It would be most unwise to deny this request…
dialogsComplete: I see you have returned. What has transpired?
dialogsFail: Please hurry. Sury needs our aid.

4796.name: Flybrigen Brigade (2)
4796.description: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Flybrigen threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Flybrigen?
4796.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Flybrigen threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Flybrigen?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Flybrigen flying between Saint Morning and Garden of Rhisis continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

4797.name: Chapter 2 Hill of Shade: History of Hardship
4797.description: I finished checking the data which Hachal requested. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsBegin: I finished checking the data that Hachal provided. Please deliver this to Hachal.
dialogsAccept: I hope you will continue to be as lucky as you have been.
dialogsDecline: If not you then who? No one can take this job!
dialogsComplete: Hmm... History of Hardship. So did he give this to you? Excellent. If he says this will be useful then I am sure it will.
See you later. Take care.
dialogsFail: Did Rovanett say anything? That makes no sense. Please visit her again. She must have something to say to you.

4830.name: Dragonflies
4830.description: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
4830.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina asked for help with reducing the Neparuba population as they're causing problems with transport. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Neparuba flying between Flaris and Saint morning continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

4852.name: Sound which calls the Dark
4852.description: Investigate the entrance to the Mars Mine.
dialogsBegin: Have you ever heard the horrible sound from Mars Mine? That strange and hair-raising sound… It's spooky!
Maybe you haven't, but you will. Muahahaha! I heard it clearly! I hope it's not the sound I think it is...
(After a long hesitation...) Listen, if it is the sound I think it is, we have a big problem. Well, more like a disaster.
(Holds your hands suddenly… creepy, right?) So, please, will you do me a favor?
dialogsAccept: Great, please investigate the entrance to the Mars Mine, then return to me.
dialogsDecline: Not interested, huh? Fine, go play with Aibatts or something…
dialogsComplete: Unfortunately it's exactly what I thought... Darn, I am still missing something.
dialogsFail: Please just investigate the entrance. It can't be that hard…

4860.name: Vagrant Master (Acrobat)
4860.description: For starters, let's go with something easy. I would like you to hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s.
dialogsBegin: So you want to be an Acrobat, huh? You won't regret it! I have a simple test for you before starting the training. Are you ready? …hic!
For starters, let's go with something easy. I would like you to hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s.
dialogsAccept: Good luck! You'll need it!
dialogsDecline: What are you afraid of? The path to become an Acrobat may be difficult for some, but it's so worth it! Come back if you change your mind, friend.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You've passed the first test!
dialogsFail: I'm still waiting for you to hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ Small Aibatts. If you want to become an Acrobat, you must complete this simple task.

4881.name: Legend of Dreadpet <Moot Arvan>
4881.description: Travel to the Plain of Bubble, defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and retrieve both the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME,2$ for Novelist Gergantes in Northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Pssst, hey you! I am writing a book and I need your help! I've had a little writers block lately and I need a brave adventurer to help me write it!
Have you ever heard of the legend of Moot Arvan? No? A long time ago, there was very a famous adventurer, Moot Arvan. One day, he found an interesting place to adventure...
It was a strange, wet marsh. Moot explored the marsh only to become infested with a disease called Unpleasant Fear.
The disease transformed him into a hideous monster known as Mushmoot! There's virtually nothing left of that brave adventurer but bits and pieces, or so they say…
So, here's where you come in. I need an ending to the story and I'd like to know what's become of Mushmoot. Feel like helping?
dialogsAccept: Great! One of those pesky Hadeseors at the Plain of Bubble has stolen one of my reference books! Find and recover the book for me and see if you can locate the Boggy Map while you're there.
dialogsDecline: Don't be a scaredy-cat! Look, I'll even give you 50% of the proceeds from my book sales if you help. Okay?
dialogsComplete: Yes, great work! I knew you could do it!

Here, take this. It's Moot's Heart. 

*You begin to feel sick…*

 Oh shake it off, slacker!
Take that heart to the Dreadpet Manager at the Eastern River of Weeping. You'll need to form a party first, it's way too dangerous to go in there alone.
dialogsFail: Ah geez! What are you afraid of? A Hadeseor? Psht! I guess you aren't as brave as I thought you were.

4921.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
4921.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

4972.name: Customer Satisfaction
dialogsBegin: Just in time! Now I can finally finish my work. Will you tell Achaben thanks for me!
dialogsAccept: Tell Achaben I will be doing all my ordering from him in the future!
dialogsDecline: Oh? You think I should go tell him myself?
dialogsComplete: Did you deliver the package to Remine? *phew* Oh, Thank you. You saved me.
dialogsFail: Did you deliver my greetings to Achaben?

4990.name: Laws of Aviation (2)
4990.description: Buy a flying device and report back to Dior.
dialogsBegin: So you've finally reached level 20! This is the perfect time to learn how to operate your very own flying device.
The first thing you need to do is buy a flying device. Come back to me when you have one. I sell Boards & Brooms so take a look in my Store.
dialogsAccept: Buy a flying device of your choice, and report back to me.
dialogsDecline: Let me know when you're ready.
dialogsComplete: You've made your choice? Great, let's get started!

4996.name: Raising Pets 1 (Egg -> F Tier)
4996.description: The Pet Tamer has asked you to feed your egg some Pet Candy until it reaches 99.99% EXP. Once you've done that, return to him and he will hatch it for you!
dialogsBegin: Nice egg, stranger. I'm sure you're wondering what kind of pet you'll get from it. Well, don't get too far ahead of yourself now. I can't guarantee you're going to be able to hatch it.
However, if you really take care of the egg there shouldn't be a problem. All you need to do is get the egg's experience (EXP) to 99.99% and then bring it back to me. Think you can do that?
dialogsAccept: Sounds good! Alright, listen. In order to bring your egg's experience to full, you're going to need to feed it while it's summoned. Find yourself some Pet Candy (F) and get started!
dialogsDecline: Well that's a shame. I can't say I'm surprised, though. From the looks of you, you probably couldn't even keep a cactus alive.
dialogsComplete: Great job with the egg, stranger! Tell you what, I'll take over from here. It's hatching time!
dialogsFail: You're going to need to get your egg's experience to 99.99% in order for me to hatch it for you. Feel free to stop by again once you've done this!

5028.name: Find Red Bang Thieves
5028.description: Find the thieves west of the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris and return with evidence.
dialogsBegin: Help! Help me! My cash box... My money... It's all gone! Someone stole my cash box! Iblis watch over me!
I was saving money in my cash box in order to buy a present for my girlfriend, but it disappeared this morning.
So I have asked people, and they said that there are unknown thieves just west of the Fountain of Dead Person these days. I'm not sure I believe them though…
Can you investigate and let me know?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Please bring me the evidence which proves they really exist. If you find them, that is.
dialogsDecline: You only care about yourself. Fine, I'll find someone else.
dialogsComplete: So they really do exist!
dialogsFail: I think this is good evidence, but... I want something more conclusive!

5032.name: Acrobat Weaponry
5032.description: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Peakyrinds and 1 Slain then deliver them to Acrobat Master Pyre near the Darken City Quest Office.
dialogsBegin: Now it's time for the next step on your path to becoming an Acrobat.
I want you to return to collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Peakyrinds from Peakyturtles and 1 Slain from Lawolf.
Once you've gathered the Twinkle Stones, bring them to Pyre in the north of Flarine.
dialogsAccept: Good luck! You're going to need it!
dialogsDecline: You must like being a Vagrant. It would certainly be a shame if you quit now. I'll be here if you have a change of heart.
dialogsComplete: Thank you for the Twinkle Stones, Apprentice. I will cover Acrobat weaponry with you now. Acrobats are able to wield both Bows and Yo-Yos.
Bows are long range weapons that consume arrows for each shot. The strength of the basic shot is determined by how long you wait before releasing the arrow.
Yo-Yos are also long range weapons. However, the strength of the basic attack only changes depending on special skills used in conjunction with them.
dialogsFail: If you met with Hent, then you should probably have something for me, hmm?

5082.name: The bottom of the mine
5082.description: Collect 30 Blood Trillipy Shells from the Bloody Trillipy and kill 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers.
dialogsBegin: Hello, if you're here it's because you've defeated all the known monsters in the mine. I'm Dekane, the creator of this mine. Now that you've proven yourself, I'll be able to tell you the real problem that lies at the bottom of the mine. In a secret room sleep dragons from ancient times created by Shade ages ago.
