To defeat them, you'll need a well-armed team. Ah, but there's one detail I forgot to mention. You'll need 1,000,000 Penya to open the door, but for now, collecting 30 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeating 3 Mutant Keakoon Workers will be enough. Are you ready to accept this challenge?
dialogsAccept: Good luck!
dialogsDecline: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.
dialogsComplete: So you really did kill them all... Thank you very much.
dialogsFail: It is true that this is not an easy thing for an adventurer. Come and try your luck again when you are ready.

5133.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
5133.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

5161.name: Internal War of Red Bang Troupe
5161.description: Travel to the Erons Factory in Darkon 1 and search for evidence of Red Bang Troupe activity.
dialogsBegin: Listen, I've been talking to some townsfolk…
After Lord Bang died, I have heard various rumors about the Red Bang Troupe that lead me to believe they are still around.
I can't ignore these rumors. If there is any chance that the Red bang Troup is still in existence, we need to take care of it immediately.
Will you help an old friend once again?
dialogsAccept: Thank you, friend. There are reports of Red Bang Troupe activity near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1. I need you to investigate!
dialogsDecline: I can't ignore these rumors. Please help me!
dialogsComplete: Then it's true. It's worse than I thought. Thank you for bringing me this information.
dialogsFail: You didn't find anything? These rumors are unsubstantiated, but I believe them to be true.

5180.name: Witch in the Tower (2)
5180.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the third floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the third floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

5244.name: A Mother's Fury
dialogsBegin: What? You came here to find me? You must have me confused with someone else. I'm not a lost child, I'm a mighty warrior!!!
Ok, so maybe I did get just a little lost. WHAT!? My mom already reported me missing!? Oh am I in trouble. Mom is gonna take my upgraded wooden sword!!!
Hey... um... YOU!! I need a favor. Please go and tell my mom I'm at a friend's house and will be home for dinner! If not, I am going to throw such a tantrum.
dialogsAccept: Hehe, I knew you would accept my request. Please tell my mom everything is fine. Don't worry about me, I will go back soon enough!
dialogsDecline: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!
dialogsComplete: What? At a friend's house? Oh that Nerco is such a little lying !@#!&@ When he comes back, I will kick his ~!#@$!#&#!@#!...
dialogsFail: No! No! I won't go! I won't go! I won't go! You can't make me!

5260.name: Existence which Desire Summoned
5260.description: Visit Dr. Est near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin: So you're interested in challenging Clockworks, huh? What are you, nuts?!
Okay...if you insist. However before I help you, I need to make sure you aren't just going to walk in there and fall over dead. I need to make sure you're worthy. Okay?
dialogsAccept: Great! Please visit Dr. Est. He is studying the ecology of Darkon, in the nearby Gouthan Mountains of Darkon1.
dialogsDecline: Backing out already? Hahaha! I knew you were all talk…
dialogsComplete: Oh, did the Mayor of Darkon send you? You must be the one he was talking about that's crazy enough to challenge Clockworks. Here, you'll need this book.
It contains information about how Clockworks appeared here in Madrigal. It's a good read, but not for the faint of heart.
dialogsFail: Clockworks is one of the most dangerous monsters in Madrigal! He's huge! I have been studying him for 4 years now, but I still don't know everything about him.

5272.name: Keakoon in Mine (3)
5272.description: Bring the seal of the chief and the package that Drian is holding back to Nevil.
5272.descriptionComplete: You rescued Nevil, chief of the Keakoon. You can feel the secrets around this place. Maybe you can get some information from Bernard.
dialogsBegin: Many thanks, friend. You have done so much for us but would you do something more?
dialogsAccept: Please defeat the Elite Keakoon Guard Leader and bring me the Chief Sign that proves I am the one true Chief of the Keakoon. Would you also please bring me the cargo my son Drian is keeping safe for me?
dialogsDecline: What kind of person are you if you refuse to help those with less power than you?
dialogsComplete: Thank you. It is my great hope that Keakoon and human can thrive together once again. Take this ring as a gift.
If, by any chance, you want more adventure visit Bernard in Darken. Be careful. I would hate for something to happen to you.
dialogsFail: Hrmm… It might not be that dangerous for someone as strong as you.

5283.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
5283.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

5351.name: The Dungeon Code
dialogsBegin: Well fine fine! Guess I did finish eating now. Anyway! I saw this particular woman entering the Dekane Dungeon by herself. By the look of her outfit, she may have been a Psykeeper or something.
Oh! You want to go in after her? Unfortunately, you can't just enter like that. You have to know how exactly!
If you want to learn how to enter the dungeon, you will need the key code from Cell back at the Erons Factory. He will tell you how to do it!
dialogsAccept: Cell is at the Erons Factory, go ask him how to enter the dungeon.
dialogsDecline: Well, there is no other way to get in! Don't look at me! It's not like I know anything!
dialogsComplete: Ah… I remember you from before... Why do you come to see me? Dekanes dungeon? Why would you want to enter that cursed mine?
dialogsFail: Did you meet Cell at Erons Factory?

5379.name: Bridge to Terror-bithia
5379.description: Get rid of the Lord Demian and return to Reonan.
dialogsBegin: But, let us not be too hasty as arrogance may lead to an early grave. Though vicious, slaying a few lawolves is just the beginning…
Here is your next task. Rumors have it, numerous villagers have been attacked by a monstrous Lord Demian just outside of Flaris. Please defeat him and return to me
dialogsAccept: The Lord Demian has been seen wandering nearby the Madren Town recently so search for him there.
dialogsDecline: What? I know I ask much of you, but I never thought you would turn down a chance to prove your worth.
dialogsComplete: Finally, the villagers may rest assured that the Lord Demian shall no longer terrorize them. You have much potential.
dialogsFail: The Lord Demian can be found nearby Madren Town amongst the other Demians.

5385.name: Welcome to Madrigal!
5385.description: Visit Boboko of the Armor Shop to receive a gift.
dialogsBegin: Welcome, traveler! By the look of you, I'd say you're getting ready for an adventure, am I right? Well then you've come to the right place!
There are plenty of dangerous monsters out there to battle, and my shop will help you get prepared for the fight!
You'll be seeing me a lot later on, I'm sure, but for now why don't you pay our local smith Boboko a visit?
Boboko owns the Armor Shop near here, and I think he might have something special for you.
dialogsAccept: Boboko's right nearby, you can't miss him with all the hammering! Oh, and welcome to Madrigal!
dialogsDecline: Packing it in so soon? But the day's just started! You have so much to do!
dialogsComplete: Howdy! Lui told me you'd be coming! Here, this should help you get started. Next time you come by, we'll get you underway on your Vagrant training.

5394.name: Raising Pets 7 (A Tier -> S Tier)
5394.description: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
dialogsBegin: I can see that you and your pet have been through a great deal together. You're almost there!
I'll upgrade your pet to *S level* using magic handed down through my family. All you have to do is get the experience of your pet to 99.99%. You've done it before, will you do it the one last time?
dialogsAccept: I knew you would. It looks like both you and your pet are ready to begin.
dialogsDecline: Does this mean you are giving up on your pet?
dialogsComplete: Congratulations! As long as you have your pet, you will never be alone. Your pet seems to be very happy, you've done a great job. Now allow me to apply the final upgrade!
dialogsFail: You are so close to getting your pet to its ultimate level. Do not give up now.

5414.name: Legendary Redmantis (Part 3)
5414.description: The Emerald Mantis is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Defeat her, retrieve the Emerald Mantis Egg, then return to Rudvihil.
dialogsBegin: Well, I have good news and bad news. The bad news is, the Redyspawn is not that valuable. The good news, is that I believe I know what Rudvihil is searching for.
It's Emeraldispawn. It is extremely difficult to acquire, as you can only get it once a year.
In addition, it's mother is rather… protective of her eggs. However, we're in luck! It's breeding season!
Now is our chance! Will you retrieve this egg for Rudvihil?
dialogsAccept: I knew you would! The mother, Emerald Mantis, is located somewhere near the Central Hillid Mountains. Find and defeat her, then retrieve the egg!
dialogsDecline: What? Why? We're so close to uncovering a precious artifact? Rudvihil will be disappointed.
dialogsComplete: Do you have it? Let me see it! Oh my… it is everything I dreamed it would be. Thank you very much, stranger! My collection is getting better and better!
Here's a little something for you. Call it a tip! Thanks again!
dialogsFail: Do you have it? No? Then get back to work!

5459.name: Magic Orb
5459.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Martin needs Hammarble to make a Magic Orb. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

5474.name: New Puppy Yorrn
5474.description: Travel to the middle of Leren Mountains, near the Grownup Lawolfs. Find Losha's lost puppy, and return to Loyah.
dialogsBegin: Excuse me, can I talk to you for a moment?
The pretty lady beside me is Losha, my elder sister. I am her younger sister, Loyah.
My sister has a very cute puppy, but unfortunately, he's gone missing! She originally found the puppy up in the mountains.
When she first saw the puppy, it was cold and starving. So she brought it home and took care of it, but suddenly it disappeared one day.
Since then, my sister has been looking everywhere for the puppy. She doesn't eat or drink or sleep. Would you please help my sister find her lost puppy?
dialogsAccept: Great! She found the puppy somewhere in the middle of Leren Mountains where the Grownup Lawolfs live. Maybe the puppy is trying to find it's way home?
dialogsDecline: How could you refuse the request from a lady? You have no social manners! Have you no shame?!
dialogsComplete: Yorrn! Where did you find him? In the mountains!? I knew it! He was probably trying to find his way home! Welcome back, Yorrn!
dialogsFail: Have you found Yorrn? No? Well, please keep looking! I'm worried about my sister!

5510.name: Revelation
5510.description: Return to Reonan with the results of Handel's research.
dialogsBegin: Why am I looking so distraught after analyzing the text you ask? Well… I guess the results are not what I would have wanted…
The records indicate that despite the efforts made by the 8 heroes to expunge any trace of Shade's existence, her essence still persists throughout this world.
When the time is right, she will regain her physical form and return anew to command her masquerpet army. It is her intention to reclaim the known world as her own…
You must go and talk to Reonan as soon as possible. We no longer have time to waste. Please find him!
dialogsAccept: Reonan still hasn't explained to you the exact nature of the 8 heroes has he? I feel you are ready to know the truth and the role you play in this all…
dialogsDecline: I'm sorry if you feel uncertain about this all. Take some time to think it over…
dialogsComplete: Greetings again! Ohhh…so this is what Handel has brought to light.
dialogsFail: Please hurry back to Reonan. I'm sure he will explain everything!

5540.name: Find the Portrait of Radion
5540.description: Visit Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and expensive items in the Saint City Square.
dialogsBegin: Hey! You there! I don't know what to do. My drawing... My best drawing has disappeared!
My hobby is collecting rare and expensive artwork. This morning I redecorating my house and I realized my most prized drawing was gone!
It is the portrait of the wise man, Radion. There are a number of suspects and I have no idea where to begin. What should I do?
Wait a minute… I have an idea. Will you do me a favor?
dialogsAccept: You will?! Thank you! I need you to speak with Helgar in Saint City. He is a connoisseur of rare and precious items. Perhaps he knows something.
dialogsDecline: No, please! You must help me! I don't know what else to do!
dialogsComplete: What? The portrait disappeared? Hmm... I knew this was going to happen.
Rudvihil has a taste for rare and expensive things. He's also very greedy, and lacks values.
If he truly has lost it, I'll do what I can to help.
dialogsFail: Do you have something that needs my appraisal? Let me see.

5551.name: A Brighter, Cleaner Darkon!
5551.description: Go meet Elaine and let him know of the result of his resignation.
dialogsBegin: We have went ahead and processed Elaine's resignation. Go and tell him about it.
dialogsAccept: Let him know not to worry about us. We understand that whatever it is he is up to must be of the utmost importance.
dialogsDecline: Please let him know at some point at least!
dialogsComplete: What happened?
dialogsFail: We have processed Elaine's resignation. Please go see him now.

5578.name: Bring Ribenuum
5578.description: Gather 30 pieces of Ribenuum from Green Trillipy
dialogsBegin: I am here in Dekane mining for Ribenuum. In all of Madrigal Ribenuum can only be found in the Darkon area.
Ribenuum is made when a Green Trillipy eats a stone and metabolizes it.
Would you bring me some Ribenuum? A Green Tillipy is dangerous but you look equally as dangerous.
dialogsAccept: Green Trillipy are down the hall to the right. The room to the left is blocked.
dialogsDecline: Are you kidding me? Go on and get out of here, I may not look it but I am an old Dwarpet and I do not have time for games.
dialogsComplete: Ahhh...you brought the Ribenuum. But what is this? It is flawed!
dialogsFail: How hard is it to bring me what I asked for? 30 pieces of Ribenuum?

5585.name: Endless Loop
5585.description: Acquire an Ancient Inscription from one of the Tombstone Bearers.
dialogsBegin: While conducting my research, I found something of interest about the pillars carried by the Tombstone Bearers. It looks similar to those of Shade's temple.
Upon looking further into the information, I found that Tombstone Bearers were actually slaves of Shade that built her temple. But why would they be here in the Garden of Rhisis?
I need to acquire more data! Would you help me further by acquiring an Ancient Inscription? This might provide the insight I'm looking for!
dialogsAccept: I knew you would have accepted. You too yearn to discover the truth! You can find a Ancient Inscription by defeating any of the Tombstone Bearers
dialogsDecline: How could you decline? This could potentially reveal so much to us about Shade's masquerpets and their growing strength!
dialogsComplete: You got it!! Please hand it over quickly for me to analyze!
dialogsFail: Even if you don't initially receive an Ancient Inscription, keep defeating them! I'm sure one of these Tombstone Bearers is bound to have the Ancient Inscription!

5590.name: United We Stand
5590.description: Take Elaine and Zoro's Pendants to Reonan
dialogsBegin: Hah! I never thought Elaine would change his mind so easily. This pendant here, well, it definitely shows that he means business!
I'm glad to see that the old Elaine has returned! Here, take my pendant as well! Now take them to Reonan and let him know we are ready to stand united!
dialogsAccept: Head back to Reonan with the pendants!
dialogsDecline: Well, whatever you wish, but I don't think we have much time to mess around!
dialogsComplete: Oh! I see you have returned! You come bearing good news I hope?
dialogsFail: You have both of the pendants, now go see Reonan!

5600.name: Squash the Sasquatch!
5600.description: Please defeat 70 Yetti and 55 Mutant Yetti and return to me as soon as you're finished.
dialogsBegin: We meet again, traveler. We need more help. Rumor has it that the Yetti are becoming more aggressive towards humans. We can't allow this to continue happening.
Will you lend me a hand once more, traveler?
dialogsAccept: Please defeat 70 Yetti and 55 Mutant Yetti and return to me as soon as you're finished.
dialogsDecline: Come back when you think you are ready.
dialogsComplete: It appears your efforts were a success. Thank you.
dialogsFail: Not enough monsters have been defeated, unfortunately. You must go back and fight.

5625.name: Reclaiming the Pendant
5625.description: Defeat the Chimeradon and show Capafe the pendant.
dialogsBegin: Ahh the Pendant. When Sury left it to me a long time ago, I kept it in a barren desert, untraversed by man.
Unfortunately at some point, Chimeradons came to discover it and took it for their own. Since then, I have been unable to locate it…
Could you please find the pendant for me?
dialogsAccept: Thank you for your assistance. I feel that the pendant is currently being held by a Chimeradon. Please reclaim it from him then show me so I may rest assured it is returned.
dialogsDecline: Please find the pendant. I feel it is partly my responsibility for the pendants disappearance…
dialogsComplete: You have returned. I hope you have succeeded in acquiring the pendant.
dialogsFail: The pendant is currently held by a Chimeradon. Go and retrieve it from his undeserving hands!

5630.name: Keakoon in Mine (2)
5630.descriptionComplete: You have saved Nevil. Go and talk to him.
dialogsBegin: I still have a need for you. Would you help me yet again?
dialogsAccept: You are a true friend. Take this key and free my father. I am not strong enough. Please.
dialogsDecline: You show yourself to be no better than the fiends that imprisoned my father.
dialogsFail: My father is in a prison on the outskirts of Keakoon village. Please hurry he cannot last much longer.

5646.name: Disguise of Remina
5646.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Remina needs you to collect repygle to make a pair of disguising sunglasses. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

5672.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
5672.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

5674.name: Billposter Hero's Pendant
5674.description: Bring the Heroes Pendant to Reonan
dialogsBegin: We have very little time. Even as we speak, I can sense the growing darkness around us…
dialogsAccept: Will you bring my pendant to Reonan? Please let him know that the time is now for us to unite.
dialogsDecline: Now that you have the pendant, hurry and give it to Reonan!
dialogsComplete: Ahh this is Sury's pendant! The time has once again come that we rise to the challenge before us! With allies like you by our side, we will be prepared for challenges Shade presents us with!
dialogsFail: Please take this pendant to Reonan!

5693.name: Keakoon in Mine (1)
5693.description: Hunt Keakoon and get all 3 pieces of the prison key.
5693.descriptionComplete: You have delivered all the pieces of the key but it looks like he still has something to say.
dialogsBegin: I am Drian son of Nevil, great chief of the original Keakoon. We were once friendly with the humans.
We helped humans develop the mine long ago but when they left some of us were locked up by a new breed of Keakoons.
My father is old and cannot last much longer in his prison. Please help me rescue him.
dialogsAccept: The key to the cell where my father is being kept has three pieces. These false Keakoons are inside, keeping them hidden. Go and bring them to me.
dialogsDecline: How could you? To think I thought to count you as a friend.
dialogsComplete: Oh… Thank you… so much. I could never repay you fully. Thank you so much.
dialogsFail: You have to gather all three pieces of the Key.

5707.name: Weak Heart
5707.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Helena needs clock hearts to make a new heart for her sick brother. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

5713.name: Successor of Hero -Feather-
5713.description: Locate the Feather of Magic Power and present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that the master recognizes your potential. Do not lose this document.
For your next assignment, I'll need you to get the Feather of Magic Power which is located somewhere in Magmient, in Darkon 3.
Once you've located the feather, present it to Cuzrill, the Elementor Wiseman near the Fountain of Dead person in Flaris.
dialogsAccept: I pray the mercy of Lillip will always be with you.
dialogsDecline: Don't underestimate yourself, Magician. The path is meant to be difficult. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: An, yes. The Feather of Magic power! It is said that this was crafted by Lillip and made from the feather of a Luia. It can double your magic power.
I sure know a lot about it, don't I? Hahaha! Thank you for finding this, Magician.
dialogsFail: I am just as clever as the Elementor Priest! Maybe I'm even more clever than her! I am surrounded by jealous people!

5792.name: Trouble-Maker in Pumpkin Village
5792.description: Travel to Pumpkin Town and search for Mayun, JeongHwa's son.
dialogsBegin: Hey there, I have a problem. Can you help me?
Actually I have 2 kids, one daughter and one son. My daughter has gone missing!
This was several years ago with some other missing children... So, my son is the only child I have left. However today... Today he disappeared too!
Both of my kids are now missing. I feel like I can't go on living. Please, will you help me find my son?
dialogsAccept: You're amazing! My son used to love the Pumpkin Patch. You should start your search there.
dialogsDecline: If you will not help me, then I have no other choice…
dialogsComplete: Hey, who are you? What? My mom is worried about me? What else is new…? Ugh, fine. I'll go back and let her know I'm okay.
dialogsFail: I am just watching those pumpkin heads. Aren't they cool? I wish I had one!

5793.name: Identity of Red Bang Troupe
5793.description: Defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red Bang Troupe Leader, and retrieve 7 Symbols of the Red bang Troupe.
dialogsBegin: I will never forgive them for what they have done. I'm literally fuming with anger right now!
Now that their leader has been defeated, I think this is a good opportunity to hit them where it hurts and end this once and for all!
I have a plan, but I will need your help again, my friend. Are you up to it?
dialogsAccept: I knew you would do it! Travel back to their camp, and defeat 5 Red Bang Troupe Members, 1 Red bang Troupe Leader, and bring me 7 of their symbols.
dialogsDecline: Will you not help me finally rid our town of this nuisance? Speak with me again if you have a change of heart.
dialogsComplete: Very good! Excellent work! They're probably tucking their tails between their legs now! Muahaha!
dialogsFail: Have you defeated them all yet? Do you have any symbols? No? Then you better get going!

5797.name: Beautiful Keil Wallpaper
5797.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Haven needs you to collect Sycale to re-model the Magic Shop. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

5809.name: Spark in the Dark
dialogsBegin: Something still bothers me... why are these storms happening at all? Maybe the Chairman of the History Society, Gothante, might know.
dialogsAccept: Seek out a forum with Gothante, and figure out what is going on with the weather.
dialogsDecline: Well... at least the airships are safe for now. I wonder why all the bad weather, though?
dialogsComplete: The storms lately have raged on for far too long! I have a feeling I know what has caused these storms.
dialogsFail: Find Gothante and see if he knows what is happening with the weather.

5813.name: Laws of Aviation (5)
dialogsBegin: Oh, back already? That was fast! You sure made quick work of those Mothbees.
Here, take this letter. Please deliver it to Dior in Flarine. It's a Letter of Recommendation. Once she reads it I'm sure she'll give you a reward! Hehe~
dialogsAccept: Have a safe journey back to Flaris. See you again soon! Tell my sweetie Dior I said hi!
dialogsDecline: There's no rush. Just talk to me again when you are ready.
dialogsComplete: Welcome back traveler. What's this? A letter of recommendation? Let's see... *mumble mumble* ...wow! Passed with flying colors I see! Well done!

5828.name: Troupe Leader, Lord Bang
5828.description: Travel to Darkon 2 and defeat Lord Bang. He was last seen somewhere near the Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsBegin: This… this symbol… it is very intriguing. If I'm right, the real leader of the Red bang Troupe is not the one you defeated.
This symbol has been found in Darkon 2 as well. Could the real leader of the Red Bang Troupe be hiding there?
We must find out. The leader must be defeated or this will never end.
I've just received information from one of my colleagues in Darkon 2. I believe we've identified him. Will you help me once again, my friend?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! The information I gathered is that his name is Lord Bang. He was last seen near the Gouthan Mountains in Darkon 2.
dialogsDecline: We are so close to putting an end to this nuisance for good! Please, help us!
dialogsComplete: You defeated Lord Bang? Thank goodness! Now we can live without fear of his retaliation. Thank you so much, my friend.
dialogsFail: You must hurry! He has to be defeated before he retaliates! Go to Darkon 2 and find him now!

5829.name: Journal of an Adventurer (2)
5829.description: Find the Sage Radion to decode the writing in the Diary.
dialogsBegin: You should hear this. This is the diary of the adventurer Bartholomew Hunt. My grand father knew of him, he was a legend at one time…
HA! Look at this… he is claiming that he discovered a new continent. New continent? How absurd!
I can't read the writing here, it appears to be a code of some sort. Maybe the Sage Radion can figure out what this writing is. Please bring him the diary.
dialogsAccept: Sage Radion is is in the Northern Leren Mountains, near the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsDecline: You are to busy? If this information is accurate do you know what this could mean?
dialogsComplete: What brings you to see me?
If the Mayor of Darkon sent you, it must be important. Let me see the Diary.
dialogsFail: It is very important, so you'd better hurry!

5846.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
5846.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

5848.name: 10 Year anniversary gift
5848.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Marche wants you to collect Starstones to make a 10 year anniversary gift. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

5855.name: Fresh Start for Mop
5855.description: House of Children wants you to collect 3 Mop.
5855.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: House of Children needs you to collect Mop for their children. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.

5857.name: Phantom of Fear
5857.description: Investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Once inside, investigate the masquerpets you find.
dialogsBegin: I cannot be sure by only investigating the entrance. I need more detailed information…
(Looks at you imploringly) Would you please, please bring me more detailed information?
I wouldn't ask if it weren't very, very important. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! This time, investigate the inside of the Mars Mine. Also, please investigate the masquerpets there.
dialogsDecline: It's not like I'm asking you for your first born child…
dialogsComplete: Oh no… We're doomed! What are we going to do!?
dialogsFail: I know it sounds dangerous, but you've got to be brave. This is very important.

5907.name: Carrierbomb Commotion
dialogsBegin: Well, here's to hoping! Hmm, Rankashu mentioned something about a strange woman. I wonder who it could be...
I'm trying to think who this strange woman could be!! In the meantime could you please go kill some Carrierbombs and then return to Rankashu!! I need more time to think!
Thank you thank you thank you!! Go kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs then return to Rankashu!
dialogsAccept: Oh how am I ever supposed to concentrate with these stupid Carrierbombs making a racket!!!
dialogsDecline: Eh? You're here again? Do you want to know about the woman?
dialogsComplete: Not yet? Kill the Carrierbombs quickly and go to Rankashu!
dialogsFail: Kill 20 Small Carrierbombs & 15 Carrierbombs and return to Rankashu.

5911.name: Mia, the Cursed Name
5911.description: Speak with Porgo and tell him the good news.
dialogsBegin: We made an inquiry group and started to review the case again. I can't believe something this horrific has happened in Saint City.
I suppose it's better late than never. Will you return to Porgo and let him know that we are investigating the case again? His cooperation is appreciated.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. I will do everything I can to make Saint City more beautiful and peaceful than it already is.
dialogsDecline: I tour the city every day, so I am extremely busy. Please tell him what I said.
dialogsComplete: Has the truth finally been revealed? It has?! I am so glad to hear that the case has been reopened.
Thank you so much for your help, young one. I couldn't have done all this alone. The girls thank you, as well.
dialogsFail: Have you spoken to the Mayor? Please hurry, this case needs to be reopened!

6001.name: Toy Materials
6001.description: You can collect them from the group of Popcrank in the Deadwallderness.
6001.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: A toy merchant requested you to collect Popshift for making fancy toys. Will you accept this request?
dialogsAccept: You can collect them from the group of Popcrank in the Deadwallderness.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

6025.name: Successor of Hero -Underwear-
6025.description: Deliver the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the Letter of Recommendation to Cuarine, the Psykeeper Wiseman at the Fountain of Dead Person near the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin: Here is your Letter of Recommendation. This shows that I have recognized your potential. Do not lose this document.
For your next assignment, I need you to retrieve the Magic Underwear of Power from Kynsy who is hiding somewhere near the Erons Factory in Darkon 1.
Deliver the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and the Letter of Recommendation to Cuarine, the Psykeeper Wiseman at the Fountain of Dead Person near the Northern Leren Mountains.
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, Magician!
dialogsDecline: Are you afraid to walk the path of the Psykeeper? Sure, it's not easy, but I think you have what it takes. Speak with me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Yes, you found them! Amazing! What…? Do I like girl's underwear? What a silly question!
Anyway, you did an excellent job acquiring these. I will continue your training immediately.
Well, I certainly look dashing in these! *snicker*
dialogsFail: Now, where did I put my underwear...

6052.name: Catalyst to the Curse
6052.description: Collect 10 Boo Petal, then bring them to Reodos
dialogsBegin: Ahh so the curse was not released yet? The curse WAS in his body a long time… We need a powerful catalyst to speed up the process. 10 Boo Petals should do the trick!
Another question? 8 Heroes huh? Well, I did see a strange looking woman enter this dungeon alone several days ago. Not sure if that will help or not!
Anyway! I told you what you need to know. Will you go get the petals now and let me eat in peace?
dialogsAccept: Yes Yes, acquire 10 Boo Petals from the Boos in the forests of Darkon 3. This should take care of your problem!
dialogsDecline: Ahh! Can't you see I'm trying to eat. Please don't disturb me right now!!
dialogsComplete: Aha! I knew Rankashu would spill the information for an easy meal. So these leaves will speed up the process you say?
dialogsFail: I am eating now. I said 10 Boo Petals!

6064.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
6064.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

6068.name: Breaking the Curse (3)
6068.description: Seek out Cell and ask him to grind the Steel Pieces.
dialogsBegin: Ahh~ turning Steel Pieces into Hard Steel Powder? Actually, I will unfortunately be unable to complete such a request, for my machinery currently is not operational.
The only other person I can think of with machinery powerful enough to grind the Steel Pieces to Powder would be cell at the Erons Factory. Seek him out and ask for his help!
dialogsAccept: I have little to no clue what you intend to do with the Hard Steel Powder, but I wish you luck!
dialogsDecline: Well! Back to work for me!
dialogsComplete: Har har har what do we have here? A new employee? You seem a little puny for a factory worker? Oh, nevermind!
dialogsFail: Yes, Cell is his name. You should be able to find him North of this location. Ask him to grind the Steel Pieces for you.

6088.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
6088.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

6090.name: Chapter 3 Purple Magician: Identity of the Purple Magician
6090.description: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsBegin: *cough* *cough* This bead, with all of its power, was crafted by the only pupil I ever had, Lapranche. *cough*
She is the Black Magician. I was also the Black Magician at one point. We have often been confused for each other throughout history. *Sigh* It seems that Lapranche found out about them.

You believe in them now right? If you are looking to me for answers about what they were, you are wasting your time. All I know is that they created all of Madrigal and that they were once agents of Rhisis.
Yes Lapranche found out about them and attempted to bring them back to this world with the Purple Magic, the same magic that drained me of so much.
Do me a favor would you?
dialogsAccept: Please deliver this book to Gothante. This may not be enough to save the world but it should be useful. Thank you and good luck.
dialogsDecline: You are afraid. I am not surprised. The world hangs in the balance. Who would not be scared? Go on. Get out of here.
dialogsComplete: What a terrible... Where did they come from? Did you see them? Renegade Blades seemingly hired to kill me. It would appear that I know too much. What is that you have there?
Oh, this! Is this the book that Laola wrote? Amazing
Fine. Now we can begin the real reconstruction of the history of our world. Thank you. Oh, I may need you later on. See you then.
dialogsFail: You could not find Loala? It is not like he is hiding or anything. Please try again.

6132.name: Refine Ribenuum
6132.description: Gather 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum
dialogsBegin: The Ribenuum you brought is impure. I could take it home and refine it myself but the other Dwarpets would laugh me back to Flarine.

It will have to be refined in a human village then. There is only one human I trust to do it it right. There is man named Nein, he was one of the last humans to work in these mines. Maybe the very last human.
Bring these Ribenuum to Nein and have him refine them. Then bring them back to me, would you?
dialogsAccept: I heard that Nein lives somewhere in the Dead Walderness. He will refine the 30 pieces of impure Ribenuum into 10 pieces of high quality Ribenuum.
dialogsDecline: Are you kidding me? Get lost! I do not have patience for games!
dialogsComplete: Oh… Thank you, thank you, thank you! Take this necklace and some money with you.
dialogsFail: Hmmm... maybe I was asking too much of you. You can just go home.

6191.name: Essence of the Gods (2)
6191.description: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, acquire the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.
dialogsBegin: According to my ancestors, this region was once a primary location for a massive conflict between Bubble and Shade. Lets put it this way, Madrigal was once all one continent before this war…

We must also acquire the Shade trace. It's rumored to be held by the Pranksters, the last remnants of the followers of Shade. As you can see, I'm a tad too short to confront them. Could you get it for me?
dialogsAccept: I appreciate the assistance. Please go Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters and acquire the Shade trace.
dialogsDecline: What? Expect a poor little Dwarpet such as myself to take on an army of Pranksters?
dialogsComplete: So according to Bowler, this was the site of the battle between Bubble and Shade? The essence of each that you contain is definitive proof of this.
dialogsFail: Kill 15 Small Mage Pranksters & 7 Pranksters, find the Shade Trace and bring it to Handel.

6196.name: ID Card (1)
6196.description: Chat with Bernard, then meet Andre in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: What? You want to know where the Violet Trillipy live? You seem so curious about this accursed mine. Unfortunately, there are not many people left who know much about it.
Only a few of the mine workers go that deep into the mine. I don't know much about them or the ID card they use to get down there. Oh! You should go speak with Bernard about this.
dialogsAccept: Would you please say Hi to Bernard for me?
dialogsDecline: No, you are right. You should not be the next one to suffer.
dialogsComplete: Violet Trillipy… Do you mean you are going in there with them?
dialogsFail: Why not just relax and give it up?

6203.name: Obsessed with Crystals! (2)
6203.description: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Yetti.
6203.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Crystals! Hmmm.... $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s! Could you please bring me some $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$!?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Yetti.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: You did it! Hooray! Here's your reward. Come back soon!
dialogsFail: More! More!

6219.name: Peculiar Creature
dialogsBegin: Normally I'd be skeptical of such a claim, but I do recall coming across quite a peculiar sight…
While out traveling, I came across a creature most bizarre not too far East of Darken City.
It looked like an animal, yet it seemed to be talking. It seems quite peculiar and might warrant an investigation. I'm not sure if this will actually help you or not…
Please go investigate the nature of this matter. Maybe this creature might know something as well?
dialogsAccept: I saw the creature near the Steel Knights, which reside in the Erons Factories. Go look for it there!
dialogsDecline: What? You don't believe me? Not like your story is any more believable!
dialogsComplete: Hi! My name is Reodos...Oh come on! It's not like you are all that normal looking either!
dialogsFail: A truly mysterious creature indeed… You can find it in the Erons Factories, near the Steel Knights.

6259.name: Successor of Hero - Guardian
6259.description: Defeat the Venel Guardian, and deliver the Mark of the Hero and the Venel heart to the Jester Guardian, Heingard, in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin: Great job, Acrobat. For the final leg of your journey, you must confront the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
The will of the heroes is preserved in the Room of the Guardian in Guardiane. This is where you will find the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ is a soul that protects the will of the heroes. Defeat him, and obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
Take this. It is a Mark of the Hero. Once you have confronted the Venel Guardian and retrieved the Venel Heart, bring both of these to the Jester Guardian, Heingard.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck, Acrobat.
dialogsDecline: This is the final test to becoming a successor of the Jester Hero. You can't give up now. Speak with me again when you are ready to continue.
dialogsComplete: Congratulations, young Acrobat. I've heard many great things about you. You've completed the final test. You will now become a Successor of the Jester Hero!
Wise Curenen! This Acrobat wishes to follow your path! Grant them your blessing and courage, Jester Hero!
dialogsFail: You have not completed the tasks given to you by the Jester Priest. Return to me when you have done so.

6286.name: Door of Dark
dialogsBegin: Excuse me. If you are not busy, would you please listen to my story? Have you ever heard of the Iblis Temple?
The Iblis Temple was built by the followers of Iblis, a leader from before the first age of Madrigal.
The temple is located in the Fantasy Desert, in the southern part of Saint Morning.
You see... every mayor has to explore all the Islands of Madrigal. In the course of these travels we have to visit the Iblis Temple but... I am so afraid.
Would you please help me? I beg of you.
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Please, investigate the entrance of the temple for anything dangerous. Would you?
dialogsDecline: I cannot force you to help me if you are busy. But maybe, when you have the time, you could come back and help me.
dialogsComplete: Thank you, you did a great job.
dialogsFail: It is very easy to find the entrance of the temple in Fantasy Desert.

6322.name: Delicious Sauce
6322.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Kalin needs you to collect Cardrin to make delicious sauce.
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of Red Mantis.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

6331.name: Prehistoric Birds
6331.description: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
6331.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for Gorrudas to be exterminated. They are an imminent threat! Please could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Gorrudas flying West of the Deadwallderness, over the mountains.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

6397.name: Bloody corridor
6397.description: Collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$ loot from the Bloody Trilipy and kill $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsBegin: Well... Not a bad deal... Can you collect 20 Blood Trillipy Shells and defeat a Mutant Keakoon Worker?
dialogsAccept: In that case...Hic, good luck.
dialogsDecline: Hmm... the Hazardous Blood Trillipys are much stronger...
dialogsComplete: Thanks to you the extraction in this area will be much easier!
dialogsFail: Hmm... Despite your level the Hazardous Blood Trillipys are much stronger...

6418.name: Temple of the Clown
6418.description: There is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the Iblis Temple. Bring a rubbed copy of it.
dialogsBegin: Oh... Back so soon? I am glad you are back but I am still so worried.
I guess I am still worrying about the Iblis Temple. I know you said that there is nothing to worry about but I still have a bad feeling about that place.
Would you please help me once more? I will not be able to rest until I know for sure…
dialogsAccept: I heard that there is a copy of the Iblis Revelation in the temple. Please bring me a rubbed copy of it, I need to see what it says.
dialogsDecline: ...but I... I... need your help…
dialogsComplete: This… this is more shocking than I could have imagined. Bubble please protect us.
dialogsFail: If you can defeat the Iblis Guardian you can enter the altar.

6421.name: Repair Work on Saint Hall
6421.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Helena needs you to collect Crescent Stones to repair Saint Hall. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

6429.name: Evidence of the Portrait 1
6429.description: The High-Dwarpets live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris. Please go there and meet with them.
dialogsBegin: I don't even like speaking of Rudvihil. He is disrespectful and his actions go against everything I stand for. You need to visit the High-Dwarpets in Flaris.
Oh, you've heard of them, then? Well, they may be able to help us. I've heard they have strange powers that may help us find the missing portrait.
Those High-Dwarpets collect ancient books and other rare treasures. How is it they can collect these things more easily than others?
The answer? They are clairvoyant. This allows them to see and hear things that you and I cannot comprehend. I am certain they would be able to help.
Will you meet with them?
dialogsAccept: Excellent. You know where they live, right? They live in the middle of the Leren Mountains in Flaris.
dialogsDecline: If you don't wish to help recover what is arguably one of the most valuable pieces of art in Madrigal, then that is your business. It's a shame.
dialogsComplete: A missing portrait you say? Of Radion? Yes, I have heard of it. I will do what I can to help. Please allow me to focus my thoughts for a moment. Hmmmm….
I think I've found it. Yes, this has to be the one. Here, let me draw you a picture…
I drew the face of the thieves who stole the portrait. This is all I can do for you.
dialogsFail: Now please go away. I can only stand humans for so long…

6436.name: Dwarpet Festival
6436.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: The Dwarpet needs you to collect wheeshoes for their festival. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

6448.name: The Flower that Time Forgot
6448.description: Collect a Time Lapse Flower which only blooms near the entrance to Mars Mine.
dialogsBegin: I almost have all the ingredients! The piece de resistance is a mysterious ingredient known as the Time Lapse Flower.
Time Lapse Flowers can be found only around Mars Mine dungeon entrance. The entrance is located at the most Northern part of the Flaris continent.
dialogsAccept: Awesome! No worries! You don't have to enter the dungeon per se. The flower should simply be near it!
dialogsDecline: Haha, nice joke. You are quite the kidder you know that!
dialogsComplete: Finally! Finally! Finally! Please hand it over quickly so I can make the potion!
dialogsFail: The Time Lapse Flower should be found near the entrance to Mars Mine. Please go collect it!

6450.name: The Pendant of Reodos
6450.description: Deliver the pendant from Reodos to Reonan.
dialogsBegin: Ahh, so I guess I should express my gratitude to you! The potion will take a little time to mix so I guess I will hang out here a little longer.
While the potion mixes, here, take this. This is a pendant to symbolize my unwavering participation in whatever is to come. Please take it to Reonan and let him know we will meet soon enough!
dialogsAccept: Good! Then go to Reonan. I will soon recover my original body and meet up with the rest of the original crew!
dialogsDecline: Err… well in that case you must have some more urgent matters to attend to? Please take the pendant to Reonan soon.
dialogsComplete: There you are! Unfortunately, I'm glad to see you but unable to talk at the moment. Take this time to reach level 60 then return to me.
dialogsFail: Hurry quickly back to Reonan with the pendant!

6460.name: A Hero Emerges!
dialogsBegin: Know that I, as well as the citizens of Flaris, are forever in your debt. If you are ever in need of assistance, do not hesitate to ask!
Carry on now young adventurer! I can tell you will accomplish great things. Oh, I believe Reonan was looking for you as well. Won't you speak with him?
dialogsAccept: Before you leave, please tell Reonan thanks for bringing you to my attention. He, as well, has my gratitude.
dialogsDecline: Well, I don't mind if you stay here. Who knows, perhaps you might even be the Mayor of Flarine one day! Haha!
dialogsComplete: A safe return I see? You no doubt have completed the mayor's request. Oh and his gratitude? Can't say I've ever trusted the word of a politician, but I will take it! Hah!
dialogsFail: Reonan is looking for you.

6519.name: Successor of Hero - Scroll
6519.description: Take the Letter of Hynan to High-Dwarpet Liekyen in Darken.
dialogsBegin: Many thanks for bringing me the Letter of Hynan! I would like you to deliver it to High-Dwarpet Liekyen.
High-Dwarpet Liekyen can be found near the northwestern edge of town in Darken.
dialogsAccept: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsDecline: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Hello, I am Liekyen. A former steward of the Hynan family. I now administer the keepsakes of the Hynan family. What have you got there?
The Letter of Hynan?! This was the last lost keepsake of the Hynan family. How did you… no matter. The important thing is that it has been returned. I have been looking for this for a very long time.
Now all of the keepsakes of the Hynan family are accounted for. Here, take this. This scroll will prove that you are ready to become a successor of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsFail: I'm waiting for someone to deliver a letter to me. Do you have it? No? Then our business is concluded.

6552.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
6552.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

6632.name: Duty of Mercenary
6632.description: Slay Babari and speak with Mercenary Instructor Hyuit in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: So... are you starting to understand how a Mercenary works now? Don't lose that Label of Technique I gave you!
Now for your next test! There is a creature named Babari just south of Flarine terrorizing the citizens there. Slay him, and seek out Hyuit, the Mercenary Instructor in Eastern Flarine.
Be careful, I hear Babari packs quite a punch!
dialogsAccept: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsDecline: You can't give up now, Vagrant! You've come so far already!
dialogsComplete: The citizens of Flarine are in your debt, Vagrant! Now the children of Flarine can play outside without having to worry about being eaten by that big bully!
Mercenaries are experts at close combat. We have the ability to stop an enemy's movement in order to close distance and keep them in range. This ability is called, Sneaker.
Our main strength is in one on one combat. If we can get within range of an enemy, you can bet they are going to feel it the next day! Welcome to the fold, Mercenary!
dialogsFail: May I help you? I'm waiting for a pupil to take care of a little problem for me. I'm guessing that's not you? Then we have nothing further to discuss.

6656.name: A Vagrant's First Steps (1)
6656.description: Luda at the Shield Shop will give me 2,500 Penya when I hunt 15 Small Aibatts and return to him.
dialogsBegin: Hello! I am Losha and I run the Food Shop. I sell food that is helpful for when you lose your Health Points (HP). Each type of food has a different recovery power and level requirement.
You can eat the food by double-clicking it in your inventory. Also, you can add them to your hot keys. Please remember that once you eat food, you cannot eat again for a certain amount of time.
Now that the lesson is over it is time for some combat! There are a lot of Aibatts to the north. Please hunt 15 Small Aibatts and go back to Luda at the Shield Shop.
dialogsAccept: Don't be too nervous and please check your equipment again before you venture out. Oh, and don’t forget to buy some food!
dialogsDecline: This is only your first step into a larger world. Don't hesitate, go forth and defeat those Small Aibatts!
dialogsComplete: Great! You completed your task wonderfully! I can see that you will be very famous one day. If you talk to me again, I will give you another task which will be a little bit harder.
dialogsFail: You should hunt 15 Small Aibatts. Please check in the quest window (Q Key) and return to Luda at the Shield Shop once you're finished.

6693.name: ID card (2)
6693.description: Defeat 30 Captain Watangka and the Lord Watangka.
dialogsBegin: Look, I have no problem giving you the ID card… I just do not want to see you die… But if you really insist, then fine. Hunt some Watangka and I will give you the card.
If you can hunt Watangka you can probably hunt Violet Trillipy.
dialogsAccept: Bye bye then! Take care of yourself…
dialogsDecline: Hmm… Violet Trillipy may be stronger than Watangka.
dialogsComplete: Alright, here is the ID card. Just make sure you come out of there alive. I do not need a guilty conscience.
dialogsFail: I guess we all get tired sometime?

6739.name: Obsessed with Crystals! (1)
6739.description: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Medumet.
6739.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Crystals! Hmmm.... $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s! Could you please bring me some $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$!?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of Medumet.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: You did it! Hooray! Here's your reward. Come back soon!
dialogsFail: More! More!

6740.name: Collective Bargaining
6740.description: Take the Agony Ore to Ainher.
dialogsBegin: Give Drico Sap! Then Drico hand Ore to stranger! *snort*
dialogsAccept: Here take ore!
dialogsDecline: You no want take now? *sniff* Drico need sap please!
dialogsComplete: hehe, impressive! I knew you would find a way to obtain the ore!
dialogsFail: Go take ore. Drico is busy now!

6751.name: The Revival
6751.description: Go into the temple and gather any information you can.
dialogsBegin: What should we do?! What should we do?!
I read the revelation and it speaks of the revival of Iblis as the trigger to the end of the world!
If this is true, we have to stop it! This could be worse than the Hero Wars of long ago.
You told me that you saw new types of masquerpets while you were getting the revelation right? I think that maybe…
...they are the scouts of the army of Iblis. It looks like we may have to work together for a little while longer. Are you willing to help?
dialogsAccept: Excellent. Go in to the temple and gather any information you can about the strange masquerpets.
dialogsDecline: What?! Are you really going to stand by and let the world end?
dialogsComplete: Hmm... Iblis Crasher... So, that is one of the masquerpets? Alright, give me some time to study this information. Thank you.
dialogsFail: Any information about any Masquerpets is good.

6788.name: Successor of Hero -Altar-
6788.description: Take the Tear of Darkness from Scorpicon in Plateau of Silence, Saint Morning, and bring it to Priest Jeperdy in Brekin, Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: You’ll want to take it to the Blade Priest, Jeperdy. She manages the Altar of Blades in Brekin, Darkon 3.

Oh, since you're heading that way, could you retrieve a jewel for her called the Tear of Darkness? A Scorpicon in the Plateau of Silence has it, and we believe it could threaten the Souls of Heroes the Altars protect.
Please take it to Priest Jeperdy, and perhaps we can investigate it further.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, Mercenary.
dialogsDecline: Something this potentially dangerous could bring harm to the Altar of Blade. Please, you must help us retrieve it.
dialogsComplete: Hmm, just as I thought. Even Soulstones react to it. This requires much more investigation.
Worry not, young Mercenary. Bringing me the jewel was enough on your part. I’ll do the rest.
dialogsFail: What brings you to this holy Altar for the Souls of Heroes?

6815.name: Chapter 2 Hill of Shade: The Great Troupe Leader.
6815.description: Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsBegin: Oh your story about the pattern reminds me of something I read in one of the ancient texts.
Do you know the Hill of Shade? I found it in one of my books but have only dared to venture there once.
There is a pattern similar to the one that you saw in the Field of Bubble. Or maybe it was exactly the same. If those two patterns are the same...
...maybe you can also find a cloth piece over there. Would you please go and check?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. Please check around for the pattern in the Hill of Shade. Oh! Please be careful because there is something very fierce over there!
dialogsDecline: I understand but if you ever get the chance would you please check?
dialogsComplete: Iblis above, you look terrible. I appreciate your hard work. You did exceptional work. Let me compare the two cloth pieces.
dialogsFail: Maybe the monster I mentioned earlier was too much for you to handle? You can try again if you wish or not up to you.

6843.name: Test of Strength
6843.description: Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
dialogsBegin: The other two guardians may still be alive, but you are foolish to come here. Nobody is strong enough to face the Red Meteonyker.
Kumah spoke to you? That's okay. He has too much faith in people. I'm a bit of a skeptic. Nothing has ever gone right in this terrible place for us.
Show me a convincing display of your strength. This chamber is filled with Katamaws, a ferocious beast that cannot be tamed. Kill 70 of them and I may consider trusting your abilities.
dialogsAccept: Go on then.
dialogsComplete: I kept my word. You now have all three pieces of the key.
In order to merge them and unlock the entrance to the Red Meteonyker, you must find a guardian forger.
Most were wiped out long ago. You must find any survivors and bring the key together once again.
dialogsFail: That's not nearly enough.

6850.name: Successor of Hero -Scroll-
6850.description: Deliver the Earring of Heren to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
dialogsBegin: Now to get the Earring back into the right hands, the Manager of the House of Heren.
Please deliver it to Ata at the Observatory in Flaris.
His family has managed the House of Heren for generations, and they’ve been seeking this earring for just as long. Possessing it again will give them great relief.
dialogsAccept: Oh, I can just imagine how happy this is going to make them. Hurry along!
dialogsDecline: Delivering this earring will not only help Ata’s family, but I’m sure they’d be willing to help you in your quest. Please, reconsider.
dialogsComplete: It this…? Oh, it is! I can finally go home now! Thank you, thank you!
You don’t know how much this means to my family! We’ve been searching for the Earring for so long and now...forgive me for rambling, I’m just so excited!
This Scroll belonged to the Blades in my family line. Since you’re trying to become one, I want you to have it.
dialogsFail: Full Moon out tonight. Strange things usually happen when that occurs…

6867.name: Acrobat Skills
6867.description: Visit High-Dwarpet Tucani in Flaris. He can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsBegin: That about does it for Acrobat weaponry.
Now for the next step in your journey. I want you to travel to Flaris, and visit the High-Dwarpets. They have important information for you.
The High-Dwarpets can be found north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) to find your way if you get lost.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, apprentice.
dialogsDecline: What a shame to waste such potential. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Hmmm, has Pyre instructed you to see me? I see. Very well, I will continue your training. Listen up!
Bows consume Magic Points (MP) and yo-yos consume Focus Points (FP). There are 6 special bow abilities and 7 special yo-yo abilities. I shall teach you a common Acrobat ability, Dark Illusion.
This ability allows you to vanish from sight. However, keep in mind that any actions performed while under the effects of this ability aside from movement will remove the effect. Take this.
dialogsFail: It's interesting that you've come to see me. Did Pyre send you? If he did, you would have something for me.

6872.name: Zenma Hunting
6872.description: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
6872.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for help with reducing the Zenma population as they're causing problems with forestation in Gouthan Mountains. Could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Zenma flying above Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

6874.name: Laws of Aviation (4)
6874.description: Kill 5 Captain Mothbees then return back to Tina.
dialogsBegin: Alright, sorry about that. I just had to finish some important paperwork. Now, where were we?

*cough* ...Oh! The test, right. Sorry! To get you more familiar with your flying device, I want you to experience Air Combat! Yes, you can also fight in the air! It's very similar to regular Combat, actually.
You can even use skills in the air. Give it a try! Go and kill some of those Pesky Captain Mothbees flying near the northwestern edge of Saint City.
dialogsAccept: You'll find the Mothbees flying inbetween Flaris and Saint Morning. They seem to gather near the giant gears. Killing 5 should be enough. Report back to me once you're done.
dialogsDecline: They're just bugs, they're not that scary! *sigh* Let me know when you've found enough courage.
dialogsComplete: Wow impressive! You've really got a knack for this. Well done. You've passed the test!

6892.name: The Alluring Enchantress
dialogsBegin: Ah! So you braved all the perils of the dungeon just to meet me eh? Oh my name? Well, I don't just give that out to anyone! Hehe.
Before I bestow upon you the most graceful name ever, you have to show me you are worthy to receive it! How? Oh its quite simple! Hehe. Just kill 20 Keakoon Guards!
dialogsAccept: There should be more than enough Keakoon Guards in this very dungeon. Just kill 20 of them and you will have the privilege of knowing my name!
dialogsDecline: Oh well, I guess that is your loss then. Hehe.
dialogsComplete: Wow, that was quick! Apparently someone really wants to know my name? Hehe.
dialogsFail: Well, you could stand there and stare at me all day, but that won't kill those Keakoon Guards any faster now will it? Hehe.

6943.name: Sweet Medication
6943.description: Pink and Blue Roach Queen deep in dungeon. Please go gather their sap!
dialogsBegin: Agony Ore? Khahahahaha! You say want Agony Ore? *snort* *sniff* Agony Ore very rare! I no trade!
*sniff*. Hmm...Maybe I change mind If do something for Drico! Tribe need sap of Roach Queen for medicine! *snort* You can collect for Drico?
dialogsAccept: Collect sap from Pink Roach Queen and Blue Roach Queen, then bring to Drico.
dialogsDecline: You reject such a good chance now? *Sniff* *Sniff*. As you wish~
dialogsComplete: *sniff* *sniff* Drico smell sweet sap!
dialogsFail: Collect Pink Roach Queen Sap and Blue Roach Queen Sap! Sniff!

6961.name: Assist Skills
6961.description: Visit High-Dwarpet Goripeg north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsBegin: Now that you have a good understanding of Assist weaponry, I'd like you to visit Goripeg, one of the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
High-Dwarpet Goripeg will give you information on Assist skills. He knows a lot about Assists and I think you are ready to speak with him.
You can find the High-Dwarpets by opening your map (M Key). Go quickly, young one!
dialogsAccept: May Bubble protect you and guide you.
dialogsDecline: If you feel that you are not ready, young one, that is your decision. If you change your mind, come and speak with me again.
dialogsComplete: Erhm… hello there! You must be the young apprentice Maki spoke so highly of.
The blessing of Rhisis be with you, apprentice! I'd like to go over one of the Assist skills with you. Haste is a skill that you can cast on yourself or an ally.
The Haste skill allows you to increase your attack speed and decrease your casting time, or that of a friend's, by a very large amount. It is an amazing skill!
dialogsFail: Excuse me? I don't believe we have anything to discuss. Please leave me in peace.

6976.name: Facts of Bone Bowl
6976.description: Take the Bone Bowl to the Strange Collector in Northern Saint City.
dialogsBegin: To be honest, it disappeared a long time ago. It corroded because it was made of bone.
That is why I asked you to bring me these materials. These are the materials that the black magician used to place the curse on the Bone Bowl in the first place.
I do not have the power to curse it as strongly as the black magician did. I can certainly curse it as much as any collector could!
Now, please bring this Bone Bowl to the Strange Collector.
dialogsAccept: The Strange Collector will be very happy. Just don't tell him I had to make another one. Hahaha!
dialogsDecline: There's nothing to be afraid of! The curse isn't contagious! Muahaha!
dialogsComplete: You got it?! Amazing! Look at the craftsmanship! And it's do well preserved! It's as if it was made today!
Great job, my friend. This bowl is amazing!
dialogsFail: You don't have it yet? Well, what are you waiting for? Go!

7032.name: Mercenary Skills
7032.description: Speak with High-Dwarpet Langdrong. He can be found with the other High-Dwarpets north of Flarine.
dialogsBegin: You've done very well so far, Vagrant. You are ready for the next step in your journey to become a Mercenary!
You must travel north, and visit the High-Dwarpets. Langdrong, one of the High-Dwarpets, will continue your training.
High-Dwarpet Langdrong will educate you on Mercenary skills.
You can find the High-Dwarpets north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you get lost.
dialogsAccept: I sense great potential in you, Vagrant. Luck be with you.
dialogsDecline: What a shame. Please see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Where did you find that, Vagrant? Tell you what, for bringing this to me, I will go over one of the Mercenary Skills it details here. Listen up!
As a Mercenary you can wield a weapon and a shield. The skill, Keenwheel, is a high damage spinning attack that can only be used after using the Slash skill and must be used in the Action Slot.
Keenwheel is another example. Notice how the skills in the Skill Tree Window (K Key) are shaped like puzzle pieces? This is a good indicator of what skills can be used in what order.
dialogsFail: If Andy sent you, then he should have given you some proof. Maybe you're forgetting something, friend?

7050.name: Raising Pets 2 (F Tier -> E Tier)
7050.description: Bring your pet's experience to 99.99% and the Pet Tamer will upgrade it for you!
dialogsBegin: Now that you're pet has been hatched, it will increase specific character statistics (Stat Points) depending on the type of pet you have summoned. Every pet type affects a specific character statistic.
Feed your pet the appropriate Pet Candy and it will gain experience. If you bring your pet's experience to 99.99% again, I'll upgrade it! How does that sound?
dialogsAccept: If your pet's energy runs out, it can't help you. When it's energy gets low, you better feed it to keep the bonuses! Now, go and spend some time with your pet! Come back when you've gained enough experience.
dialogsDecline: Really? You're not interested in advancing your pet's abilities? Fine, have it your way. What a shame…
dialogsComplete: Great job with your pet, my friend! I'll take it from here!
dialogsFail: You need to spend more time with your pet. It hasn't acquired enough experience to be upgraded yet. Stop back by when his experience reaches 99.99%!

7103.name: The Perils of Gardening
7103.description: Hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to Laola.
dialogsBegin: Ohh! Achaben sent you! Sorry for the less than friendly greeting! I heard you are looking for the warrior about whom I spoke of to Achaben?
I have briefly seen her before, but I’m not entirely sure of her exact whereabouts. I do have a friend who claims to have seen this warrior recently…

I will introduce you to them, but first I need a little help! I do extensive gardening here in Darkon 3 but the Watangka tribes have been making my work difficult. Could you please eliminate some of them?
dialogsAccept: Please hunt 20 Small Watangkas & 15 Watangkas and return to me. It is terribly difficult to garden in these conditions!
dialogsDecline: Please help eliminate the Watangka! It's hard enough to make a living already without them around!
dialogsComplete: Thank you so much!! Now I can work to get my next export of flowers out!
dialogsFail: Please go and defeat the Watangka before they destroy any more of my flowers!

7124.name: Solace in the Mountains
7124.description: Find the Billposter hero high in the mountains Southeast of Nomads Village.
dialogsBegin: The warrior you are looking for is currently training up at the Stone Mountain. I believe her to be the original hero Billposter.
She shouldn't be too hard to find. Seems like she's been training in the same spot for quite some time now. Plan to find her?
dialogsAccept: She typically can be found meditating high up in the mountains Southeast of this location. Good luck!
dialogsDecline: Well, you can hang around, but don't think you will be eating for free here!
dialogsComplete: Hmm, I sense an unknown aura interfering with my meditation…
dialogsFail: Yes yes, my food smells delicious. Time for you to go accomplish your mission!

7125.name: A Mother's Embrace
dialogsBegin: Oh, also! My mommy is looking for you... Go talk to her. Don't worry, she is cooled down now.
dialogsAccept: I think she wants to thank you for helping me!
dialogsDecline: Hmm... If you go back to Mayor, this mission will fail...
dialogsComplete: Good to see you again. Sorry for earlier, it's just that Nerco makes me so angry sometimes. Anyway, I heard you found something for my daughter.
dialogsFail: Please go talk with my mommy!

7176.name: Construction Gone Awry
7176.description: Kill 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders located near the entrance to Dekane Dungeon.
dialogsBegin: Alright, I guess I should uphold my end of the promise!
You say Zoro is going to reunite with Reonan? Well... He did always like playing the Hero. What's this? A letter from Zoro?
Alright. I will read his letter. While I do that, would it be possible for another favor? Monsters, known as Garbagespiders, have been ravaging the land. Could you please defeat them?
dialogsAccept: Garbagespiders were once used to assist workers in construction. They have since become cursed and are soley bent on destruction. Please defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders.
dialogsDecline: Hmm… I would prefer to read the letter without anyone around…
dialogsComplete: Just in time! I have finished reading the letter.
dialogsFail: Please go defeat 20 Small Garbagespiders & 15 Garbagespiders in Darkon 1 while I finish reading this letter.

7218.name: Elaine's Reply
7218.description: Meet Zoro and give him Elaine's letter.
dialogsBegin: Zoro wrote this letter to convince me… but no!! I thought about it and nothing can change my mind. After the war, I promised myself I would never kill again… I intend to uphold that vow…
Can you bring this to Zoro? This letter is for him.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. When Zoro reads this letter, he will fully understand my rationale…
dialogsDecline: I hope you will reconsider. I want Zoro to understand my reasons for declining the offer.
dialogsComplete: Have you met with Elaine yet? Hmm? He sent a letter?
dialogsFail: Did you give my letter to Zoro yet?

7247.name: Lens of Olien
7247.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Olien needs you to collect steam tears to make a new lens. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7292.name: Sury's Test (1)
7292.description: Hunt 50 Small Shuhammas & 35 Shuhammas and then speak with Sury
dialogsBegin: Do not fool yourself into believing that was the only test. Next, please defeat the Shuhamma for me.
Are you still determined to prove your worth? You can back out at anytime.
dialogsAccept: Well then, hunt 50 Small Shuhammas & 35 Shuhammas for me.
dialogsDecline: Heh, a true warrior would never turn down a challenge.
dialogsComplete: Impressive. Guess I should increase the difficulty of the next test if I wish to truly test you!
dialogsFail: The Shuhammas should be right at the bottom of this mountain. Please make haste and defeat 20 Small Shuhammas & 15 Shuhammas.

7304.name: Stone of Enlightenment
dialogsBegin: In order to create a Shard of Enlightenment, we will need to fuse together an Infernal Stone and an Angelic Stone.
Please return to Fera and explain to her what it is you need.
dialogsAccept: She will be able to explain in greater detail about how to acquire an Angelic Stone.
dialogsDecline: We could all use your assistance right now…
dialogsComplete: Ah! You've returned! What did Capafe have to say of the issue?
dialogsFail: Ask Fera about the Angelic Stone.

7310.name: Journal of an Adventurer (3)
