7310.description: Bring the translated document to the Mayor of Darkon.
dialogsBegin: Why, this is not a code… Amazing! The language of the Ancient Tribe. This Bartholomew Hunt must have really known his stuff. Maybe there is more to this…
I have translated the Ancient language. Bring this Translated Document to the Mayor of Darkon. Keep it safe, this is truly a special thing!
dialogsAccept: You are playing an important role in historic events.
dialogsDecline: I can't believe it! The possibility of a new land and you are not interested?
dialogsComplete: You can't imagine how eagerly I've been waiting for you to return. Have you met the Sage Radion? Is there news?
He was able to translate it? Wonderful. Now we can see if this is real or just a wild goose chase… Give me a moment to read through this.
dialogsFail: The Mayor of Darkon is waiting for you. Hurry!

7315.name: Successor of Hero - Master
7315.description: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Ranger Hero? We will see…
Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsAccept: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Ranger Hero.
dialogsDecline: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsFail: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Ranger if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.

7335.name: The Insightful Store Owner
7335.description: Acquire 10 Hard Drill from the Drillers in Darkon and bring them to Remine
dialogsBegin: Oh! Interested in the stories of this so called super hero I see? Can't say I know a whole lot about him.
There was someone who had more insight into this mysterious man. Oh, what was his name now! Oh I've just got so much on my mind right now its hard to think about anything!
You want to know what the problem is? I had an important package to deliver but I can't for the life of me remember what I did with it…
The package contained special drills acquired from the Drillers in Darkon. Some of the sturdiest around!! If you could acquire some of these drills for me it would surely help a lot!
dialogsAccept: Oh! You will get the drills for me!! You are really great! Drillers can be found Southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. Acquire 10 drills and bring them to Remine the weapon smith.
dialogsDecline: Oh no... I'm in trouble now. Who will ever want the business of such a forgetful store owner!
dialogsComplete: Achaben sent you here I see! Are these the Hard Drills I ordered?
dialogsFail: Thank you again! Please make haste and acquire the 10 Hard Drills and take them to Remine the Darken weapon smith.

7394.name: Zenma Hunting (2)
7394.description: Almani asked for further help regarding the Zenma threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Zenma?
7394.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for further help regarding the Zenma threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Zenma?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Zenma flying above Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

7415.name: Prepare for Battle! (2)
7415.description: Kill 100 Cannibal Mammoths and last but not least, the Lord Mammoth.
dialogsBegin: It's time to face off against the Mammoths. The most fearsome and terrible creature I have ever laid my eyes upon in this place.
This will not be an easy battle. May Rhisis be with you.
dialogsAccept: Kill 100 Cannibal Mammoths and last but not least, the Lord Mammoth.
dialogsComplete: You are truly a great warrior and an even greater friend. We owe our lives to you.
We are safe now. I know this may not be much, but take this as a sign of our appreciation. You will always be remembered here.
dialogsFail: We must battle on. I believe in you.

7450.name: Chapter 2 Hill of Shade
7450.description: Here. Take this picture. Please deliver it to Rovanett who is working in the National Library in Saint City. You can find her in Saint Hall.
dialogsBegin: Hey! Great timing! I have just found out about something very interesting.
Do you know what this is? Well, I am sure you do not but I will tell you.
This is an entire picture of the pattern we found. I found it in one of my books but it was the only picture I could find.
I need your help once again. Would you do ma a favor?
dialogsAccept: Take this picture. Please deliver it to Rovanett in the National Library in Saint City. You can find her at Saint Hall.
dialogsDecline: Hey we are in this together. We are all in the same boat. You would do better to help me You know that.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... Is this what Hachal said? Good job. Thank you very much. Let me check.
dialogsFail: History is always more interesting than current events but this is especially mysterious.

7473.name: Chapter 3 Purple Magician: The Great Magician Laola
7473.description: This is it. I have to check this first, so please come back to me in a minute.
dialogsBegin: Oh, you are here finally. I cannot say that your arrival is entirely a surprise. I am Laola the Great Magician *cough* *cough*.
I can see in your face that you do not believe me. I guess, looking at myself, I do not look like such a Great Magician.
Magic always has a high cost and I used some terrible magic back then.
But never mind that, show me the bead you brought, I can feel its power from here.
dialogsAccept: Yes, this is it. I have to check this first, so please come back to me in a minute.
dialogsDecline: *cough* *cough* Hey, do not be too greedy. Something that powerful could corrupt you to your core. *cough* *cough*
dialogsComplete: Hmmm I did not know he could make something like this, but I cannot say that I am surprised.
dialogsFail: It is no secret why I am called the Great Magician. Though, I have learned that being a great magician, does not make you a great person. *cough*

7484.name: Legendary Redmantis (Part 2)
7484.description: Travel to the Pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and acquire 15 Redyspawn. Return to Helgar when you've completed this task.
dialogsBegin: Hmmm, I think Rudvihil is referring to the Red Mantis Egg. These eggs are difficult to acquire and I think these might be the eggs Rudvihil is after.
There are reports that some Red Mantis C, the female variety, have been seen near the pumpkin patch. Feel like taking a trip?
dialogsAccept: Great! Head to the pumpkin patch, slay 10 Red Mantis C and collect 15 Redyspawn. These are the eggs. Hopefully we'll find a pristine one!
dialogsDecline: Are you afraid of a little action? This is a very rare find, it will be worthwhile, I promise. Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Let me see what you've got there… Hmm yes, these are very nice! Thank you for bring these to me!
dialogsFail: What are you doing here? You have work to do!

7502.name: Lost Documents
7502.description: Julia wants the office documents that the mia stole.
7502.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Julia needs you to collect office documents stolen by the Mias. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect the office documents near Mias.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7508.name: Weed Whacked!
7508.description: Kill 10 Fefern & 5 2nd Class Fefern and go back to Reonan.
dialogsBegin: I now have another favor to ask of you. A mysterious curse has turned the once docile Fefern into foul beasts which are ravaging the land. Will you defeat them?
dialogsAccept: Fefern can be found in the Northwest region of Flaris. Please kill 10 Fefern & 5 2nd Class Fefern and come back.
dialogsDecline: So that’s it? You eliminate a giant Rogue, yet tremble at the sight of some mere weeds?
dialogsComplete: It's as I've come to expect. The villagers are rejoicing of your heroic deeds. You my friend, have earned yourself quite a reputation around here.
dialogsFail: If you cross the bridge located in Northern Flaris, you will find the Fefern.

7546.name: Devil Marble
7546.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Bill needs Tomb Marbles to make the Devil Marble. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7554.name: A Test of Trust
dialogsBegin: Now we just need to wait for the right moment to open the door! What is your business with me anyway?
Gathering the 8 original heroes? Hmph. Been so long I can hardly recall. Only member I've kept in touch with is Elaine… err, forget I said anything. Hah.
I can prove quickly if it was truly Reonan who sent you. Reonan is perceptive when it comes to people and he doesn't choose just any pushover! How about a test of your skill?
First, I need to test your skill. Go kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts and come back, Then I will trust you and participate to Reonan's decision.
dialogsAccept: How about you… mmm… Kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts! BAM! There we go. A true test of skill. Then I will know for sure! You can find them East of this location.
dialogsDecline: This is the only way to earn my trust.
dialogsComplete: Guess I will give credit where it's due. You aren't THAT much of a weakling! Alright, guess I will trust you!
dialogsFail: Zoning out the entire time I was giving instructions? Head east of this location and kill 15 Volts & 15 Captain Volts!

7605.name: Menacing Phantom
7605.description: Defeat 3 Worm Veduques and eliminate Serus Uriel. Use the Mars Dungeon key to enter her chamber.
dialogsBegin: The final task awaits. Please eliminate Serus Uriel. If we don't eliminate her now while she's weakened, Flaris will be in grave danger.
dialogsAccept: Use the key I gave you to enter her lair. Please be careful, the monsters inside are on whole other level compared to the Guardians. It would be wise to form a party before entering her chamber.
dialogsDecline: There is no time. Please rethink this through...
dialogsComplete: You've returned! Flaris can be at peace once again. Thank you, adventurer. Please take this as a reward. You have my gratitude.
dialogsFail: The main thing is you are still alive. Take time to recover, and try again! You can do this!

7608.name: Forest Destroyers
7608.description: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards located in the Northwestern region of Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin: Ahh, Reonan is looking to reunite the original 8 heroes you say? He was a dear friend, but I don't think I will be able to fulfill his request. You see… things have changed since that time…
I know it is for the sake of Madrigal! But, I've resigned from a life of heroics. All I desire now is to live in peace…
You sure are persistent eh? I'll hear you out if you do something for me. Recently, the ecosystem has been suffering due to deforestation caused by the Elderguards. Defeat them, and I will listen.
dialogsAccept: Kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards, responsible for the devastation to this environment, and you have my undivided attention!
dialogsDecline: The forest needs our aid!
dialogsComplete: Wow, you really accomplished the task! Because of you, I no longer need to concern myself over further deforestation!
dialogsFail: Please go kill 20 Small Elderguards & 15 Elderguards before they destroy anymore of this environment!

7610.name: Sweet Dessert
7610.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Damian needs you to collect Blue Honey to make a new dessert. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7619.name: Save the Garden! (Part 2)
7619.description: I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
7619.descriptionComplete: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: You have a message from my sister!
I see. The Garden of Rhisis is dying... Could you inform my sister Kimberley?
dialogsAccept: Thank you!
dialogsDecline: The problem with the Garden of Rhisis can wait. I guess...
dialogsComplete: Thank you from bringing me this message. I think you should talk to Marche in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsFail: You still haven't found Kimberley? She is in Saint City.

7620.name: Portable Power
7620.description: A request for Amperes has gone out
7620.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: A request for $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$s has gone out. Will you accept this quest?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7641.name: Anesthetic Needs
7641.description: A request has gone out for $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
7641.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: A request has gone out for Boopoison to make an antidote. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7651.name: Strange Collector (3)
7651.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Strange Collector needs you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7732.name: Strange Collector (4)
7732.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Mysterious collector needs Garbageton for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7744.name: Evidence of the Portrait 2
7744.description: Find Ancimys south of the High-Dwarpet camp and ask him to find the portrait for you.
dialogsBegin: We're going to need more information if we are to find the missing portrait. Wait, maybe Ancimys can help.
Powerful black magicians once existed in Madrigal. They used black magic which is slightly different than what our modern day Magicians use.
One of them made a box possessing great magical power… Ancimys. Some say that very same magician locked himself inside the box, hahaha!
He may be able to use Psychmetria... What? You don't know what Psychmetria is?
Psychmetria is a powerful black magic spell that can pinpoint the location of an object. You must go and find Ancimys.
dialogsAccept: The Ancimys you need to speak with is just south of here.
dialogsDecline: What do I care if you don't do it? It's no skin off my back…
dialogsComplete: A missing portrait? Well, isn't that exciting! I was so bored I thought I was going to fall asleep! Tell me more about this portrait.
Alright, give me a moment… Mmmmmm, yes. I've got it! I see a camp… and large creatures with hammers and blades for hands.
Ah ha! It's the Red Bang Troupe camp northeast of the Mars Mine. One of those big beasts has it! It's difficult to get to, but I'm sure you'll manage!
dialogsFail: Are you going to play with me? Really? Good! What will we do? Hide and Seek? YAY!

7765.name: Mark of Bill
7765.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Bill needs you to collect Gigglande so that he can make his mark. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

7768.name: Chapter 1: Field of Bubble: The Strange Pattern
7768.description: I am sure we can find out something by checking the pattern. Please check it carefully and bring me whatever you get.
dialogsBegin: Before you showed up I took a look around and found something strange to the North. The ground was dug up and...
...it looked like some kind of pattern. I could get a close look at it because it was surrounded .
Strange fellows were hanging around there. I think they were defending something. There was no way I could have fought them off.
Would you check? I am sure they are no match for you.
dialogsAccept: Great! I am sure that there is something to that pattern. Check it closely and bring me what you find.
dialogsDecline: Are you really ready to give up? I cannot force you but think about the future.
dialogsComplete: Oh! This! The legend is... Martinyc was right! Oh... What should we do now... Iblis watch over me!
dialogsFail: Were those fellows too strong for you? Bring more people with you and continue checking. I am not strong enough to help you with them.

7784.name: Dragonflies (2)
7784.description: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Neparuba threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Neparuba?
7784.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Neparuba threat. Could you get rid of the Lord Neparuba?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Neparuba flying between Flaris and Saint morning continents.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

7799.name: Successor of Hero - Scroll
7799.description: Bring Curenen's ring to Clackcable of the Pepoview Troupe in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: My sincerest gratitude once again for finding the ring. However, now I'll need you to take it to Saint City.
Visit the Pepoview Troupe near the town square and speak with Clackcable. Present him with the ring and he will guide you from there. He may even give you something in return.
dialogsAccept: You possess great potential, young Acrobat. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsDecline: Foolish Acrobat! Don't you realize your potential? See me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Thank you so much for finding the ring! We are performing the ancestral ceremony of Curenen. This ring will complete the ritual.
Here, you certainly deserve this. It is the Successor Scroll of the Jester Hero.
dialogsFail: If you spoke with Radyon, didn't he ask you to bring me something? I'm sorry, I'm very busy and we don't have much more to discuss, I'm afraid.

7802.name: Vagrant Master (Magician)
7802.description: Slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs then return to Wingyei, the Magician Drillmaster in Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Are you intrigued by the art of magic? If you're speaking with me, you must be interested in becoming a Magician. I must warn you, it is not an easy road.
Very well then, first, I would like you to perform a small task for me. Captain Aibatts have infested the area north of Eastern Flarine.
If you're interested in helping, this little nuisance is just north of there. Will you slay 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to help us?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Good luck!
dialogsDecline: I see you're not ready to walk the path of the Magician. Very well, speak to me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Great job, young Vagrant! I think you'll make a fine Magician.
dialogsFail: You must defeat 15 Captain Aibatts and 10 Small Burudengs to prove you are worthy of Magician training. I will not help you if you cannot even complete this simple task.

7869.name: To the Real Owner
7869.description: Deliver the Hero's Pendant to Sury.
dialogsBegin: Thank you. I can now rest assured knowing that the pendant will be returned to its rightful owner.
Will you please take the pendant to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive it.
dialogsAccept: Hurry over to Sury, I'm sure she is anxious to receive the pendant.
dialogsDecline: Please rethink your decision. This pendant is quite important to Sury.
dialogsComplete: You have recovered the pendant!
dialogsFail: Take the pendant back to Sury.

7941.name: The Rusty Shackle
dialogsBegin: What? My mother told me to come and eat? Awww but I’m just getting started!
What? She's mad at me? If you show Mia's Shackles to her, I know she will be proud! Please take this to my mother.
dialogsAccept: Awesome! Now I can get back to killing more monsters!
dialogsDecline: It's ok, I understand that you are just jealous! Mwahaha!
dialogsComplete: What's this? Some old shackle? What? Nerco told you that he isn't coming back?
dialogsFail: Hurry up and take Mia's Shackles to my mother, so she can see how great I am!

7945.name: Successor of Hero - Altar
7945.description: Bring the Stamped Scroll and the 8 lost History of Hero books to Rupim, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: This scroll is the right of passage for those seeking to pursue the path of the Ranger Hero. Please, take it and seek the Ranger Priest in Darkon 3.
Rupin, the Ranger Priest, can be found in Aniceknight in northern Darkon 3. Present her with the scroll and she will recognize you as a successor to the Ranger Hero.
There is one thing you must do before you can speak with the Ranger Priest. Pranksters in the Garden of Rhisis have stolen the 8 books of the History of Heroes.
These books detail the History of the Heroes and are very sacred us. Go now, to Rhisis, and do what you must to get these books back!
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, Acrobat. May the Ranger Hero guide you. Speak with Rupin, the Ranger Priest in Aniceknight, once you've recovered the sacred texts.
dialogsDecline: The books must be returned. We need your help, Acrobat. Speak with me again when you are ready.
dialogsComplete: What've you got there, Acrobat? A Stamped Scroll, and are those… they are! I can't believe it! The 8 lost books of the History of Heroes!
How did you ever… never mind! The important thing is that we have them back! We owe you our sincerest gratitude, young Acrobat!
dialogsFail: I'm waiting for someone who has allegedly found the 8 lost books of the History of Heroes. Is that you? No? Then we have nothing more to discuss.

7948.name: Plot of Colack
7948.description: Find 5 Pieces of Meteoritill and bring them to Colack in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Did you know that a huge meteorite fell nearby a few days ago?
We usually refine chunks of meteorite into a very rare metal. We call it Meteoritill.
It is the best material for making expensive arms or armor in Madrigal.
It usually takes about 500 years to get it because meteorites don't fall every day. However, one just fell, so now's our chance!
Think you can find me some Meteoritill? I would be very pleased to acquire some.
dialogsAccept: Keep it secret, though. I don't want the other armorsmiths to find out! Try searching south of Saint City.
dialogsDecline: Pfft! Fine! I'll find someone else to help me, but you better keep your mouth shut!
dialogsComplete: Oh my… you found it! Real Meteoritill! I'll be rich beyond my wildest dreams! Muahahah!
Oh, I mean uh… I will be sure to make good use of this material. Here's a little something for your trouble.
Thanks again, friend!
dialogsFail: You didn't find any? That's a shame. Keep looking! Don't give up!

7974.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
7974.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

8047.name: New Yo-Yo
8047.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: An Acrobat master needs you to gather Renyken to make a new Yo-Yo. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

8095.name: Successor of Hero -Master-
8095.description: Defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not Small $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s or Giant $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, just $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. They are located southwest of the Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsBegin: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
First, we'll need to test your skills in combat if we are to continue down this path.

I want you to defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not Small $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s or Giant $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, just $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. They are located southwest of the Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsAccept: I will be watching you, Magician. Good luck!
dialogsDecline: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsComplete: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Elementor Hero.
dialogsFail: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.

8142.name: Chapter 3 Purple Magician: A Mysterious Bead.
8142.description: Please, once more, check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade. I am sure that there is more to be found!
dialogsBegin: I have finished translating the book. The Purple Magician and the Black Magician are the same person! Just as Hachal said!
It looks like the purple altar was made by the Magician in Purple for some kind of religious service.
It seems that they were attempting to transcend to a better existence but how?
As always, I have a few good theories but I need more data. Always more data! I want answers now!
Would you help me again? I can see the curiosity in your eyes, same as mine. Am I right?
dialogsAccept: Very well! Then please check the Field of Bubble and the Hill of Shade more carefully. I am really sure there is something over there!
dialogsDecline: Fine, return to me when you get the time.
dialogsComplete: Oh... What a strong magical power this bead has... Oh... What a surprise!
Good job...But something like this is completely out of my range. Let me think for a moment. Yes, I have it!
Please deliver this to the Great Magician Laola in Darkon 3.
dialogsFail: I have a bad feeling about this. I have never been wrong about anything. I hope I am this time.

8155.name: Successor of Hero -Altar-
8155.description: Locate the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and present it to Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest at the Altar of Psykeeper in Darkon 3.
dialogsBegin: No, on to your next challenge, Magician! I need you to speak with someone.
Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest, is trying to locate an ancient Relic from the war somewhere in the Cave of Envy in Darkon 2. It's called the Trace of Offerep.
Locate the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, and present it to Pereb, the Psykeeper Priest at the Altar of Psykeeper in Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!
dialogsDecline: Don't give up now, Magician. You're so close!
dialogsComplete: I am grateful that you've brought the Trace of Offerep, Magician. I have been searching for this for a very long time.
You possess great potential, young Magician. Keep working hard and you will realize your dream.
dialogsFail: This is the alter where the Souls of Heroes are protected. What can I do for you, young one?

8156.name: Flying Board
8156.description: Dior wants you to collect Peakyrinds.
8156.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Dior needs you to collect Peakyrinds. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

8160.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
8160.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

8169.name: Questioning
8169.description: Go to the office and deliver a scholarship application to the Mayor.
dialogsBegin: Hmm... What should I do? Hey, can you help me?
I have been worried for so long, I know I must look a mess. It is good to have a friendly ear to turn to.
I am studying recent history, but it is really hard. So would you please help me? Please?
dialogsAccept: Really? Wow! Thanks a lot! Please go to the office and deliver my application for a scholarship. Thank you.
dialogsDecline: What? Awww I knew it was too good to be true.
dialogsComplete: Oh, it seems like Martinyc is too busy to deliver her own applications.
dialogsFail: May I help you? You want to fill out an application? The form is on the right side of the office.

8269.name: Hero of Saint City
8269.description: Kill Hobo and get the Hobo Sword.
dialogsBegin: Hah, you have become quite the celebrity around here! Yes, there is still evil afoot in Saint Morning, but nothing that we can't now contain thanks to your aid!
I do wish to ask you one last favor. Will you hear me out in my final request?
dialogsAccept: You have my thanks. Word has it, a group of dangerous escaped convicts from Saint City Prison are planning their revenge. Please defeat the Hobo and take his sword as proof!
dialogsDecline: Hmm…just unfortunate considering how far you have come!
dialogsComplete: I knew it all along. Reonan was right. There is truly greatness within you. I, and the people of Saint City, wish to bestow you with this gift of elemental cards. Use them wisely!
dialogsFail: The Hobo should be in the Western Fantasy Desert. Please eliminate this threat!

8271.name: Successor of the Hero - Master
8271.description: I'll need to see what you can do before I'll allow your training. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsBegin: You think you have what it takes to be a successor of the Jester Hero? We will see…
Fine, I'll humor you. Slay $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s southwest of the Gouthan Mountains. They must be regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, not the small or captain variety.
dialogsAccept: Show me what you can do and I might consider allowing you to continue on the path of the Jester Hero.
dialogsDecline: That's too bad because I sense potential in you. You must not be ready for the challenges that lie ahead. Come see me again if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Not bad, Acrobat. Not bad at all. You may have something to offer. I'll allow your training.
dialogsFail: I doubt you have what it takes to be a Jester if you can't even slay 20 Drillers.

8337.name: Strange Collector (5)
8337.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Strange Collector needs $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

8357.name: Successor of Hero -Scroll-
8357.description: Deliver the Seal of Aenn to Teshar in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: Now, deliver the Seal to Teshar, the leader of Kyon Soldiers.
Teshar and her Mercenaries can be found in Eastern Flarine.
dialogsAccept: Make haste!
dialogsDecline: The Seal is very important, and you’re one of the only people able to keep it safe. Please, reconsider taking this task.
dialogsComplete: Greetings, I am Teshar, and I lead Kyon’s company of soldiers for hire. How may I help...oh my. How did you find this? I’ve looked all over Flaris for it.
In Saint Morning, really? That explains why I never ran across it. Anyway, thank you very much. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation.
This Scroll was passed down to each Ringmasters in my family. I’d like you to have it.
dialogsFail: Even though the Kyon are hired soldiers, we do not follow just anyone because of the money. We respect faith and royalty.

8398.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
8398.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

8420.name: Fera's Test
8420.description: Hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3, then talk with Fera.
dialogsBegin: Sury's mind is currently clouded with doubt, as the Guardian had mentioned. In her current state, she will never reach enlightenment regardless of how hard she trains…
To help grant her thoughts a renewed sense of clarity, we must bring her a Shard of Enlightenment. First I must test your own personal strength. Do you accept?
dialogsAccept: I knew you wouldn't back away from this challenge. Please hunt 60 Small Kern and 40 Kern located in Southern Darkon 3.
dialogsDecline: We must not falter in the face of adversity!
dialogsComplete: I never doubted your skill for a second!
dialogsFail: Please go and hunt down the Kern as a test of your own strength.

8443.name: Find Luda's Cash Box
8443.description: Recover Luda's cash box from the Red bang Thieves at the camp west of the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsBegin: I asked the witnesses with the evidence you have brought to me, and now it is clear they had stolen my cash box. Now the only thing I have to do is get the cash box back from them.
I am really sorry but please do me a favor once again? I really need to get that cash box back. I really need to get my girlfriend a present. You see…
it is our 100th day anniversary… She will be so upset if I don't. Would you please get my cash box back from them? I will reward you.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. Thank you very much. As I heard, one of them is keeping the cash box.
dialogsDecline: You make me really disappointed. Whatever…
dialogsComplete: You found it! Thank you so much! I'll never forget this! Take this, it's the least I can do.
dialogsFail: Where is my cash box? You have not found it yet. Please bring it to me. I will be waiting.

8488.name: The Last Hero
8488.description: Return to Darken and meet with Achaben.
dialogsBegin: You know? You've grown a lot during the course of this all. We've almost reached the end of the initial phase though! We just need to find the last hero!
Shade's power grows progressively stronger… I can feel it…. We must hurry and find the last hero as soon as possible.
I believe Achaben has more details on where we might find the last hero. Please go to him right away!
dialogsAccept: You can hear more details on where to find the last hero from Achaben! Please go and speak with him!
dialogsDecline: You cannot give up yet after everything we've worked for!
dialogsComplete: Yes~ Oh! You're here again, my lord.
dialogsFail: Why haven't you left yet? Achaben is running the general store of Darken. Please go meet with him!

8512.name: Create Guild
8512.description: Please come back again when you have met all of the conditions for creating your guild.
dialogsBegin: Do you want to create a new guild? Excellent! First, I have to check if you are qualified to create a new guild.
Okay, first you have to organize your own party. You should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Got it?
dialogsAccept: Once again, make your own party. Remember that you should be the party leader and the total number of members should be 3, including you. Please visit me again once you have done this.
dialogsDecline: Okay, in that case, if you decide to create a guild later, we'll be here!
dialogsComplete: Hmm… Okay, lets see. You are the party leader, and there are 3 members... Good!
Now I will let you create your own guild. By the way, according to Madrigal policy, you must pay 3,000,000 Penya to create the guild.
Do you have 3,000,000 Penya right now?
dialogsFail: There seems to be a problem. Maybe you aren't the party leader or you do not have enough members. Remember, you have to be the party leader and you should have 3 party members, including yourself.

8528.name: Unknown Situation (1)
8528.description: Flaris Pang wants you to collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
8528.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Flaris Pang needs you collect unknown letters. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ near a bridge in north.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

8535.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
8535.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

8581.name: Successor of Hero -Earring-
8581.description: Find the Earring of Heren, hidden somewhere in Heret. Then take it and your letter to Guabrill, the Blade Sage at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris.
dialogsBegin: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Blade-in-Training. Guard it as you would your own life.
Take it to Guabill, the Blade Sage. He resides at the Fountain of Dead Person in the North Leren Mountains.
Before you do that, however, locate the Earring of Heren. It’s hidden somewhere in Heret, in Darkon 3.
dialogsAccept: May the mercy of Heren be with you always.
dialogsDecline: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsComplete: Dear me! This… this is Earring of Heren! We thought it had been lost forever!
It had gone missing in Heret somewhere, and no one could find it. Thank you, you're truly remarkable!
Your efforts this day will be forever appreciated.
dialogsFail: The souls of many people travel to the Fountain of Dead Person. It is the crossroads between life and death.

8609.name: Chapter 3 Purple Magician
8609.description: Please deliver this to Gothante in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Hey. It seems like the altar and Magic Troupe have something to do with...

...the Purple Magician in this book. History of Hardship. Only it says that the Black Magician and the Magician in Purple are the same person. The same person that fought alongside the heroes in the Hero Wars. That does not make sense.
It is something really unbelievable, but it is also something we should believe.
I think this is the best I can do for now but I will never stop looking for the truth.
You! I want you to show this to someone. Can you do that right now?
dialogsAccept: Yes! Please deliver this to Gothante in Saint City. He is he head of the History Society.
dialogsDecline: I understand that you have other things to do. But this is very important. Come back soon.
dialogsComplete: Hey! Long time no see! Did you meet Hachal? What is this?
Oh... Bubble protect us! Is this true? Oh... Oh... This is too big to deal with alone.
dialogsFail: I am really glad to see you again, but did Hachal tell you to meet me? For what?

8611.name: Sury's Test (2)
8611.description: Hunt 40 Captain Shuhammas & the Lord Shuhamma and go back to Sury.
dialogsBegin: This will be my final task. Complete this and you will have proven yourself worthy enough to speak with me regarding Reonan's request.
The Shuhamma were hardly a challenge for you. Now I really wanna test your skill!. Please go hunt the Lord Shuhamma which servers as their leader!
Hunting the Lord Shuhamma by yourself will be a daunting task. You might wish to enlist the aid of other warriors. But, if you DO defeat him solo, you will have truly earned my respect!
dialogsAccept: You are a quite a brave adventurer. Go hunt 40 Captain Shuhammas & the Lord Shuhamma and let's see what you are truly made of!
dialogsDecline: And here I was thinking you could do it! Maybe I was wrong about you...
dialogsComplete: That was surely no easy feat. You have earned my respect stranger! My name is Sury, the original Billposter Hero
dialogsFail: You still have yet to hunt 40 Captain Shuhammas & the Lord Shuhamma? Return to me once you are finished!

8614.name: Successor of Hero -Guardian-
8614.description: Defeat the Venel Guardian, take his heart, and present it to Sencyrit the Blade Guardian in Guardiane.
dialogsBegin: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Blade.
In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Sencyrit, the Blade Guardian.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck.
dialogsDecline: You’re almost finished, Mercenary. Don’t give up now.
dialogsComplete: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Blade upon you.
Heren, please bless and encourage this Blade as they follow your will!
dialogsFail: Only one recognized as a Blade may pass. Please turn back.

8666.name: Breaking the Curse (2)
8666.description: Kill Steel Knights to collect Steel Pieces and bring them to Amadolka.
dialogsBegin: Yes you heard me correctly, FIRST component. What!? Did you think breaking this curse would be THAT easy? Hah!
Next I will be needing Hard Steel Powder. Unfortunately, as with most things in life, this is easier said than done!
First you will need to get Steel pieces, then take them to Amadolka. He is knowledgeable in metallurgy and can convert the pieces to powder. Up to the challenge?
dialogsAccept: Good!! Kill Steel Knights near the Erons Factory to get the Steel Pieces, then bring them to Amadolka!
dialogsDecline: What? Complicated? What's complicated is being a man, trapped in a fuzzy little body! Try that on for size!
dialogsComplete: Woah! Don't get many visitors out this way. What are you looking for here anyway?
dialogsFail: You heard me correctly! Kill Steel Knights to get Steel Pieces and go to Amadolka. You got this champ!

8690.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
8690.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

8697.name: Missing Play Script
8697.description: Colar is hiding somewhere in Darkon 1. Find him and retrieve the play script.
dialogsBegin: Oh boy... I am in big trouble. How long have you been standing there? Did you hear everything I was saying?
You heard? Hmm... Okay, I will tell you what happened. I am in charge of play scripts for the Pepoview Troupe.
The new play script called The Sky of Madrigal has disappeared. If I don't get it back, I'll be fired.
I know who stole it. His name is Colar, and I think he did it as payback for being fired himself.
Would you please do me a favor? Would you please bring me the play script from Colar?
dialogsAccept: You will?! Thank you very much! Colar is hiding somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him!
dialogsDecline: I knew you weren't going to help me. Why did I even tell you all of that?
dialogsComplete: What?! What play script? I don't have it, I swear!
Well, yes. I stole it. A grave robber who was riding some kind of strange machine took it from me.
The machine was spouting steam and the grave robber was riding and controlling it. That is why I am in this terrible situation now.
dialogsFail: All I know is that he is somewhere in the far east of Darkon 1. Please find him.

8718.name: Evil Eyed Red Dragon
8718.description: You can collect them from Meteonyker. I heard it's in Dekane Dungeon. Be careful, the Meteonyker is very strong! It's  best if you go with a party!
8718.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ is very grateful to you for completing this quest.
dialogsBegin: Can you please go find Dragon Tooth of the Meteonyker Dragon for me? The Arena Manager Lay requested 5 of them.
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

8736.name: A Warm Reception?
dialogsBegin: Sorry, I'm busy looking for someone so hurry… What did you say? YOU are the hero Reonan spoke of!? I imagined you to look, oh… a tad more heroic?
Well, where are my manners? Heh. Welcome to Saint City, the biggest town of Madrigal, supplier of airships and… oh sorry, you probably don't care about any of this!
Reonan DID send you here for more than listening to me ramble about our town, but hey! I'm a tour guide, it's what I do! Anyway! The mayor requests your presence. Please speak with him.
dialogsAccept: The Mayor of Saint City is standing behind me. He'll inform you more of the situation at hand!
dialogsDecline: Don't feel like it? Just don't expect me to babysit you all day long! I'm a busy gal ya know!
dialogsComplete: Ah! So you must be the famed hero of Flaris I've heard so much about? I guess I owe you my thanks already for making the trip to Saint City.
dialogsFail: What? Lost? The Mayor is right behind me. Apparently your vision is as bad as Reonan's choice in heroes.

8741.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
8741.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

8782.name: Death Mine and Roaches (2)
8782.description: Gather the blood of Pinky and Blue Roach Queen.
8782.descriptionComplete: Something about the way Bernard talks suggessts that the Roaches were placed in the mines intentionally. Maybe you can find out.
dialogsBegin: The toxicity of Roaches has poisoned many humans in the mine.
It seems that the Roach Queens are the source of the poison.
Bring me the blood of Pink and Blue Roach Queens so that I can make a vaccine.
dialogsAccept: Sprinkle this liquid on the Roach Queen egg to wake her up. Be careful.
dialogsDecline: You really will not see this through to the end?
dialogsComplete: This vaccine will save many lives. Thank you.
Take this weapon as a token of gratitude and this card to venture deeper into the mine.
The Roaches appeared very suddenly in the mine. Maybe you can find out the reason by going deeper into the mine.
dialogsFail: I am sure that you can handle the upcoming danger.

8785.name: A Chest full of Memories
8785.description: Bring the purified Memory Shard to Hael.
dialogsBegin: I will purify the Memory Shards sure, but first a joke!
dialogsAccept: Haha, well since you were so kind to listen here is your crystal. Now go ahead and take it!
dialogsDecline: Thanks again for listening. The Pukepukes around here don't have a very good sense of humor! Haha!
dialogsComplete: What's the deal with this weird looking stone? Oh, for helping me to recall my lost thoughts you say? Oh well, worth a shot!
dialogsFail: Oh back so soon? Don't worry I have plenty more jokes! So what do you get when you cross an Aibatt with... Er wait, I forgot how it goes...

8796.name: Breaking the Curse (1)
8796.description: Kill the Zombiger West of Darken City and acquire the Forsaken Soul.
dialogsBegin: As I was going to say! I would love to reunite with my fellow heroes, but I can't do much in my, uh… current form hehe. Never fear! I think I have a possible solution!
I have a list of items I need to create a powerful concoction that might possibly alleviate this curse… OR destroy us all. Want in on it? Don't worry, I'm sure everything will be fine! Bwahaha.
dialogsAccept: Excellent! The first material I will need is a Forsaken Soul. You can collect one from the Zombiger directly West of Darken City.
dialogsDecline: I would collect the items myself, but, I don't have opposable thumbs!! Hahaha! Jerk…
dialogsComplete: Oh! Nice work! The first component has been acquired!!
dialogsFail: Yes, yes Zombiger, Forsaken Soul, blah blah blah, you know what to do, now snap to it!

8820.name: Successor of Hero -Master-
8820.description: Defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not Small $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s or Giant $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, just $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. They are located southwest of the Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsBegin: So, you think you're ready to become a Successor of the Psykeeper Hero? You've come a long way, Magician. I think you're ready.
First, we'll need to test your skills in combat if we are to continue down this path.

I want you to defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not Small $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s or Giant $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, just $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. They are located southwest of the Gouthan Mountains.
dialogsAccept: I will be watching you, Magician. Good luck!
dialogsDecline: You're giving up now before you've even started?
dialogsComplete: Yes, very well done, Magician. You've certainly come a long way. You're ready to become a Successor to the Psykeeper Hero.
dialogsFail: I've already given you your task, my friend. You must hurry.

8831.name: Successor of Hero - Ring
8831.description: Meet with Radyon, the Jester Wise Man at the Fountain of Dead Person in Flaris. First though, slay Ren and get the ring from him. He can be found in the Fantasy Desert south of Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Here is a Letter of Recommendation. You will need to give this to Radyon, the Jester Wise Man in Flaris.
Radyon can be found at the Fountain of Dead Person north of the River of Weeping. Before meeting with him, you need to find the ring he lost and return it to him.
Far to the south of Saint City, lies the Fantasy Desert. It is believed that a gentleman named Ren is in possession of the ring. Slay Ren and bring the ring to Radyon.
dialogsAccept: I hope I'm right about you. Don't let me down!
dialogsDecline: I guess I was wrong about you. You're not ready to walk the path of the successor of the Jester hero. See me again when you think you're ready.
dialogsComplete: Is that… the ring? My goodness, thank you so much! This ring belongs to the Jester Hero Curenen. Ren has always wanted to acquire this ring, or so the story goes.
After the war ended, and Curenen passed on, Ren searched for this ring for hundreds of years. He finally discovered it a couple of years ago.
dialogsFail: Have you met Lorein? If you did, you should have something for me. Think carefully.

8893.name: The Jester Hero!
dialogsBegin: I was trapped by the monsters while researching and hid behind these rocks here. Ahh, so you are searching for the super hero?
I briefly came across him earlier while high up in the Gouthan Mountains. He was in a hurry to save a young boy trapped in Eastern Darkon. Maybe you could head there?
dialogsAccept: So you are going there? You are quite brave! This mysterious hero has to be somewhere near where the boy is in Eastern Darkon
dialogsDecline: Don't blame you. I prefer to stay out of trouble like that myself anyway!
dialogsComplete: Hush! Be very quiet! I, Zoro the Magnificent!.....am in the middle of a very important mission!
dialogsFail: Look around the prison in which the boy is locked in East Darkon. I'm sure the hero will be there.

8928.name: Successor of Hero -Scroll-
8928.description: Deliver the Hall Document to Segho in the Leren Mountains.
dialogsBegin: The rightful caretaker of the Hall Document is Segho of the Pesin family. They have been managing Roentel’s Hall of the Martial Arts for generations.
He is out of the Hall right now, doing some adventuring of his own in Flaris.
He’s an accomplished mountaineer, so you may be able to find him in the Leren Mountains. Present him with the Hall Document when you find him.
dialogsAccept: Good luck!
dialogsDecline: Very well, then. Perhaps someone truly worthy of becoming a Billposter will come along to deliver this for me...
dialogsComplete: Surprised to run into somebody else this high up. I’m looking for Roentel’s Hall Document, you wouldn’t happen to have heard about it… well, what d’ya know...
Thanks for bringing this back to us, now I can finally get back to the Hall. Say, I knew I had a good reason to bring this along. Let’s see... *rummaging*
There you go. Every Billposter in my family line possessed this Scroll. Now it’s yours.
dialogsFail: Ahh, Leren Mountains. The root of Flaris itself, perfect for surveying every spot on the map.

8982.name: The Squirrels Took It!
8982.description: Recover the Hero's Pendant from Nautrepy and return it to Elaine.
dialogsBegin: In a way this is good for them. The citizens of Darken needed to become more self-efficient. I know they will be fine without me. There is another issue that has come up.
When we finished the war, aside from my sister's ring, I also threw my pendant somewhere in Darkon 3. I was so convinced I would never need it again…
Could you please find it for me? I know it is asking much of you. It is important that I regain possession of it though and present it to Reonan.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. I feel that if anything, a Nautrepy has the pendant. They tend to seek out shiny objects. Please locate them in the Eastern forests of Darkon 3. Please retrieve it.
dialogsDecline: It is imperative that you retrieve this pendant and get it to Reonan!
dialogsComplete: Oh you found it! Thank you so much!
dialogsFail: A Nautrepy must have taken the pendant. Please go and check the Eastern forests of Darkon 3!

8986.name: Dream of the Fighter
8986.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Fighter needs you to collect Golden Fists to make a golden glove. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

8999.name: The Mayor's Aid
8999.description: Go speak with the Mayor of Flarine.
dialogsBegin: It appears that word of your selfless exploits has reached the Mayor of Flarine. I believe he has something important about which to speak with you. Please speak with him
dialogsAccept: The Mayor of Flarine can be found in Central Flarine. Please see what it is he requires of you.
dialogsDecline: Well, not that I can blame you. I have no time to meddle with politicians.
dialogsComplete: It is with a warm heart that I welcome you to our humble town young adventurer! The citizens of this town speak highly of all you.
dialogsFail: You haven't met Mayor of Flarine yet?

9008.name: Successor of Hero -Master-
9008.description: Hunt Down 20 regular Drillers and return to Karandur in Darken City.
dialogsBegin: So you think you're ready to become a Knight? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsAccept: Good luck, my friend. I'll be watching.
dialogsDecline: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work, Mercenary! Now you're on your way to becoming a Knight.
To commemorate this day, I have something for you.
dialogsFail: Exactly 20 Drillers, Squire. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to Knighthood.

9024.name: Successor of Hero -Hall Document-
9024.description: Retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren, who is hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis. Then deliver it and your letter to Domek the Billposter Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsBegin: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Billposter. Guard it as you would your own life.
Take it to Domek, the Billposter Sage. He resides at Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
Before you do that, however, retrieve the Hall Document from Hoiren. He's hiding somewhere in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsAccept: Luck be with you.
dialogsDecline: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsComplete: Your skill must be extraordinary if you were able to take this document from Hoiren, good work!
The Billposter Hero Roentel originally owned this document, but his pupil Hoiren stole it when he died.
Hoiren hid it away, and no one could find it until now. We deeply appreciate your efforts to return it.
dialogsFail: Such a peaceful place...if only these other Sages would stop with their chattering I could get some writing done...

9025.name: Bring Triduum
9025.description: Get the ID card that will allow you into the room with the Violet Trillipy. Hunt them down and bring 20 pieces of Triduum to Nein.
dialogsBegin: Ribenuum is useless to most humans. Maybe you have a Dwarpet friend you can give it to? Here, let me see it. These samples are too impure and even I cannot refine them without the right materials.
I need a special metal called Triduum in order to refine this. You can get it by hunting Violet Trillipy but they live deep in the Dekane Mine.
Well… If you really need the Ribenuum refined bring me 20 Triduums. You are going to need a special ID card to go in there.
dialogsAccept: Go and get an ID card from the guys I used to work with.
dialogsDecline: Ha ha ha.You can do that if you need to. I hope you are not doing this for some Dwarpet.
dialogsComplete: Here is your refined Ribenuum. But, a word of warning, if the Dwarpet Kazen asked you for this… he is thinking more than he is saying.
Kazen has hated humans for as long as I have known him and him working with you means he is on to something big. You know… there is a rumor that he had a hand in all the deaths in that mine.
You let me know if he is acting suspiciously. Maybe I can do something to help you.
dialogsFail: Why not just let it go? Go home and get some rest.

9051.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
9051.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

9076.name: Successor of Hero -Guardian-
9076.description: Defeat the guardian spirit, Venel Guardian, and get it's heart. Then please visit Capafe who is the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsBegin: Here, take this Mark of the Heroes. It along with one last item will denote your status as a true Billposter.
In the Guardian's Room, you will find a spirit called the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
Defeat this spirit, and take his heart. This will be your final test.
Once you have completed this task, present the heart to Capafe, the Billposter Guardian.
dialogsAccept: I wish you luck.
dialogsDecline: You’re almost finished, Assist. Don’t give up now.
dialogsComplete: Well done! I now officially bestow the title of Billposter upon you.
Roentel, please bless and encourage this Billposter as they follow your will!
dialogsFail: Only one recognized as a Billposter may pass. Please turn back.

9108.name: Red Muffler
9108.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Soldier needs you to collect knightlers to make a new scarf. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9121.name: Laws of Aviation (1)
9121.description: Visit Dior to learn all about flying.
dialogsBegin: Hello traveler! It looks like you've reached level 20! You know what this means right? You can now fly on your very own flying device!
Scared? Don't worry, go see the Station Manager Dior. She'll show you the ropes and get you flying in no time!
dialogsAccept: Dior is on Flarine Station. Take the elevator right in front of me. You can't miss it!
dialogsDecline: You don't have to be scared. Well... if you change your mind, do let me know! I'll be right here.
dialogsComplete: What's this? Is sent you? Oh! you want to know about flying on your own flying device? Why didn't you say so?

9133.name: Successor of Hero -Scroll-
9133.description: Go to the Plain of Bubble to meet Kurmin and give her the Golden Helmet.
dialogsBegin: I deeply appreciate what you've already done, but alas, the Helmet's journey does not end here.
It belongs with the Hersan Kurmin, in the Plain of Bubble.
The Kurmin Family has managed the house and relics of Billaon for generations. I'm sure they would reward you handsomely for its return.
dialogsAccept: Time is a-wasting, Mercenary! Hurry along, now!
dialogsDecline: No time to be showered with the appreciation and riches of a wealthy family? Very well, then...
dialogsComplete: Oh my… I can't believe it.... I've been looking for this for years. Thank you, thank you very much!
I'd like to give you something for bringing this back to the Kurmin family.
This Scroll has only been passed down to the Knights in my family line, until now. I'd like you to have it.
dialogsFail: What nice weather! Oh, I'm sorry, did you need to speak with me?

9145.name: Successor of Hero -Scroll-
9145.description: Deliver the Feather of Magic Power to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsBegin: Now, I need you to deliver this relic to Parine, Tina's helper at Saint City Station.
dialogsAccept: Take good care of that relic, and good luck!
dialogsDecline: What? You did all this just to get your filthy hands on that relic? That's just… awful. I'm speechless.
dialogsComplete: You've found it! Oh thank you, thank you, thank you! Finally, I have it! The Feather of Magic Power!
You must have been through a lot to acquire this for me. Here, I have something for you…
Take this, my friend. This Stamp Scroll will prove you are worthy to become a Successor of the Elementor Hero.
dialogsFail: I am the scion of Lillip. At the moment, I am learning from Tina about managing the Saint City Station. Why are you here? Are you forgetting something?

9183.name: Woodworking Material
9183.description: A request has gone out for $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.
9183.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: A request has gone out for Rootioe to be used as woodworking material. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9188.name: Trolling Flaris
9188.description: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill the Caveman Chief.
dialogsBegin: I have contacted the experts of Flaris history and magic to review the findings surrounding the interesting properties of the souls of the Nightmist.
Shockingly... they have come to the conclusion that these Nightmist creatures were likely once trolls themselves. The Elixir of Vitality may have given them unending life in a new form.
That explains why no evidence of trolls were found within the Leren Chasm today. The trolls of the past evolved into something new... the Nightmist.
I am curious, however, if there is something we missed along the way. Go inside the Leren Chasm once more and make sure there's nothing we left behind.
dialogsAccept: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. This trip will be your last. Make sure to leave no stone unturned, so we can close the case on the mystery of the Leren Chasm.
dialogsDecline: You have made great progress figuring out the mysteries within the Leren Chasm. Maybe there is nothing left to explore anymore.
dialogsComplete: Welcome back, adventurer! I have heard from everyone the great work you have done investigating the strange sounds within the Leren Chasm.

It seems to me the Caveman Chief you encountered was the last of its kind in Flaris. Perhaps it simply held on to life as a way to protect its kin, even those that transformed into the horrid Nightmist.
For now, I think the mystery of the Leren Chasm has been solved. Well done!
dialogsFail: Eliminate the Caveman Chief and share the news with the Mayor of Flarine.

9193.name: For the Wife
9193.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Mayer needs Kalin to make a present for his wife. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9195.name: New Lord Bang
9195.description: Search the Northern Leren Mountains for evidence of another Red bang Troupe camp.
dialogsBegin: They still exist, huh? I knew it. This can only mean there is a new leader.
Darn it! We've got to do something before it's too late!
Since there is evidence of a new leader, there must be a new group of Red Bang Troupe members hiding out somewhere.
A good friend of mine mentioned having seen some Red bang Troupe members in the Northern Leren Mountains
dialogsAccept: I am sure that the group of them live in the Northern Leren Mountains. Go now, friend, and see if you can identify a new group of troupe members.
dialogsDecline: I know I've asked for many favors, but we are so close to putting an end to this threat. Please, help me!
dialogsComplete: I see. There must be a new leader. Thank you for delivering this information.
dialogsFail: Please, hurry! We don't have much time!

9225.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
9225.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

9230.name: The First Pendant
9230.description: Bring the pendant from Hael to Reonan.
dialogsBegin: Woahhhh now, everything is finally clear. Hah...Hah... I finally remember... I can't believe this... I recall Reonan now...
We were once good friends who stood together against a great threat… only at that time… we went by different names… I'm sure you will understand in time.
Here, take this to Reonan. It's a pendant once shared amongst several old comrades… He'll understand when he sees it…
dialogsAccept: As for now, I have business to attend to. I will catch up with you guys later. Try not to miss me too much and stuff *sneer*
dialogsDecline: Well, I'm in no real hurry. Just take the pendant to Reonan whenever you have the chance.
dialogsComplete: This pendant… It was a symbol of the trust that I once shared with Hael. I've been hoping to find him for awhile now to no avail…
dialogsFail: Take the pendant to Reonan soon. I didn't give it to you as a keepsake.

9240.name: Key to the Prison
9240.description: Find a Prison Key by killing Steam Walkers.
dialogsBegin: I apologize but I have no time to talk. I have to figure a way to rescue that boy and I'm afraid the at time is limited.
At any moment the Steam Walker that put the boy there might return, so I must keep an ever vigilant watch! Maybe you COULD help me?
How about this? While I secure the perimeter, you acquire a key to open the prison door. Deal?
dialogsAccept: Great! While I secure the area, quickly retrieve a key from one of the Steam Walkers!
dialogsDecline: If you won't help me then I have no time to deal with you!
dialogsComplete: Huzzah! Mission accomplished. Good thing I was here. Who knows what might have happened. Anyway! Time for phase 2!
dialogsFail: Quickly! Quickly! Retrieve the prison key from one of the Steam Walkers! We may not have much time!

9250.name: Welcome to Azria! (2)
9250.description: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsBegin: I help protect this small town. Dangerous Masquerpets are everywhere.
I could use some help fighting them off. If you are interested, feel free to drop by and lend me your assistance.
Stay within this town and you will be safe from harm. Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsAccept: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.
dialogsComplete: Welcome, brave warrior. I hope this town serves as your safe haven during your perilous journey here.
This town could really use your help. We are surrounded in every corner of this continent.
Our people have a lot of hope, but I fear the threat grows stronger and stronger every day.
dialogsFail: Go and visit Mawrang. He is the oldest and wisest of us all. He will help you survive out in the cold.

9270.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
9270.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

9324.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
9324.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

9428.name: Welcome to Azria!
9428.description: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsBegin: Welcome to Azria, one of the coldest places in Madrigal!
This town is a haven in this dangerous place. Masquerpets have overrun the entire continent and made much of this land uninhabitable.
We see you have come a long way to get here. I bet it was a very dangerous journey! You must be very brave.
dialogsAccept: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.
dialogsComplete: Azria is a dangerous place. You are lucky you made it here and lived.
dialogsFail: Feel free to stay as long as you need to. Go and visit Gigaka, our protector. He will help you stay safe.

9444.name: Revenge of Red Bang Troupe
9444.description: Defeat the Red Bang Troupe Leader west of the Fountain of Dead Person and return Luda's family treasure.
dialogsBegin: That Red Bang Troupe is making me absolutely nuts!
They invaded our home and stole our family treasure, leaving only a note yesterday. I was absolutely horrified...
I was so scared I couldn't do anything about it. They stole my family treasure, and I am powerless to do anything.
If I knew this was going to happen, I would have donated it to the Public Office.
What can I do now? Is there anything you can do to help? Please?!
dialogsAccept: Are you serious!? Thank you! The leader of the thieves has my treasure. Their camp is just west of the Fountain of Dead person. Please, find it and bring it back to me!
dialogsDecline: Oh… okay. Never mind then. I guess my problems are none of your concern.
dialogsComplete: My Entanale Sword! Thank you so much! My family treasure has been returned!
This sword was made by Entanale Boineo, my great great grandfather. It was made out of the bones of an ancient animal...
I would like to give this to you in return. Perhaps you can keep it safe from thieves better than I can. Thank you once again, my friend.
dialogsFail: You have to find the leader of the troupe. Only he could have done this.

9452.name: Successor of Hero -Master-
9452.description: Hunt Down 20 Drillers and return to Ride in Darken City.
dialogsBegin: So you think you're ready to become a Billposter? It isn't easy, but since you've made it this far I think you're up to the challenge.
First, a simple test of your skills in combat to see if you are qualified.
Go to KhipRa and hunt down $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. Not the Small ones, or the Giants, just regular $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s. That should be easy enough.
dialogsAccept: Good luck. I'll be watching.
dialogsDecline: Giving up already? But this is the easy part.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work! Now you're on your way to becoming a Billposter.
dialogsFail: Exactly 20 Drillers. That's what you'll need to take your first steps to becoming a Billposter.

9477.name: Helper Text Book
9477.description: The Helper Text Books can be found in the flower bed behind Public Office of Flarine.
dialogsBegin: What am I going to do? Oh my... What? You're curious as to why I'm so nervous? Actually, we Helpers have a test once every year and I'm no good under pressure.
The test is very soon, and the date was just moved up all of the sudden! I am so worried! I'm a good helper, so I should pass and all, but I want to be the best!
I have never taken first place because of that know-it-all Herth, and I absolutely must beat her this year! I will do anything to come in first place and I need your help!
So will you help me, stranger?
dialogsAccept: I need lessons 1 and 2 of the Helper Text Books. I understand that both lessons can be found in the flower bed behind the Public Office. Will you bring it to me?
dialogsDecline: You know, people nowadays are only worried about themselves. Typical…
dialogsComplete: Hmmm yes! These are the ones! So this must be the range of possible questions, huh?
Yes, it all makes sense now! This is the information I needed. This will really help me put Herth in her place!
Thank you very much, my friend! Please see me anytime if you need my help.
dialogsFail: Do you have the Helper Text Books I need? Please hurry, the test is very soon. I'm so nervous!

9484.name: Replacement Tires
9484.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: The Dwarpet needs you to collect Dumptires to replace his flat tires. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9502.name: Successor of Hero -Seal-
9502.description: Retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, then take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. You can find him at the Fountain of Dead Person.
dialogsBegin: This letter of recommendation is proof of your achievements as a Ringmaster. Guard it as you would your own life.
Take it to Clamb, the Ringmaster Sage. He resides at the The Fountain of Dead Person in the Northern Leren Mountains.
Before you do that, however, retrieve the Seal of Aenn from Roy near the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning.
dialogsAccept: May Aenn’s mercy be with you always.
dialogsDecline: You've already come so far, why give up now?
dialogsComplete: The Seal of Aenn! Someone’s finally found the Aenn family symbol!
I’d always heard that Roy would steal anything of value, but I never thought he’d have a mind to take the Seal!
Your efforts are most appreciated!
dialogsFail: You're a long way from a doctor’s office… but I am still a healer of the sick and injured.

9505.name: Power in Numbers
9505.description: Kill 8 Small Bucrow & 4 Bucrow while in a party and return to the Mayor of Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Do you know about the Bucrow? They are protectors of the natural order that have existed long before man. They have since grown malicious, and attack our citizens.
I believe the sudden increase in the amount of monsters is to blame. Bucrow are very in tune with the balance of nature, and have become enraged with its disintegration
