I must warn you though. Bucrow are very strong, which is why I've asked you to unite with other champions in this task. Please, will you help us to defeat them?
dialogsAccept: You and your band of allies must travel to Saint Morning's southernmost region known as the Fantasy Desert. This is where the Bucrow primarily reside.
dialogsDecline: I might not know with any certainty how the Bucrow first began to become so vicious, but what I do know is that we must do something about them soon!
dialogsComplete: Done already!? My thanks go out to you and your allies. Sometimes companionship is the key to victory! As soon as you reach level 30, please return to me as I have another request.
dialogsFail: Please you must all hurry! We cannot sit idly by in such a dire situation.

9558.name: The Best Shield
9558.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Remina needs Luchest to make the strongest shield in the world. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9578.name: Mercenary Arms
9578.description: Gather 10 Twinkle Stones from the Aibatts, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma then bring them to Andy, the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsBegin: I suppose you've proven you're not completely useless. On to the next task!
I want you to gather the materials needed for making the weapons of the Mercenary. Try not to mess this one up, alright?
Collect 10 Twinkle Stones from Aibatts in the area, 5 Chupims from Pukepukes and 1 Poporam from Doridoma. They should be relatively easy to find.
Once you've gathered enough Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, bring them to Andy the Mercenary Master in northern Flarine.
dialogsAccept: Good luck! You're gonna need it!
dialogsDecline: Are you afraid of a couple Aibatts? I know they stink and all... but really?
dialogsComplete: Great job acquiring the Twinkle Stones, Chupims and Poporam, Vagrant. Oh, and don't worry about old Mustang. He's all bark and no bite!
A Mercenary can use both swords and axes. They each have strengths and weaknesses. Swords strike fast, but deal only moderate damage, whereas axes deal heavy damage but at a moderate speed.
Which weapon suits you best? That's a decision only you can make, young Vagrant.
dialogsFail: You need to acquire 10 Twinkle Stones, 5 Chupims and 1 Poporam before I can continue your training, Vagrant.

9587.name: Origin of Bone Bowl
9587.description: Locate Bowler, the Bowl Merchant in the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsBegin: *Gnarllll!* Hey! You there! You don't know me, right? My reputation usually precedes me. I am the strange collector!
I wanted to ask you something. Have you ever heard of the Bone Bowl? No, not just some random Bone Bowl. THE Bone Bowl!
I'm talking about the original cursed Bone Bowl.
I am looking to acquire it. Will you help me?
dialogsAccept: *Grawrrrll* Great! Head to the Garden of Rhisis and find (Bowl Merchant) Bowler! *SNARF!*
dialogsDecline: Oh come on! I can pay you as much as you want! *GNARL*
dialogsComplete: Hmmm… so the strange collector wants the Bone Bowl, huh?
Hahaha! I knew this day would come.
dialogsFail: Hello there! Are you looking for something special?

9598.name: Initiation of Champions
9598.description: Kill 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs and go back to Reonan.
dialogsBegin: Hmm, I sense an aura of greatness from you young warrior, yet a mind clouded with uncertainty and doubt.
I intend to help you realize your true inner potential. Though I am but a stranger to you, I need you to trust in me. My true identity will be revealed soon enough.
dialogsAccept: Apparently I was correct in choosing you. Well then! Please eliminate 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs residing in Northern Flaris.
dialogsDecline: Hmm, apparently I made a mistake. I believed you to be the champion I was searching for.
dialogsComplete: Ah! I admire your courage. It appears you could very well be the champion I have sought.
dialogsFail: The citizens grow ever more fearful of this situation! Please get rid of 10 Lawolfs & 5 Grownup Lawolfs.

9625.name: The Great Teacher Inisis
dialogsBegin: Search out the Great Teacher Inisis. She has a wealth of knowledge on many subjects and has produced many outstanding students. If anyone knows it would be her.
Inisis can be found at the center of Darken. Please go see her! I'm sure she will be of assistance!
dialogsAccept: But be patient! Inisis will hardly give you the answers you seek so quickly!
dialogsDecline: Changed your mind already? Guess the task wasn't that important then.
dialogsComplete: Hmm... You are new here aren't you? Have you journeyed all this way to become one of my students?
dialogsFail: Go see Inisis. She is at the center of Darken.

9651.name: Slaves to Shade
9651.description: Defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers.
dialogsBegin: You know where these monsters come from right? According to the records, they were the creation of Shade. Angered by her inability to destroy all of Roika, she plagued the lands with these foul beasts.
Shade and her monsters succeeded in taking over all of Madrigal. She was subsequently defeated by 8 brave heroes who all rose to the challenge, restoring peace to the land.
Shade is now dead, but monsters that she created still exist. In fact, they seem to be growing stronger and greater in number. I'm here in the hopes of uncovering some sort of answer.
Research is difficult with the constant threat of Tombstone Bearers around. Will you please help buy me some time by defeating them?
dialogsAccept: Thank you for your assistance. Killing 15 Tombstone Bearers should allow me ample time to complete my research.
dialogsDecline: For the sake of truth, please do not pass up my request!
dialogsComplete: I've done it!! Because of your bravery, I've found an important piece of information.
dialogsFail: I'm still in the process of research. Please go and defeat 15 Small Tombstone Bearers & 7 Tombstone Bearers while I complete my work!

9670.name: Moth Infestation (2)
9670.description: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Mothbee infestation. Could you get rid of the Lord Mothbee?
9670.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Tina is asking for further help regarding the Mothbee infestation. Could you get rid of the Lord Mothbee?
dialogsAccept: You can find the Lord Mothbee flying inbetween Northern Saint City & Flaris.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

9671.name: Magician Skills
9671.description: Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan north of Flarine. Check your map (M Key) if you lose your way.
dialogsBegin: That concludes your lesson on Magician weaponry. Now, I'll need you to visit one of the High-Dwarpets to continue your training.
Travel to Flarine and head north. You'll find a High-Dwarpet camp just south of the middle of Leren Mountains.
Speak with High-Dwarpet Hastan once you arrive. If you get lost, you can check your map (M Key) to find your way.
dialogsAccept: Good luck to you, Vagrant!
dialogsDecline: Do not be frightened by what lies ahead. This is your destiny. Speak with me again if you'd like to continue your path.
dialogsComplete: Greetings, young one! The will of Rhisis be with you! I am Hastan. Magician Master Hee mentioned that you might be stopping by.
Magicians are powerful fighters that utilize magic to defeat their enemies. Let me go over one of the basic attacks with you.
Mental Strike is a very strong magic attack that consumes Magic Points (MP) in order to be cast. This skill allows you to attack the target from a distance for a high amount of damage.
dialogsFail: Excuse me? Who are you exactly? I'm waiting for someone else right now. Take a hike!

9691.name: Vagrant Master (Mercenary)
9691.description: Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs just north of Eastern Flarine and return to Mercenary Drillmaster Mustang.
dialogsBegin: What?! Hahaha! You think you have what it takes to be a Mercenary? Oh, that's good …hic! I think you'd be better off as a comedian!
You're still here? Ugh… fine. I'll humor you just this once. If you think you are strong enough to be a Mercenary, then I'll need you to do a little something for me.
Small Aibatts have been infesting our crops just north of here. We need someone to go exterminate some of those filthy things.
Slay 20 Small Aibatts and 20 Small Mushpangs then return me when you are finished. Understand? Now get out of here, vermin!
dialogsAccept: Good luck, Vagrant. You'll need it! Hahaha!
dialogsDecline: I knew you were all talk, Vagrant. That's 30 seconds of my life I won't be getting back…
dialogsComplete: Hmmm, that's acceptable. Not bad, Vagrant! Although, I could have done it in half the time. But that's neither here nor there.
Hahaha! As if you could ever hope to compare yourself to me… Mustang the Great!
dialogsFail: What's the matter? You're not afraid of some Small Aibatts, are you?
Alright, listen carefully. Just north of here, there are several Small Aibatts. Slay 20 of them with 20 Small Mushpangs and return to me. Got it?
<Mustang mumbles something under his breath about you being… not so bright.>

9719.name: Baby Meteonyker
9719.description: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
9719.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Almani asked for Fafnirs to be exterminated, before they grow into Dragons! Please could you kill 15 of them?
dialogsAccept: You can find Fafnirs flying near the Volcano in Darkon 3, Brekin.
dialogsDecline: You don't want to help? That's okay. We'll find somebody else.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You haven't finished the task yet.

9798.name: Disguise of a Native
9798.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy that the quest was completed.
dialogsBegin: Darkon natives need you to collect Tangkask. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can get $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any type of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Good Job! You successfully completed the quest. Take this for your trouble.
dialogsFail: You need more $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9802.name: Strange Collector
9802.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Strange Collector needs you to collect Dumblings for his collection. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9809.name: Psykeeper Hero's Pendant
dialogsBegin: Just give me the ore and you have my word that I will reunite with Reonan and the rest of the gang. First I need a little time to examine the ore.
I can't leave this very moment, but here, take my pendant to Reonan. It will seal the deal! I will meet up with you again soon enough! Hehe.
dialogsAccept: Please tell Reonan I am busy with important research but will come directly to him afterwards!
dialogsDecline: Eh? You don't want to leave here because of my radiant beauty? Guess I don't blame you!
dialogsComplete: You're back! How is Ainher doing? What? This is another of the pendants!
dialogsFail: Well what are you waiting for! Take the pendant to Reonan!

9835.name: Legendary Redmantis (Part 1)
9835.description: Travel to Saint City and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint hall.
dialogsBegin: Hey you! Yeah, you! Come here for a minute… I would like to speak with about something.
My name is Rudvihil, and I am a collector or rare and expensive artifacts. I'm always on the lookout for something new and precious.
Anyway, to the point, I heard some rumors that there is a very rare artifact in Saint Morning.
I intend to acquire this artifact for my collection. I have a vast collection of artifacts and it would make a nice addition.
So, what do you say? Will you help me find this artifact?
dialogsAccept: Great! Travel to Saint City, and speak with Helgar, the connoisseur of rare and precious items. He should be located near Saint Hall.
dialogsDecline: What? You won't help me? Fine, get off my property, then!
dialogsComplete: Hello there, are you interested in any rare artifacts? I have an stunning ancient Aibatt carving here that is very unique…
Rudvihil? Hahaha! That guy will never stop hoarding rare and precious treasure.
dialogsFail: Have you found anything, yet? No? Well hurry up! I don't have all day!

9846.name: The Problem with Leyenas
dialogsBegin: What's this you speak of? Heroes? Can't say I've heard anything about that… But, I believe I know a person who may have…
Oh you want to know? Of course I will tell you… But first perhaps you could do me a favor?
I am frequently in touch with the mayors of both Saint City and Flarine. I have heard of your heroic actions and request your aid. There has been a dramatic increase in Leyena populations.
They have made it awfully hard for our workers to collect a rare ore which is a staple export here in Darken. Please defeat the Leyena and I will give you the information.
dialogsAccept: Thank you adventurer! The Leyena can be found in Eastern Darkon. Please decrease their population by killing 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas.
dialogsDecline: Hmm, what was it you needed again? My mind seems to be getting fuzzy... Since you are here, why not do some sightseeing?
dialogsComplete: Hah! It is just as I have heard. You are truly a problem saver! Now to uphold my end of the bargain!
dialogsFail: Well? I'm not getting any younger! The Leyena are found in Eastern Darkon. Please get rid of at least 20 Small Leyenas and 10 Leyenas!

9891.name: Doridori Sushi
9891.description: Collect 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs. Return to Sotta when you have the ingredients.
dialogsBegin: Finally! The time has come to learn how to make Doridori Sushi. I just need some ingredients!
I'll need to practice the recipe so that I can master it. Oh boy, Doridori Sushi is the best sushi in Madrigal! I can't wait!
Tell you what, if you help me, I will give you some of this fantastic sushi. How's that sound?
dialogsAccept: I knew you wouldn't be able to resist! Now, bring me the following materials: 12 Doridoma Keratins and 5 Mushpang Secretion. You can get them from Small Doridomas and Captain Mushpangs.
dialogsDecline: You have no idea how delicious my sushi is. Oh well. Your loss!
dialogsComplete: Ah ha! There we go! Your order is ready! I even autographed it in wasabi! Careful, it's SPICY!
dialogsFail: I know they can be hard to find, but I'd really like to learn to make it sometime this year. Hurry up, pal!

9914.name: Gene of Wagsaac
9914.description: Gather 10 pieces of Wagsaac DNA for Heitung in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: What, you thought that was it? Oh no, I have plenty more for you to do, champ!
We require more data to complete our research. Feel like helping out again?
dialogsAccept: Great! We need 10 Gene Pieces from Wagsaacs this time. We're close to cloning out first Wagsaac! Get going!
dialogsDecline: Don't want to do it, eh? You kill hundreds of small animals and you're going to preach to me about ethics?
dialogsComplete: Ohhh yeah! This is good stuff! Thanks again!
dialogsFail: Take your time, friend. We're busy making Jack in the Giggle Boxes out of Jack the Hammers and Giggle Boxes!

9931.name: Magic Quill
9931.description: Mule needs you to collect Tarin roots.
9931.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ was happy to see the quest completed.
dialogsBegin: Mule wants you to collect Tarin roots so he can make a new magic quill. Will you help?
dialogsAccept: You can collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from all types of $QUEST_END_ITEM_MON$.
dialogsDecline: You do not want to collect them? Okay.
dialogsComplete: Well done. You have successfully completed the quest.
dialogsFail: You do not have enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$.

9988.name: Pint Sized Hero
9988.description: Kill 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia and locate Nerco.
dialogsBegin: It appears as if I must again call upon you for a favor. We have reports of a missing child, but unfortunately our guards are too occupied to help.
The boy, named Nerco, apparently left a note to his mother saying he wanted to defeat monsters just like the Hero of Flaris! For his sake, please find and protect him!
dialogsAccept: His mother believes him to be in Southern Saint Morning, attempting to take on the Mia by himself. Please protect him by defeating 10 Small Mia & 5 Mia.
dialogsDecline: What? Why am I asking you to find just a KID? Kids are the future of Madrigal. You have a bad mental attitude.
dialogsComplete: Tremble ghosts, for I am the mightiest warrior in the… wait, who are you? You are interrupting my ghost slaying!
dialogsFail: Hurry and find Nerco before the Mia get to him!

9999.name: Hunting Monsters to recover Karma
9999.description: Hunting $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ will recover your Karma points.
dialogsBegin: Your Karma can be redeemed. Are you ready to pay for your sins?
dialogsAccept: Hunt $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsDecline: You have yet to pay for your sins…
dialogsComplete: Your quest has been accomplished. Your sins have been forgiven.
dialogsFail: If you are truly unwilling to fight for forgiveness, then there is no hope for you.

10002.name: The Mystery of Leren Chasm Part 2

10034.name: Petrified Wood
10034.description: Collect 10 Tainted Root and 1 Cracked Bark of Shelid.
dialogsBegin: From the information we have available, the remnant of Ishirut hides in the very heart of the catacombs.
dialogsAccept: You have already made it further than the last group, keep pushing and find out what lies in store.
dialogsDecline: You've made it so far... why give up now?
dialogsComplete: Fascinating! The bark from the large tree creature seems to have the symbol of Shelid etched on the surface... Does this mean that the catacombs were originally an altar to Shelid themself?
dialogsFail: Investigate the the catacombs further, there is still more to see.

10044.name: An Island Shrouded in Mystery
10044.description: Defeat 200 of any kind of Atrox, then return to Sunny Pang.
dialogsBegin: Those who call Coral Island their home have been unable to explore the world due to a curse placed on the island many years ago.
The cause of the cursed mist that has kept the Coral Island inhabitants trapped is unknown.
However with the mist cleared from around the island, we can finally welcome fresh new faces to help us defend our small village!
dialogsAccept: Coral Island is a dangerous place. To prove you are an adventurer capable of surviving the dangers here, I want you to go explore the island and take down 200 of any kind of Atrox.
dialogsDecline: We didn't expect everyone that arrived to be strong enough for this place. Perhaps you can return to Darken City.
dialogsComplete: I am impressed! Atrox are dangerous beasts known to cut down most creatures that approach them. You have proven yourself.
dialogsFail: Atrox are dangerous foes, you'll need to successfully defeat more of them to prove yourself to me.

10083.name: Abraxas Antitoxin (1)
10083.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

10096.name: Island Delicacies
10096.description: Defeat any kind of Kingster or Creper until you've made 200 Island Bait.
dialogsBegin: Ha! You have really made a name for yourself here on Coral Island, hero. Everyone has told me of the amazing feats you've accomplished.
If you want to prove yourself further, help us defeat the legion of Naga that have taken over the island.
dialogsAccept: To safely take on the Naga, first you'll need to gather bait made of their favorite foods. You can make bait from any type of Kingster or Creper! Meet up with Pau Pau and he'll prepare everything.
dialogsDecline: Everyone's adventure comes to a close one day. That's alright, hero.
dialogsComplete: Woaw, nice job hero! We can make plenty of bait with all this to lower the guard of the Naga! For now, take a rest. We'll make a plan of attack later.
dialogsFail: Keep fighting Kingster or Creper until you've found enough bait.

10101.name: Tigar Bites
10101.description: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Tigars around the island.
10101.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: Tigars are known to have some of the strongest teeth in all of Madrigal. If you come across $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ could you bring me a few? I'm crafting a giant dagger... it'll be HUGE!
dialogsAccept: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Tigars around the island.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll have the biggest dagger in Madrigal. Hehehe, catch me showing off to the Demians!
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

10161.name: The Cursed Wing of Destiny (2)
10161.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the sixth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the sixth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

10179.name: Keeper of the Kingdom
dialogsBegin: Lapranche has certainly slowed down our efforts to build a force that can oppose her. It's likely that the previous Keeper of the Sanctuary was transformed like all the others...
The Keeper was a force to be reckoned with, the second in command of the protective force that guarded the Guardiane Sanctuary. If the Keeper still remains... it will be a formidable challenge.
dialogsAccept: You have already done so much to help uncover the truth of the Purple Magician's terrible crimes. Defeat the Keeper if you are able... and please, be careful.
dialogsDecline: The Keeper stood guard over the grounds of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and dealt with intruders abruptly. Defeating the Keeper is a challenge even you may not be ready to handle.
dialogsComplete: Your strength is nearly beyond belief... You are a true hero, down to the very core of who you are. The Pyramid Keeper was also a hero... and now a hero who can rest.
dialogsFail: Carefully scout the grounds of the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary, and defeat whatever remains of the Pyramid Keeper.

10330.name: Jeepers Creepers
10330.description: Collect 10 Clothing Scraps and 1 Broken Shield.
dialogsBegin: A small group recently went inside the catacombs, but have not returned in several hours. I fear they have fallen to whatever creatures may be inside.
A thick webbing has appeared around the entrance, and I hear loud footsteps not far within the depths of the ruins.
dialogsAccept: Go inside and find out what happened to the group before you.
dialogsDecline: Scared of a few spiders? Those poor adventurers...
dialogsComplete: I see... so you found only the remains of their armor. It is a shame what has happened, but you seem to be strong enough to continue pushing deeper into the ruins.
dialogsFail: Investigate the disappearance of the lost adventurers.

10428.name: Crafting an Army
dialogsBegin: With the smelting complete, it's time to craft an army's worth of armor!
dialogsAccept: Alright, head back to Chenbing. Work with him to start crafting the armor we'll need to win the battle against Lapranche!
dialogsDecline: Crafting is tough work. It's not for everybody.
dialogsComplete: Well done, we have everything needed to bolster an army of adventurers against the Black Magician!
dialogsFail: Head back to Chenbing to help craft armaments.

10475.name: Stealing gems from the cursed guardian (2)
10475.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the seventh floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the seventh floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

10502.name: The Mystery of Leren Chasm Part 1

10509.name: Seeing the Light
10509.description: Find the lair of Ishirut's remnant.
dialogsBegin: The murky darkness clouding our vision of the future clears up with the use of these special herbs, when combined with a powerful cursed item. It takes a toll on me every time...

The darkness is lifting! And the truth is just as I feared... remnants of the lightning god, Ishirut, have stirred, creating a powerful beast that hides in the stormy mountains of the Garden of Rhisis...
dialogsAccept: I am too weak from the ritual to do anything about the remnant of Ishirut, but here is a map that will lead you to where the creature is hiding.
dialogsDecline: Ishirut was known to be one of the most powerful beings in existence... fear of them is nothing to be ashamed of.
dialogsComplete: Ah, the MewMew clan sent word of your arrival. I have been stationed outside this ruined temple to prevent travelers from facing death before their time has come. Inside are beasts of great power.
Only enter if you feel truly prepared for a difficult challenge. I have heard rumors that the beast in the deepest part of the ruins holds a remnant of an ancient god's power.
dialogsFail: Follow the map to find the creature's lair.

10627.name: Growing Gills
dialogsBegin: After being assigned to my post here in the Cave of Envy, I've witnessed dozens of Syliaca enter the waters of the cavern behind me. If what the mayor said is true... those Syliaca may have grown into something much stronger by now. An investigation is in order.
dialogsAccept: Head inside the cavern behind me and find out what have happened to the Syliaca.
dialogsDecline: You seem strong enough to handle a few empowered Syliaca... but maybe not.
dialogsComplete: Very interesting... so the Syliaca have turned into Overgrown Sharks after ingesting the cavern's magic waters. I am curious what else may be living within the cavern...
dialogsFail: Find out what have become of the Syliaca that entered the cavern.

10686.name: Gullah Gullah Island! (2)
10686.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

10753.name: Prepare to Dive!
10753.description: Meet with the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsBegin: Now that we know where the Leren Chasm is, I have stationed a guard outside the cave to prevent anyone from accidently going inside.
From here on adventurer, you must delve into the Leren Chasm if we are ever to know the truth. Please speak to the Leren Chasm guard when you are ready to explore the caves.
dialogsAccept: What you find in the caves of Leren Chasm may be terrifying, but I sense a special kind of bravery within you adventurer... When you are ready go speak to the guard outside the Leren Chasm.
dialogsDecline: Without you, the mystery of the Leren Chasm trolls may never be resolved. No matter though...
dialogsComplete: Welcome to the Leren Chasm. I am here to prevent those who are ill-prepared from entering and befalling an early death... I see Radion sent you though, you seem prepared.
dialogsFail: Seek out the guard in front of the Leren Chasm.

10796.name: The Mystery of the Shady Eye (2)
10796.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the sixth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the sixth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

10823.name: The Hidden Cavern
10823.description: Search for the damaged wall in the Cave of Envy.
dialogsBegin: If the water from the flood continues to affect the masquerpets in the Cave of Envy, soon they may become too strong for our forces to overcome. We must find the broken wall and see if a repair is possible.
dialogsAccept: The hole must be near the Syliaca... find it and determine if the damage is reparable.
dialogsDecline: If we leave the break in the walls of the Cave of Envy for too long, this situation will become an even bigger disaster.
dialogsComplete: So behind the wall seems to be a large, ornate cavern... What has Lapranche opened up to the world!?
dialogsFail: Find the damaged wall in the Cave of Envy.

10870.name: A Potent Mist
10870.description: Kill 30 Regal Kumai, 30 Enchanted Rider, and find the Vial of Purple Mist.
dialogsBegin: A horde of the dead have arisen inside the sanctuary...
dialogsAccept: Your first order of duty is to eliminate the dead and find any clues that may lead to Lapranche.
dialogsDecline: Do not feel guilty for slaying the creatures inside. They are long dead now.
dialogsComplete: Well done on clearing out the dead. Oh, and what's this? Interesting... a vial of purple mist. Could the mist be connected to the Purple Magic that Lapranche is said to practice?
dialogsFail: Clear out the undead minions inside the sanctuary, and search for any clue that could help us find Lapranche.

10972.name: Fresh Mountain Air
10972.description: Speak to the Storm Peak Guard.
dialogsBegin: For many years the mine that sits atop the Azria mountains was run by a group of Dwarpets. The export of crystals from the mine allowed us to build this village in the first place, long long ago.

Not only did the crystals help defend Azria Village from the monsters outside these walls, but they were once used to give life to a mechanical beast that the Dwarpets used to fight against Shade's army.
Rankashu probably wonders what is left of the mine's powerful crystals, and what may have been left behind by his people...
dialogsAccept: There is a guard outside the entrance to the Storm Peak where the Azria Mine is located, let him know that Mawrang has sent you and he may allow you to step inside the mine to search for clues.
dialogsDecline: Those are do not seek knowledge may never know true wisdom...
dialogsComplete: Oh hello, it's rare to see visitors way up here. I see, so Mawrang sent you to investigate the mine.
dialogsFail: Find the Storm Peak Guard.

11040.name: Trouble in the Sky
dialogsBegin: The weather lately has been terrible! Recently lightning has been striking airships on route to Saint City, causing delays in our shipments.
I wonder what has caused all the bad weather lately? I am still on duty here for a while longer.
Parine helps manage the Station with me. She acts as a scion of the great Elementor hero, Lillip.
dialogsAccept: Parine may know why the skies have been so angry lately. Go speak with her please!
dialogsDecline: The lightning is out of control... perhaps you can help us another time.
dialogsComplete: It is true, the airship deliveries have stopped due to lightning... We must get to the bottom of this, for Saint City.
dialogsFail: Find Parine and let her know of the airship situation.

11161.name: Davy Jones' Locker
dialogsBegin: No wonder Lapranche released the powers hidden within the Envy Depths... She has certainly bought time to work towards her own goals while you deal with this.
I believed the masquerpets that you gathered samples from were the last remaining creatures within the cavern... but certainly you hear the roar coming from within the cavern now?
dialogsAccept: Only the roar of a mighty creature emanates the cavern now... Slay whatever beast is within. If you survive, deliver a report of your victory to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsDecline: That roar is terrifying... steel your emotions and return to me when you are ready to find out what it is.
dialogsComplete: So all along the sealed chamber was an altar to an ancient being... I suppose the myths of the water god Herness may be more than a myth after all.
Well, with the Great Kraken defeated at least the danger that Lapranche brought to our feet has ended... for now.
I congratulate you on making it out of there alive. Expect the repercussions of releasing Lapranche to be upon us one day though...
dialogsFail: Head inside the Envy Depths and eliminate whatever is causing that awful noise.

11243.name: Tough as Steel
dialogsBegin: Based on Laola's instructions, you'll need to help me gather enough metal scraps for a small army... That might take a while.
dialogsAccept: To get started on the crafting materials for an army of armor, collect 200 of the Muffrin's metal buckets.
dialogsDecline: Finding the right metals will be difficult on your own...
dialogsComplete: Thank you for your efforts. I know gathering this much metal must have taken a toll on you.
dialogsFail: Collect 200 buckets from the Muffrins that roam the Deadwallderness.

11274.name: Carpentry Class
dialogsBegin: You can make furniture out of wood. Would you like to learn carpenting?
dialogsAccept: Okay, try anything on the woodcutting tools nearby. The woodcutting tools are near the Housing Manager.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Try anything on the woodcutting tools nearby. The woodcutting tools are near the Housing Manager.

11323.name: Expert Metallurgist Colack
11323.description: Speak with Colack in Saint City.
dialogsBegin: Hmmm, well I guess I will not get to keep the ring after all if it is needed to create a lightning rod.
I have heard that ore from meteorites has an interesting reaction with the ring.
dialogsAccept: Colack from Saint City could certaintly craft such a device if you can find the rare ore!
dialogsDecline: *Snarl* We will just have to weather the storm then...
dialogsComplete: The Strange Collector was smart to send you to me. With the right materials we can create a lightning rod to protect the Saint City Station.
dialogsFail: Find Colack in Saint City and see if he can assist in crafting a lightning rod.

11330.name: Grabbed by the Ghouls
11330.description: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Cavern Nightmist and the Nightmist Empress. Collect 10 Souls of the Nightmist.
dialogsBegin: The Queen Long Legs held evidence that the Elixir of Vitality was once real. But still, there have been no sightings of trolls within your journeys through the Leren Chasm.
There must be more to the Leren Chasm that has yet to be uncovered. If you are feeling brave, descend deeper within the caves, and see what may be waiting for us.
dialogsAccept: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Queen Long Legs this time to find new information.
dialogsDecline: The Queen Long Legs was a powerful foe. I am sure the remaining Masuqerpets within the Leren Chasm will only get stronger. Rest here for now if you are not ready.
dialogsComplete: The souls of the Nightmist creatures have an interesting property... when looking through the glassy orb that contains the soul itself, it faintly looks like the face of a troll.
dialogsFail: Eliminate 20 Cavern Nightmist and the Nightmist Empress, and collect 10 Soul of the Nightmist.

11338.name: The Mystery of Leren Chasm Part 3

11343.name: The Black Magician Returns
11343.description: Report to the Mayor of Darken City.
dialogsBegin: Throughout history the Black Magician has changed from person to person... the two best known are Great Magician Loala and the one you've just released... Lapranche.
While Loala has stood down from her post as the Black Magician, Lapranche's mind was enslaved by Shade, and granted an incredible dark power...
For a while we were safe with Lapranche sealed away by Bubble's magic, but Lapranche will surely send disasters our way to distract us while she builds her power back up.
You should go speak to the Mayor of Darken City as quickly as possible to see if anything has been reported...
dialogsAccept: Check with the Mayor of Darken City and see if news of a disaster has been reported!
dialogsDecline: Whyyyy, why won't you help us? Are you secretly working with Shade!?
dialogsComplete: So Lapranche was released from her prison after all these years...
dialogsFail: Go speak with the Mayor of Darken City!

11496.name: Curiosity Killed the Cat (2)
11496.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

11505.name: Weapon of the Future
11505.description: Defeat the Crystal Demon Lord to obtain the Clockworks Core, then return to Rankashu in Darkon.
dialogsBegin: The dream of building a new weapon to defend Madgrial is starting to feel real. The only thing standing in our way is the Crystal Demon Lord.
dialogsAccept: Go collect the Clockworks Core that the Crystal Demon Lord has been guarding all these years. Once you've collected the Clockworks Core, I'm sure that Rankashu would appreciate an update on your progress...
dialogsDecline: Without the Clockworks Core there is no hope to build a new weapon.
dialogsComplete: This is incredible!!! My kin was in Storm Peak all along... and a Clockworks Core was being guarded there, too!? Perhaps the future of Madrigal is brighter than I thought...
I will spend my days trying to understand this Clockworks Core, perhaps one day Rankashin and I will successfully create the strongest Clockworks of all time!
dialogsFail: Destroy the Crystal Demon Lord so I may finally bring a new Clockworks into the world!

11579.name: Witch in the Tower (1)
11579.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the third floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the third floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

11580.name: Collect Whispering Leaves from Risem
11580.description: Bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$x $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ back to me to prove the strength of your love!
dialogsBegin: In their spare time, Risems collect leaves that whisper sweet nothings. Spread love around Madrigal by bringing these $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ back to me!
dialogsAccept: I'm so glad to see how in love you are. Go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Risems in Darken, then return to me.
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: Can you hear the leaves speak? Soon everyone will know how special your love is!
dialogsFail: I'm sorry, were you unable to find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? Perhaps they only appear for those truly in love.

11713.name: Alchemy Class
dialogsBegin: Once you learn the alchemy, you can brew your own buff potion to carry with. Want to learn?
dialogsAccept: Good. Try anything on the caldron nearby. Caldron is near the magic shop.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Try anything on the caldron nearby. Caldron is near the magic shop.

11749.name: Supercharged
11749.description: Locate the Altar of Violet, supercharge the lightning rod, then report to Tina.
dialogsBegin: Aha, we've done it! The lightning rod is complete!
dialogsAccept: Supercharge the lightning rod by visiting the Altar of Violet, then deliver the lightning rod to Tina and hope that it protects the Station.
dialogsDecline: Without power the lightning rod we've built has no use...
dialogsComplete: Thank you for delivering the lightning rod! I believe with this installed our airships will be safe.
dialogsFail: You cannot deliver the lightning rod until has been supercharged...

11761.name: Shot Through the Heart
11761.description: Speak with the Guardiane Sanctuary guard.
dialogsBegin: A hole in the heart of the Guardiane Sanctuary has been torn asunder! Purple magic has ripped open a portal to a sad, twisted version of the once peaceful haven.
Reports show that all the inhabitants were killed and raised as bloodthirsty masquerpets... this is no doubt the doing of Lapranche. She is causing chaos to bide time, just as we expected!
For now we must pause our preparations to deal with the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsAccept: A guard has been posted out front of the portal... go speak with them. Prepare to clear out the Guardiane Sanctuary.
dialogsDecline: Are you really so weak as to run away from danger, after all you've done!?
dialogsComplete: Laola sent word of your arrival. The events that Lapranche have put into place are tragic... all the inhabitants of the Guardiane Sanctuary are dead. And yet... they live.
dialogsFail: Go find the guard posted outside the Guardiane Sanctuary portal, in the heart of Guardiane.

11916.name: Abraxas Antitoxin (2)
11916.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

12021.name: Lost Kin
dialogsBegin: I wish you the best on your journey, however just know that the Storm Peak is terrifying. Only step foot within if you are truly prepared.
dialogsAccept: Many dangers lie ahead... but I trust you to take them head on and emerge victorious, warrior. Enter the Storm Peak and find out what lies ahead.
dialogsDecline: It is not too late to turn back, entering the Storm Peak is almost certain death.
dialogsComplete: Heh!? What is one of your kind doing here? I haven't seen any living creatures other than these puppets of Shade for years now...
dialogsFail: Head inside the Storm Peak when you are ready.

12049.name: Rumble in the Mountains
dialogsBegin: Strange sounds have been coming from the Leren Mountains. I recall Martinyc once speaking of a myth about creatures that roam deep within the mountain caves.
Could you go check with her to see if she has any information about what could be causing this disturbance?
dialogsAccept: Martinyc is likely reading her books as always. Go speak with her to find out more information.
dialogsDecline: Leren Mountains is a dangerous place. I do not blame you for wanting to stay within the safety of Flarine.
dialogsComplete: Oh... the Mayor sent you! And he says that there has been a disturbance in the Leren Mountains...
dialogsFail: Seek out Martinyc for information on the rumblings of Leren Mountains.

12090.name: A Shocking Conclusion
12090.description: Kill 20 Old Ruts, 10 Bolt Otem, and the Temple Guardian.
dialogsBegin: So many mysteries still to unfold... but I believe you are now close to the heart of the catacombs.
dialogsAccept: Enter once more and clear out the remnant of Ishirut if you are capable of doing so. Prepare yourself before entering again, for I fear the beast within the depths of the ruins is far stronger than you could imagine.
dialogsDecline: After all this effort... now is when you back away from danger?
dialogsComplete: What you have uncovered has tremendous impact on our knowledge of the past! Congratulations on making it through the deadly Rhisis Catacombs, and uncovering the secrets of the past.
Based on the evidence you have gathered, we believe that the Rhisis Catacombs were once a holy ground for the god of earth, Shelid.
Along the way, a feud between Shelid and Ishirut must have occurred, leaving behind remnants of both gods that empowered the masquerpets that would eventually call the catacombs their home.
dialogsFail: Eliminate the remnant of Ishirut and anything in your way to get there.

12128.name: Heart of Iron (2)
12128.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fifth floor of the Forsaken Tower.

dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

12178.name: Hard Shell of the Creper
12178.description: You may find tough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Creper around the beach area.
12178.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: After all that seafood I couldn't eat another bite! For this next invention, I need $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the large crabs called Creper. From their hard carapace I will craft the strongest of armors. I forsee a fate in which doning this armor will save Coral Island!
dialogsAccept: You may find tough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Creper around the beach area.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll have armor enough to defend Coral Island against all evil!
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

12194.name: Lizard People
12194.description: Collect evidence of defeating at least 1000 Small Naga, Naga, or Captain Naga. After that, defeat the Lord Naga and Overlord Naga.
dialogsBegin: I hope you're feeling rested after making all that bait with Pau Pau!
It's time to go on the offensive and take down as many of the Naga as we can.
dialogsAccept: Okay hero, go out there and defeat the Naga before they come eat us!
dialogsDecline: The Naga are ferocious, there's no shame in saying no.
dialogsComplete: Incredible! Truly amazing! You've conquered the Naga, and nearly all of Coral Island!
Hopefully soon our village can sleep without keeping one eye open.
dialogsFail: Keep going! You need to defeat more Naga.

12205.name: The Third Eye Opens
12205.description: Collect 5 Black Heroca and 1 Black Curse Book.
dialogsBegin: I will grant you one reading, but I require special materials to perform the ritual.
dialogsAccept: Please bring me a Black Curse Book and 5 Black Heroca from the Garden of Rhisis.
dialogsDecline: Do not fear the future, for it is inevitable.
dialogsComplete: With these items I can perform the ritual to read from the fabric of time. We will finally know the true meaning of these storms!
dialogsFail: Search the Garden of Rhisis for a Black Curse Book and the Black Heroca plant.

12228.name: The Sea King Returns
dialogsBegin: The great Sea King of Coral Island has finally returned to wreck havoc upon the land.
The locals told me that getting near the beast could cause mortals to lose their mind...
This battle will take all the strength we can muster. If you make it out alive, go back to Darken City, and let the mayor know about all that happened here.
dialogsAccept: The only path forward to end the curse of the Sea King is to slay the beast in its lair. Go forth and do the deed, for Coral Island!
dialogsDecline: Those who lose their mind to the Sea King are said to become faceless.
dialogsComplete: Welcome back from Coral Island, hero! And what a story to tell, it's true that Coral Island is a fascinating place.
BoBu and the Coral Island villagers sent something by mail for you as a way to say thanks. Perhaps they were too shy to give it to you themselves!
dialogsFail: The Sea King consumes all who look into the void.

12244.name: Inky Darkness
12244.description: Defeat 500 of any type of Kraken.
dialogsBegin: I hope you are ready for our final challenge hero... According to legend, once every few hundred years the Sea King will release spawn onto Coral Island.
A strange darkness has began to fill the waters of Coral Island, so it seems as if the legend is true.
Please help us stave off the spawn of the Sea King!
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Find where the Sea King has released their spawn, and defeat as many as you can. Let BoBu know once you've finished!
dialogsDecline: Soon the inky darkness will overflow Coral Island, and we will be engulfed...
dialogsComplete: Hohoho! You really do have a mysterious power within you, don't you hero?
dialogsFail: Will we become faceless like those that failed before us?

12326.name: Demian Deviants
12326.description: Kill 15 Demian and find the Legend of Leren Mountains, then return to Martinyc.
dialogsBegin: I once had a book that contains legends of the beasts that live within the caves of the Leren Mountains... but it was stolen by a pack of Demians during my research.
If you return my book to me I may be able to help.
dialogsAccept: I have a feeling that the Demians still have my book of legends. Search for my book in Madren Town. You may have to get your hands a bit dirty...
dialogsDecline: Madren Town is no place for commoners to travel. I could never expect you to risk your life for my book. Thank you for listening to me anyway.
dialogsComplete: You found my book, thank you so much! Now to find the legend of the Leren Chasm...
dialogsFail: Please find my book! I'm positive it is still in Madren Town.

12356.name: Clear the Paths
12356.description: Defeat 300 of any kind of Tigar, then return to Talus.
dialogsBegin: Word has been going around the village about a strong new visitor that can hold their own against the ferocities of Coral Island.
The number of Tigars on the island have exploded recently, and we're not sure why. It's hardly safe to walk along the paths of Coral Island anymore.
dialogsAccept: If you are willing to help us, go hunt enough Tigars to keep our paths safe for a while. Around 300 should do.
dialogsDecline: Perhaps no one is powerful enough to defeat the Tigars.
dialogsComplete: Incredible, thank you for your efforts! We can safely travel around the land paths of the island again.
dialogsFail: Tigars hide in the grass, waiting to strike their prey. In just one NaNosecond they pounce to attack.

12810.name: Master Grade (4)
dialogsBegin: We’re almost done, don’t worry. But for now, let’s keep going?
And yes, as usual, same rules!
This time, it will be from level 90 to 100! So, shall we go?
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

dialogsBegin: One more and then it’s the last!
This time, it will be from level 100 to 110! So, shall we go?

dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.

dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

13434.name: Fishing Class
dialogsBegin: Once you get to know thrill of fishing, it's hard to get away from it. What do you say, learn?
dialogsAccept: Good. Then go to the nearest river and try fishing. Whether you succeed or fail, it'll help you a lot.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Go to the nearest river and try fishing. Whether you succeed or fail, it'll help you a lot.

Like last time, I take your levels and you go back up! As simple as that!
And like last time, if you want to resume your previous progression, you can cancel the quest, you will resume the progression of the latter by resuming the quest!
This time, it will be from level 70 to 80! So, shall we go?
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!

13597.name: Find Your Bearings
dialogsBegin: Long ago I sailed into the mist that surrounded this island, hoping to discover something new and untouched in the land of Madrigal.
I found Coral Island nestled deep into the clouds, but something kept me from ever leaving.
The mist that covered the island held some magic that prevented those who arrived from escaping.
dialogsAccept: With Coral Island open to all, we may begin seeing more travelers arrive over time. For now, go introduce yourself to Sunny Pang. Sunny Pang will help you in your adventures around the island.
dialogsDecline: Take your time, the island has a lot to offer. Come back to me when you are ready.
dialogsComplete: Wow, it's a real adventure! It's been so long since we've had anyone come visit Coral Island. I wasn't sure this day would ever come!

13674.name: Kill Cardpuppets
13674.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!

13744.name: Venomous Vendetta
13744.description: Defeat 60 Prismatic Cobra, the Twinstrike Den Mother, then 60 Twinstrike Cobra.
dialogsBegin: Have you heard of the legendary King of the Beasts? Brace yourself, adventurer, for he is not one to be easily defeated.
Before you can even set foot in the presence of the King, you must navigate through a winding path teeming with a vicious monsters.
dialogsAccept: Venture forth and cleanse The Wilds of the fearsome cobras and their master, the Twinstrike Den Mother. Clearing an opening will grant you the breathing space needed to strategize and prepare for what's to come.
dialogsDecline: Should a mere handful of these snakes cast doubt upon your resolve, the prospect of facing Beast King Khan becomes a distant dream!
dialogsComplete: With the serpents vanquished, your valor shines brightly, hero. Savor a brief rest, but keep your mind sharp, for another battle awaits when you re-enter the untamed Wilds!
dialogsFail: Stay focused, adventurer. Venture back to the Wilds, and press on until the Prismatic Cobras and Twinstrike Den Mother are no more.

13775.name: Bird Assassins (2)
13775.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the third floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
