13792.name: Pirates and Their Pet
13792.description: Collect 30 Pristine Pirate Lens from any kind of Meral, and a Gigantic Feline Fang from a Lord Tigar.
dialogsBegin: Your reputation continues to grow in our little village, hero!
The Meral pirates of Coral Island have managed to tame a Lord Tigar. Those thieves have threatened to come rob and destroy our homes.
dialogsAccept: Defeat the pirates and their gigantic pet before they destroy everything we've built!
dialogsDecline: I wouldn't want to be eaten by a Lord Tigar either. Understandable.
dialogsComplete: I knew you could do it, hero! For now we can rest, knowing that our village is safe from the Meral pirates and their Lord Tigar!
dialogsFail: Merals and their pet Tigar are terribly powerful. You'll need to be strong to defeat them.

13842.name: Bead of the Black Magician (2)
13842.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

14045.name: Mission Improbable
14045.description: Search for where the Dorian and Okean live.
dialogsBegin: Hahaha! I cannot thank you enough for all that you have done for our village, hero! Only the most powerful of masquerpets remain a threat to our village now.
We rarely see the Dorian and Okean creatures approach the village. However with so many other Island evils defeated, I fear they may leave their lair to take advantage of the situation!
dialogsAccept: Go seek out where the Dorian and Okean live. We'll need as much information as we can get if we expect to defeat them!
dialogsDecline: What!? You can't possibly be scared of a few more masquerpets after all we've been through together!
dialogsComplete: Well done, hero! With this information we have a chance to defeat the Dorian and Okean before they can attack!
dialogsFail: Keep searching, the Dorian and Okean make their homes in the waters of Coral Island.

14082.name: Gotta Catch Them All
14082.description: Collect 500 Erons, Krasec, Mineral, and Guru.
dialogsBegin: We won't be able to craft any armor until Nein has completed smelting the Muffrin's buckets into something suitable. But once Nein is complete, we will need several materials only found from rare creatures known as Catchers.
dialogsAccept: Catchers can be found all over Madrigal, but luckily for you all the most common catchers appear in Darkon 3. Collect 500 of each Catcher's material, then head back to Nein to collect the smelted metal.
dialogsDecline: Collecting materials from Catchers is quite simple... I have a book on how to gather them in my tent if you need a reference.
dialogsComplete: Perfect timing! I just finished smelting down all the metal into something of use.
dialogsFail: Catchers are rare, but Darkon 3 has them all. Keep looking, and make sure to equip your Collector weapon to harvest a Catcher after you defeat it.

14163.name: Conquering the King
14163.description: Collect the Oversized Heart from Beast King Khan.
dialogsBegin: Beast King Khan, the sovereign of the Wilds, holds dominion over all the untamed creatures dwelling within its depths. His fury befalls any who dare venture too close to his inner sanctum.
Legend speaks of the King's chambers as housing extraordinary treasures, granting those who uncover them unparalleled power. Are you prepared to test the truth of these legends?
dialogsAccept: Your time has come to confront the King, hero. Stand against the mighty King Beast Khan, and collect the spoils of your brave endeavors!
dialogsDecline: Take all the time you require to make your preparations. The Beast King will surely remain within.
dialogsComplete: Astounding, hero! You've vanquished the very King of Beasts himself!
dialogsFail: Return to me if you emerge victorious against Beast King Khan.

14231.name: Curiosity Killed the Cat (1)
14231.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

14438.name: Herbology Class
dialogsBegin: You can gather herbs with a hoe. Want to learn how to gather herbs?
dialogsAccept: Good. Then go out into the field and try to gather some. It will be a great help, whether you succeed or not.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Go out into the field and try to gather some. It will be a great help, whether you succeed or not.

14566.name: Master Grade (6)
dialogsBegin: Here we are! This is one of the last missions I have for you at the moment. Are you still motivated?
This time, it will be from level 110 to 120! So, shall we go?
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

14629.name: To The Skies, For Fun!
14629.description: Kill the Mothbees and return to Mr. Flyff.
dialogsBegin: Happy 20th to us! Now that we've looked back on the last 20 years, we arrive to today. Flyff Universe was launched in May of 2022, and brings Madrigal to many different corners of the world.
As we continue to appreciate Flyff and its memories over the next 20 years, why don't you do one final, iconic task for me?
I want you to head back to flaris and speak with Mr. Flyff, right after you kill some Mothbees on your flying device!
dialogsAccept: He's waiting for you!
dialogsDecline: He's going to wait for another 20 years, no problem.
dialogsComplete: Welcome back! As promised, here's your token of participation, wear it proudly.
dialogsFail: He's waiting for you!

14693.name: High Quality Goods
dialogsBegin: Smelting all this metal down for use will take a while. You may want to find an armorsmith to determine what else will be needed until I finish my work.
dialogsAccept: Out in the Village of Kan there is a talented craftsman named Chenbing Khan who can guide you further.
dialogsDecline: Well you could just wait here... but time is ticking, better to get other tasks out of the way.
dialogsComplete: It's nice Nein thinks enough of me to send you my way. I run a humble armor shop here in my village, and know all the secrets of how to improve simple weapons into deadly munitions.
dialogsFail: Go find Chenbing in the Village of Kan and give him a hand collecting crafting materials.

14743.name: Something Fishy
14743.description: Meet with the guard outside the Envy Depths.
dialogsBegin: Thank you for finding the break in the wall... I have sent a guard to prevent unsuspecting travelers from entering the cavern.
I believe our next step will be to explore the cavern and see what Lapranche has unleashed upon us...
dialogsAccept: Please travel back to the cavern and speak with the guard out front for your next assignment.
dialogsDecline: Oh... is there another assignment you are tied up with already?
dialogsComplete: Hello there, I was expecting you.
dialogsFail: Seek out the guard in front of the Envy Depths.

14810.name: Kill Tombstone Bearer
14810.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: The power of your love have vanquished the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat, thank you!
dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

14822.name: Minotaur Maze (1)
14822.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

14934.name: The Mystery of the Shady Eye
14934.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the sixth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the sixth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

14962.name: Brother in Arms
dialogsBegin: There is no hope in standing against Lapranche on our own. We must build an army of warriors, ensuring each is equipped with the weapons and armor needed to succeed.
dialogsAccept: In the Deadwallderness lives a smelter who has experience with unique requests. Tell Nein of our plan, and see what help he can offer.
dialogsDecline: *Scoff* What, will you smelt the materials for equipment all on your own?
dialogsComplete: So there's trouble... Well if Laola has sent you, I am much obliged to help if I can.
dialogsFail: Find Nein in the Deadwallderness, and see what he requires to help us equip an army.

15022.name: Magic Mushrooms
15022.description: Collect a sample of Flaris Fungi from a Lord Mushpang.
dialogsBegin: Within this book lies the secrets to the distubances in the Leren Mountains...
The legend states that long ago packs of trolls ruled the creatures that made the Leren Mountains their home.
Through disease, famine, and bickering betweeen Masquerpets, the trolls retreated from the Leren Mountains into the caves.
The caves were said to contain magical mushrooms that could prolong the life of those who ate them, and it is said that the trolls who once lived in the cave may still live there, in the darkness.
Perhaps a sample of the local fungi could hold some clues...
dialogsAccept: A Lord Mushpang roams just north of Eastern Flarine... Bring a sample of the giant mushroom to the cook Sotta, who can tell you more about the magical properties of Flaris fungi.
dialogsDecline: Oh... are you allergic to mushrooms!? Nevermind... perhaps we can find another person for the job.
dialogsComplete: Ah, Flaris fungi! The mushrooms of Flaris have always been said to have magical properties...
dialogsFail: Collect a sample of the Lord Mushpang and deliver it to Sotta.

15174.name: Army of the Dead
15174.description: Kill 80 Skeletal Militants and the Skeleton General.
dialogsBegin: These armaments are a good foundation to work off of for now... but to bring a new Clockworks to life, we need a powerful core of energy.
When the masquerpets invaded Storm Peak, the Crystal Demon Lord led an army of undead deep within the mountains and sealed away the last known energy core produced by my people...
The Demon Lord hides behind its skeletal minions, so to even have a chance at retriving the energy core we will need to eliminate the Skeletal Militants along with the Skeleton General.
dialogsAccept: The Skeletal Militants are formidable foes. The Skeleton General is said to use sharp blades affixed to its back to rip through anything that gets in its way.
dialogsDecline: There's no way we can get to the Demon Lord without first killing its minions...
dialogsComplete: Your power is tremendous! With your help I have made more progress in creating a new Clockworks than I have in my years out here on my own.
dialogsFail: You couldn't find the Skeletal Militants and their general? Head to the valley far below.

15199.name: Creepy Crawlers
15199.description: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Radioactive Long Legs and obtain the Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.
dialogsBegin: While inside the Leren Chasm there were no sign of the trolls? Go back inside and push deeper within the caves to look for more evidence.
dialogsAccept: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm once again. You will need to go past where you faced the Cavern Larva this time to find more information.
dialogsDecline: The situation will only become more dangerous the deeper within the Leren Chasm you go. Stop now if you are scared.
dialogsComplete: Perhaps this Broken Vial was once an Elixir of Vitality. It seems the magic within was used long ago, however...
dialogsFail: Eliminate 20 Radioactive Long Legs, and collect a Broken Vial from the Queen Long Legs.

15297.name: Locku, Leader of the MewMew
dialogsBegin: I will share with you an explanation of our disdain for the Otems... We believe that eons ago, Otems stole the remaining power from an ancient god named Shelid that was a bastion of protection for this land long ago.
While you may have proven yourself enough to YaoRin to speak to me, you must further show that you are worthy to receive the MewMew clan's assistance.
dialogsAccept: Thin the herd of Totemia that taint the Southern Hillid Mountains and destroy their leader. If you can take down the leader of the Totemia, then you have earned our trust enough for YaoRin's help... once.
dialogsDecline: If you refuse this task, the MewMew will not assist you in your mission.
dialogsComplete: You have earned the MewMew clan's trust... for now.
dialogsFail: Go defeat Totemia and eliminate their leader.

15405.name: Call of the Siren
dialogsBegin: I am curious if additional life lives within the cavern. Sadly whatever remains in the tainted waters has likely gone feral by now. More samples from the masquerpets within may reveal the true nature of what this place represents.
dialogsAccept: Go back inside the cavern and collect samples from any masquerpets that remain.
dialogsDecline: There's no time to worry over what you may encounter... Trust in your own power.
dialogsComplete: Wow, these artifacts are pulsing with power! No normal being could handle something like this without becoming corrupted. It appears as if these artifacts have been present here for hundreds or thousands of years...
dialogsFail: Collect samples from any remaining masquerpets that are in the cavern.

15421.name: The Beginnings
15421.description: Kill the Aibatts the mayor of Flarine told you about.
dialogsBegin: Happy 20 year anniversary! Why don't you let me take you on a leisurely trip through a little history in celebration? As a reward, my mayor friends and I will reward you with a special glow.
The rest of the city mayors and I will guide you through some iconic Flyff experiences, and tell you about some milestones.
The first and biggest milestone this 20 year old game hit was the grand opening, this month 20 years ago in Japan!
As you might expect, the world of Madrigal looked quite different at that time... I was still a newly elected mayor! My only friends were the mayors of Saint City and Darken back then.
You know, the only continents that were formed at that time were Flaris, Saint Morning, The Garden of Rhisis, and Darkon 1. If you'd like to see some pictures, check out the article on our website.
dialogsAccept: I'll be waiting!
dialogsDecline: Well, that's a shame. Happy anniversary anyway!
dialogsComplete: Nice! This is nostalgic... It's been a while since I've seen an Aibatt kill mission.
Go ahead and meet with the mayor of Saint City. He's a great storyteller.
dialogsFail: I'll be waiting!

15526.name: An Evil Set Free
dialogsBegin: Just one binding is left... we must break it so I can grant you new strength!
dialogsAccept: That foolish clown thought they hid his cache of power out of reach of my minions... HA! How wrong he was... Collect the cache and my bindings to this place will finally be broken! No one will be able to stop me either... unless that rat Reodos is still around.
dialogsDecline: ARGH!! You must set me free!
dialogsComplete: Oh no... that Ancimys was one shackled by Bubble himself! It was once an ancient wizard with powerful black magic... this is very bad news.
dialogsFail: You are just as foolish as the clown... find his cache of power!

15666.name: A Harey Situation
15666.description: Kill 30 Frozen Hare Guard and 1 Frozen Hare Assassin.
dialogsBegin: So a Dwarpet named Rankashu sent you to look for scraps that could be used to build another weapon... interesting. I have lived my life reflecting on the effects of the last time the Dwarpets made a weapon... the Clockworks.

Creating the Clockworks weapon brought Madrigal salvation... until Shade turned our weapon against us. The Clockworks rampaged throughout the lands, destroying villages and the people who lived in them. Clockworks was eventually contained... but is no longer a threat to Shade.
All the other Dwarpets have long died or left the Storm Peak... but perhaps with your help, we can gather materials to build a new weapon to stop Shade once and for all.
dialogsAccept: Frozen Hare Guards have completely blocked off the path leading deeper within the mountains. If you can take down their leader we can make a foothold further ahead.
dialogsDecline: You were my one hope of continuing work on a new weapon... please reconsider.
dialogsComplete: Well done! With the Frozen Hare Assassin out of the way we can continue to explore.
dialogsFail: Eliminate 30 Frozen Hare Guards and their leader, the Frozen Hare Assassin.

15776.name: Building a Weapon
15776.description: Collect 30 Yetti Hammers from the Enraged Yetti, and 15 Hound Harness from the Saphyryan Hounds.
dialogsBegin: With the guards out of our hair we can start collecting supplies to start building a brand new weapon!
The Enraged Yetti and Saphyryan Hounds that live in the valley below have weapons and armor we can use to forge the basis of a mechanical beast like Clockworks.
dialogsAccept: Head down to the valley and collect Yetti Hammers and Hound Harnesses, they'll come in handy for crafting...
dialogsDecline: The hounds only bite a little bit...
dialogsComplete: Yes, this will do nicely! I can start forging a new Clockworks with these materials. But there's one thing we're missing...
dialogsFail: Collect Yetti Hammers and Hound Harnesses from the masquerpets in the valley below.

15859.name: Throwing Shade
15859.description: Collect 5 Symbol of Shade from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsBegin: Well you've proven yourself to have some strength at least. There are still three more bindings to shatter though.
dialogsAccept: You won't find anymore Symbols of Shade with that same level of power. I don't care where you get them from, but bring me 5 normal Symbols of Shade to break the next binding. Symbols of Shade drop from Violet masquerpets.
dialogsDecline: WHAT!? You don't trust me or something?
dialogsComplete: Wahahahaha! You really are something, aren't you! I'm surprised you were powerful enough to take down so many Violet masquerpets. And with that, the second binding has been released!
dialogsFail: Can't you figure this out on your own? Go kill Violet masquerpets for their Symbols of Shade!

15932.name: Kill Doridoma
15932.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: The power of your love have vanquished the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat, thank you!
dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

15935.name: Sage Advice
dialogsBegin: I feel we are getting close to solving the mystery behind the magic mushrooms in Flaris...
The wise sage Radion in the North of Leren Mountains has lived in Flaris longer than most residents have been alive.
dialogsAccept: Go speak with the sage Radion and see if he knows anything about the power within the Elixir of Vitality!
dialogsDecline: Radion is a bit of a hermit, but he means no harm. I cannot force you to speak to him if you do not want to, though.
dialogsComplete: Hello adventurer... I see Marche has sent you to me with something interesting in hand.
dialogsFail: Speak with Radion to find out information about the magic within the Elixir of Vitality.

15966.name: An Old Gift From an Old Friend
15966.description: Deliver the broken Wooden Sword to Bulrox, as a gift from the mayor.
dialogsBegin: Hello there. My friend in Flarine said you'd be coming. Now... where was the story?
Right. You just killed some Aibatts, and while that's something everyone is familiar with, there are some experiences that the veterans only know about.
Were you around when you had to level your skills by using them?! Yep, different world back then.
Have you ever had to repair your weapon? Until the 9th version of Flyff, players like yourself had to repair their weapons over time...

As a matter of fact... I happen to have an 18 year old relic of mine which I never got to repair! My friend Bulrox used to love these things. Why don't you give it to him for me, as an Anniversary gift?
dialogsAccept: I hope he still has the equipment to repair it, it's a sentimental piece... After you give it to Bulrox, the mayor of Darken will have some more to tell you.
dialogsDecline: Ah. He probably doesn't have the equipment for it anymore anyway.
dialogsComplete: Wow! I never thought I'd see one of these in this condition again! This is an incredible gift for a weapons' master, I'll be spending all my time off work fixing this.
dialogsFail: I hope he still has the equipment to repair it, it's a sentimental piece... After you give it to Bulrox, the mayor of Darken will have some more to tell you.

16023.name: Orbs of Power
16023.description: Collect ten Ultima from the giants of Coral Island and treasure chests in The Wilds.
dialogsBegin: Your arrival has come at a critical time, hero. Bring me Ultima, and in return I shall grant you the key to ultimate power.
dialogsAccept: Collect Ultima from the giant creatures that live on Coral Island, or from chests of plunder deep in The Wilds.
dialogsDecline: Without Ultima I cannot grant the ultimate power you seek.
dialogsComplete: Well done, hero... I bestow upon you the power of the Ultimate Orb. Combine this with Shining Oricalkum and obtain ultimate power!
dialogsFail: I need more Ultima to complete the ritual.

16064.name: Kill Wagsaac
16064.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: The power of your love have vanquished the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat, thank you!
dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

16084.name: Over Encumbered
16084.description: Collect 10 Dungeoneer's Pack and 1 Broken Sword.
dialogsBegin: One thing still troubles me though... The thick webbing around the entrance can be explained by the spiders, but what creature could have such loud, stomping footsteps?
dialogsAccept: Go deeper into the ruins and find out what is making that loud thumping noise.
dialogsDecline: I won't blame you for avoing whatever beast awaits the next group of adventurers. It sounds big...
dialogsComplete: Sadly it seems the adventurers all fell to the power of the the massive gorilla inside the ruins... I believe the group would have wanted you to finish what they set out to do. Here, take their belongings. Perhaps it will help.
dialogsFail: Investigate the loud sound of footsteps within the catacombs.

16190.name: Collect Rainbow Flowers
16190.description: Head to the Plateau of Silence in Saint Morning, and retrieve the Wild Rainbow Flowers.
dialogsBegin: Welcome! We require flowers blessed by lovers. Could you please collect Rainbow Flowers, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: Wonderful! The rare flowers grow near the large tree in Saint Morning where no one flies.
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: These flowers are perfect. With your help I can now bless all of Madrigal with love!
dialogsFail: Oh no, that's not right. The flowers are in Saint Morning. If you get lost, remember to check your map!

16341.name: Poor Unfortunate Souls
dialogsBegin: With the Overgrown Sharks out of the way, you can find out what lies deeper within the cavern.
dialogsAccept: Go back inside the cavern and seek out what caused the Cave of Envy to flood.
dialogsDecline: Don't give up now, you've nearly figured out the secret to this cave.
dialogsComplete: It's incredible that life has been hidden here this whole time! It's a shame the Mermaid Beauties were so vicious. Likely influenced by the magical waters just as the Syliaca were.
dialogsFail: Go deeper into the cavern.

16533.name: King of the Pirates!
16533.description: Defeat the Overlord Meral to collect the Purple Pirate Insignia.
dialogsBegin: Woaw, welcome to Coral Island hero! Let me tell you a story of legend, if you don't mind.
Long ago, a huge Meral was once blessed by Shade. The Meral grew twisted and grotesque, but filled with dark power.
Soon the Overlord Meral became the King of the Pirates of Coral Island, ruling with an iron hook.
dialogsAccept: Wehehehe, if you defeated that Overlord Meral maybe YOU could become King of the Pirates!
dialogsDecline: I guess we will never know if the legend of the Meral King is true.
dialogsComplete: Woah woah woah! You defeated the King of the Pirates? And that stone...
It seems this one piece of stone is filled with purple magic... this is definitely the work of Shade.
Fufufu, the only thing that bothers me is that there is legend of a second piece of magic stone hidden on this island. Maybe one day the two of us will discover where it's hiding!
dialogsFail: To find out if the legend is true, you'll need to defeat the Overlord Meral.

16751.name: Picking Up the Pieces
dialogsBegin: There has been an influx of Meteoritill lately ever since a meteorite fell in the Fantasy Desert.
If I combine the Metallurgic Bull Ring, some Meteoritill, and Cardpuppet gears, I believe I can create a lightning rod strong enough to draw lightning away from the airships heading to Saint City!
dialogsAccept: Search for Meteoritill at the meteor crash site in the Fantasy Desert, and defeat Cardpuppets to retrieve their gears.
dialogsDecline: Meteoritill is safe to handle, I assure you...
dialogsComplete: Wonderful! Now that we have all the materials, it is time to finally craft the lightning rod.
dialogsFail: Collect Meteoritill in the Fantasy Desert and gears from Cardpuppets.

16765.name: Weapon Piercing Box (C)
16765.description: Collect souls from 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 20 dungeon bosses on Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Hard or higher difficulty 20 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsDecline: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

16828.name: Defying the Mystic Monarch
16828.description: Defeat 60 Wildwood Stalker and the Wildwood Shaman.
dialogsBegin: The time has come to face King Beast Khan's most powerful allies!
dialogsAccept: Deep within the camp of the Wildwoods dwells a potent species of beast known as the Wildwood Stalkers. They are lead by the mysterious Wildwood Shaman, a being believed to imbue them with corrupted magics.
dialogsDecline: To challenge the Wildwood without being thoroughly prepared would be a grave mistake.
dialogsComplete: The Wildwood have truly fallen!? Well done, hero! Only the King now stands in your path!
dialogsFail: The Wildwood are a fearsome species. Persevere, and keep pressing forward!

16856.name: Grab a Bull by the Horns
16856.description: Collect a Metallurgical Bull Ring from the Lord Dumb Bull.
dialogsBegin: We need some sort of lightning rod to attract the storm's fury away from the airships heading into Saint City...
I am unsure of who could build such a device, but you will certainly need a large amount of metal to do it.
dialogsAccept: The largest piece of unrefined metal in Saint Morning hangs off the head of the Lord Dumb Bull... Defeat the Lord and collect the Metallurgical Bull Ring!
dialogsDecline: I suppose we could collect scrap metal...
dialogsComplete: You have found the ring!
dialogsFail: Hunt down the Lord Dumb Bull and take its ring.

dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

16960.name: Crumbly Purple Essence
16960.description: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Naga around Coral Island.
16960.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: The Naga are powerful warriors of the sea... their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ are said to hold magical powers that can be used to harness purple energy. I have a healthy fear of Purple Magic, but what doesn't kill you only makes you stronger.
dialogsAccept: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Naga around Coral Island.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll know more about this Purple Magic... Perhaps one day enough to stop its evil from taking over Coral Island.
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

17075.name: Googly-Eyed Gogloo
17075.description: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Meral patroling the beaches.
17075.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: The glass inside a Meral's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ can enhance a person's vision thrice their normal spotting distance. Collect me enough and I could build a telescope to peer halfway across the globe!
dialogsAccept: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Meral patroling the beaches.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll be able to see the sights without ever leaving my home!
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

17138.name: Fun with Fungi
dialogsBegin: Cooking with Flaris fungi brings out the properties of vitality in a dish...
It is not hard to believe that a Masquerpet may be able to extend its life by eating the magical fungi.
I am a seasoned cook, but Marche knows more about the magic of Madrigal.
dialogsAccept: Marche has always been an expert on the magical properties of the plant life in the region... Go speak with Marche to learn more about the magic within the Flaris fungi.
dialogsDecline: Magic is powerful, and sometimes scary. I understand if you do not want to speak to Marche.
dialogsComplete: Oh, hello! So Sotta sent you to me. I wonder if you are prepared to seek out the magic behind these mushrooms...
dialogsFail: Speak to Marche to learn more about the magic of Flaris fungi.

17395.name: Kill Fefern
17395.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?

dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

17405.name: Smithing Class
dialogsBegin: You can make furniture out of wood. Would you like to learn carpenting?
dialogsAccept: Okay, try anything at the nearest crafting tool. The tools are near the jewelry.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Try anything at the nearest crafting tool. The tools are near the jewelry.

17549.name: Purple Reign
17549.description: Collect 20 Purple Essence from Enchanted AI and Enchanted Shaman.
dialogsBegin: Often potent magic leaves behind a trail in its wake of destruction. If Purple Magic was used to destroy the Guardiane Sanctuary... the people inside that turned into those creatures may have a small essence of purple energy still hanging on.
dialogsAccept: Return to the ruins of the Guardiane Sanctuary, and collect the purple essence left behind on the bodies of the creatures within.
dialogsDecline: Little is known about the effects of Purple Magic on the body... a healthy fear of it may be for the best.
dialogsComplete: The evidence is clear... the only magician powerful enough to cast Purple Magic of this potency is the Purple Magician herself, Lapranche.
dialogsFail: Destroy the Enchanted AI and Enchanted Shaman in the twisted Guardiane Sanctuary to obtain 20 Purple Essence.

17566.name: Keys for the Piano (1)
17566.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fifth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fifth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

17654.name: Minotaur Maze (2)
17654.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

17665.name: Magic in the Air
17665.description: Collect 10 Mothbee Spore and bring them to Marche.
dialogsBegin: Hmm... well, I believe the magical properties of these mushrooms originally came from spores that fall from the wings of Mothbees.
With a sample of Mothbee Spores I may be able to recreate the potent vitality mushrooms that may have allowed a troll to live much longer than normal...
dialogsAccept: The wings of Mothbees shed spores constantly. Please, go defeat the Mothbees flying above Flaris, and bring me a sample of the spores!
dialogsDecline: Mothbees can be vicious creatures. If you don't want to get knocked off your broom, it is best if you leave them alone.
dialogsComplete: Ah, you found the spores! I should be able to concoct something from these...
dialogsFail: Collect a sampling of Mothbee Spore, and bring them back to me.

17685.name: His True Intention
17685.description: Bring “Fragment of a Fallen Ship” to the Darken Mayor
dialogsBegin: Now that you’ve come this far, I have no choice but to tell you everything. Are you ready? That fragment is from the ship the expedition used when they set sail.
How do I know that from a single piece of debris? Because I was involved in everything—from its design to its construction. But so far, all we’ve found are scattered fragments like this.
I’ve done my best to stop the news from spreading, but there’s only so much I can do. At this point, I have no one left to turn to but you. Could you help find more clues about the expedition?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. The expedition followed the Darkon 1 mountain range. Start searching from there.
dialogsDecline: So even my last hope is fading. If you change your mind, please come back.
dialogsComplete: Welcome, adventurer. Hmm? What is this?
dialogsFail: Have you found anything? Oh… this is getting serious.

17714.name: Ring of Power
dialogsBegin: I only know of the ring's metallurgical properties.
dialogsAccept: The Strange Collector may know more about what the bull ring can do.
dialogsDecline: Keakoon are not that scary...
dialogsComplete: *Snort* Well look at that, a Metallurgical Bull Ring! I will need to thank Parine later for sending you to me with this precious trophy.
dialogsFail: Go speak with the Strange Collector when you have a moment.

17745.name: A Date on Mars!
17745.description: Go on a romantic date outside the entrance of Mars Mine!
dialogsBegin: What could be more romantic than frolicking near the Bangs of Northern Flaris? A picnic outside of Mars Mine sounds outstanding!
dialogsAccept: Wonderful, then the date is set. Enjoy your time sightseeing at the Mars Mine!
dialogsDecline: Not a fan of Bangs? Well, there's always the Nyangnyangs.
dialogsComplete: How was the date? Hopefully the Bangs weren't too distracting.
dialogsFail: Oh, so the Bangs were too distracting after all. Maybe you need to take a cold bath?

17799.name: Letter in a Bottle
17799.description: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ inside the bellies of the deep-sea Kraken.
17799.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: With the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Kraken, I could finally write to all my friends across the oceans. There's never enough time to keep up with everyone...
dialogsAccept: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ inside the bellies of the deep-sea Kraken.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! I've decided to write these letters and deliver them myself. Thank you for everything... I hope to see you again one day!
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

17877.name: Kill Demian Thieves
17877.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?

dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

17880.name: Weapon Piercing Box (A)
17880.description: Collect souls from 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare difficulty.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 50 dungeon bosses on Nightmare or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Nightmare or higher difficulty 50 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsDecline: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

17895.name: Bring Broken Wings
17895.description: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any of the Atrox crawling around the island.
17895.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: Hello adventurer... would you bring me $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Atrox? I want to build giant wings I can soar the skies with! Bring me all you can find...
dialogsAccept: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from any of the Atrox crawling around the island.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Soon I'll be soaring the skies with ease. See you at the Rainbow Race!
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

18075.name: There's Something in the Water
dialogsBegin: It was reported a few hours ago that a wall near where the Syliaca roam recently burst open, flooding the caves. Something this destructive has not happened in many years... I am certain this was caused by Lapranche's meddling.
I wish to investigate the matter, but I have to attend to my duties here in the city.
dialogsAccept: Collect enough samples of Syliaca to see if the flood has caused any mutations in their DNA.
dialogsDecline: Without your help, who knows when I'll have time to investigate this matter...
dialogsComplete: Fascinating! After analyzing the Syliaca samples it seems the water in the flood contains a magic component that affects the Syliaca's brain.
dialogsFail: The hormones of these Syliaca seem to affect how aggressive they will become. And their teeth are somehow much sharper than before...

18146.name: Mining Class
dialogsBegin: You can dig up ores with a pickaxe. Would you like to learn mining?
dialogsAccept: Good. Then go out into the field and try to dig some. It will be a great help, whether you succeed or not.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Go out into the field and try to dig some. It will be a great help, whether you succeed or not.

18156.name: Weapon Piercing Box (B)
18156.description: Collect souls from 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 35 dungeon bosses on Extra Hard or higher difficulty, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon on Extra Hard or higher difficulty 35 times, and return to me for a reward.

dialogsComplete: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

18260.name: Cooking Class
dialogsBegin: Food is the basic of survival. Why don't you cook on your own?
dialogsAccept: Good. Try anything on the oven nearby. Oven is near the food shop.
dialogsComplete: There you go. It's easier than you think, isn't it? Just remember, the most important thing is to do 'a lot'.
dialogsFail: Try anything on the oven nearby. Oven is near the food shop.

18264.name: A Gray Picture of Dorian
18264.description: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ left behind by Dorian around Coral Island.
18264.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: The Dorian have risen from the seas around our island! Please defeat them and collect their $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ as proof. My inventions can only hold them back for so long...
dialogsAccept: You may find $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ left behind by Dorian around Coral Island.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! Those fishy creatures have a strange power that makes them age slower than others. Perhaps studying their teeth can give us insight to the Dorian's special powers.
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

18269.name: Seeking Leren Chasm
18269.description: Locate the entrance to the Leren Chasm in the Leren Mountains, and report back to Radion.
dialogsBegin: Interesting... even with my vast knowledge of Flaris I know very little about the troll migration to the Leren Chasm.
Perhaps it is time to go explore the Leren Chasm to find out more about the powers behind the Elixir of Vitality.
dialogsAccept: The secret behind the longevity of the Leren Chasm trolls begins with finding the entrance to their cave. Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm and return to me at once!
dialogsDecline: The trolls of the Leren Mountains were believed to be part of a fierce army. If you are not comfortable seeking out the trolls, I will understand.
dialogsComplete: I see, so that's where the Leren Chasm is hidden...
dialogsFail: Search for the entrance to the Leren Chasm, then return to me.

18283.name: New Hero
dialogsBegin: Your will and ability have proven you to be a master in both thought and deed. Now that you've shown your true strength, it is time for your final task.
I need you to reach level 125 and bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$x $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$. Only a real Hero can do that!
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

18399.name: King of Coral Island
18399.description: You may find magnificient $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Okean, deep in the waters of Coral Island's seas.
18399.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: The $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ of the Okean must be mine! I know having their crown won't make me a king, but it will put me on the path of my dream. To be King of Coral Island!
dialogsAccept: You may find magnificient $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Okean, deep in the waters of Coral Island's seas.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! It's just a dream... but I hope to one day greet you again as King of Coral Island.
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

18469.name: Kill Giggle Boxes
18469.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: The power of your love have vanquished the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat, thank you!
dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

18500.name: Ishirut's Return?
dialogsBegin: Over many years our society has collected rare texts that reveal the history of the world of Madrigal. Eons ago a god of lightning helped create this world. That god was named Ishirut.
Perhaps ripples of Ishirut's spirit have returned to give us a sign, but I have no connection to the gods. Perhaps this is work for a mystic of sorts.
dialogsAccept: I believe that YaoRin of the MewMew people has the power to reveal the truth, but the MewMew clan are distrusting of most humans. Anyway, I recommend you go speak with YaoRin and see if they are willing to cooperate. They are our best chance at learning what the gods are up to.
dialogsDecline: While a bit standoffish, the MewMew clan is not that scary...
dialogsComplete: *Hmmph* So you were sent by that man Gothante. Even so, I do not trust you one bit.
dialogsFail: Find YaoRin in the MewMew camp just outside the walls of western Saint City.

18550.name: Weapon Piercing Box (D)
18550.description: Collect souls from 5 dungeon bosses on any difficulty.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out the boss masquerpets within Madrigal's dungeons. Could you please slay 5 dungeon bosses, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: Collect souls from boss masquerpets at the end of any dungeon 5 times, and return to me for a reward.
dialogsDecline: The dungeons are filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: The threat from within the dungeons has been reduced thanks to you, hero. Please accept a weapon piercing card as thanks for your efforts!
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the bosses yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

18665.name: A Loud Bang!
dialogsBegin: Look at all this steel. We'll have an army up and running in no time!
dialogsAccept: *BANG* Wha... What was that!? Perhaps the battle has already begun? Quickly, go speak with Loala to figure out what is going on!
dialogsDecline: Just a while longer and we'll have enough armor to equip a proper militia!
dialogsComplete: Chenbing was smart to send you to me... surely you felt the tremors after that loud bang.
dialogsFail: Speak with Loala to find out what caused that loud noise.

18729.name: Light as a Feather (1)
18729.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

18741.name: Winter is Coming
dialogsBegin: Storm Peak mountain has been closed off for many years... I am stationed here to prevent anyone from going inside. Terrifying masquerpets have overrun the place, and as far as I know no one has been able to safely step inside for a long time.
If you really want to go inside, you'll need to prove that you can handle the strongest masquerpets in Azria. Those found within the Storm Peak are even more dangerous...
dialogsAccept: Eliminate 200 Mammoth to prove that you can handle the dangers within the Storm Peak.
dialogsDecline: The Storm Peak mine is too dangerous anyway...
dialogsComplete: You actually managed to kill that many Mammoths!? Well if that is the case... I think it's time to let you test your fate inside the Storm Peak mountain.
dialogsFail: Eliminate 200 Mammoths as proof of your strength.

18742.name: Gullah Gullah Island! (1)
18742.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the second floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

18744.name: Find Love Fish
18744.description: Bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ back to me to prove the strength of your love!
dialogsBegin: Have you heard of the legendary $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? Legend has it that lovers who obtain the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ will be together forever.
dialogsAccept: Wonderful! The $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ is said to swim near Zaoma's Refuge in the middle of the Leren Mountains.
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: You've found the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$! Surely your love will be blessed to last forever.
dialogsFail: I don't see the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$. If you have trouble finding it, search near Zaoma in the Leren Mountains.

18869.name: Surprise Attack!
18869.description: Collect trophies from any defeated Dorian and Okean, and defeat at least one Lord or Overlord of each!
dialogsBegin: HOOWAH! I'm trembling with excitement!
With the information you've brought back, our village has a real chance to take down the Dorian and Okean before they get to us!
dialogsAccept: Go ahead and defeat as many Dorian and Okean as you can find, including their leaders! We trust you to take down the leaders, we'll be helping with the smaller ones in the back.
dialogsDecline: If we wait too much longer the Dorian and Okean will attack the village!
dialogsComplete: It's been done, hero. We've defeated the Dorian and Okean, and can now rest easy.
dialogsFail: We're doomed... without your help we will never defeat the Dorian and Okean in time!

18956.name: Light as a Feather (2)
18956.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the first floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

19065.name: Raiders of the Lost Sanctuary
dialogsBegin: Lapranche has twisted this once peaceful haven into the distorted Guardiane Sanctuary that you see before you. Your strength has carried you to do deeds that many others would be unable to stomach.
With great honor, you have put to rest those cursed by the power of the Purple Magician. In eternal rest, Shade's curse can no longer harm them.

Within the walls of the Guardiane Sanctuary, there was one guardian that acted as the last defense against evil that dared to approach. In hundreds of years of service, the Pyramid Guardian never faced defeat... until now.
The last bastion of Guardiane stands within the deformed heart before you. Its tattered muscles move to protect the twisted realm, though no life remains behind its eyes.
dialogsAccept: This barbaric curse sickens me... Put the Pyramid Guardian to rest, then report back to Laola.
dialogsDecline: For all but the Purple Magician... little hope may remain for those who enter into a battle with such a powerful warrior.
dialogsComplete: So it is done... thank you for laying to rest those cursed by the Purple Magician. It's selfish, but I truly do not wish harm upon Lapranche, only for her to be free from Shade's curse...
I intend to find a way to stop Lapranche without destroying her entirely... but in the end, we have no choice but to stop her now.
Guardiane needs time to heal, but soon we will speak again about the plan at hand. The army of Madrigal will rise again to defeat Shade and her puppet Lapranche.
dialogsFail: Seek out what remains of the Pyramid Guardian, and put it to rest.

19131.name: Kill Scorpicon
19131.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsBegin: Welcome! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$. Could you please work together to defeat the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted somewhere in Madrigal. Check your map for hints for where they may be hiding!
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: The power of your love have vanquished the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat, thank you!
dialogsFail: Were you unable to find and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? Track them down to prove your love is true!

19166.name: Master Grade (1)
dialogsBegin: Do you really think you’re the strongest? You’re wrong. You can be stronger! Listen... What if I told you that you could... relive certain moments of your life? It would be crazy, wouldn’t it?
I have a proposal for you. I take a few levels from you, of course temporarily, and you will accomplish a task for me. What do you have to gain? Everything!
I’m bringing you down to level 60, and when you get to level 70, come back to me! I’ll give you back your previous levels with a little gift.
Be careful though, your experience will be halved for the duration of this short mission!
Obviously, if you change your mind, you can abandon the quest at any time through your quest window and I will give you back your levels, of course!
dialogsAccept: Perfect! I've taken your levels, come back to me when you reach the goal of our arrangement!
dialogsDecline: Oh I see... you’re probably too weak.
dialogsComplete: Wonderful! So I give you back your levels, and the little gift with it! Thank you for your help and see you soon!
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

19217.name: Disarming the Maleficars
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: Disarming the Maleficars
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

19275.name: Disarming the Maleficars (2)
19275.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the seventh floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome back hero! There are reports of a new threat in the Forsaken Tower. Please seek out and get rid of the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$.
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the seventh floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You weren't able to kill the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's alright, please return after you've won against the giant!

19331.name: Bead of the Black Magician (1)
19331.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fourth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

19352.name: Collect Heart Charms from Nyangnyang
19352.description: Bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$x $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ back to me to prove the strength of your love!
dialogsBegin: Nyangnyangs possess charms bursting with the power of love. With a few of these charms, you can show Madrigal how strong your love is!
dialogsAccept: I'm so glad to see how in love you are. Go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Nyangnyangs in northern Flaris, then return to me.
dialogsDecline: Some days we don't feel productive. I understand.
dialogsComplete: I can feel these charms emitting love waves. Soon everyone will know how special your love is!
dialogsFail: I'm sorry, were you unable to find the $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? Perhaps they only appear for those truly in love.

19424.name: Clouds Over Coral Island
19424.description: Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsBegin: Hero, the clouds over the island to the southeast have finally cleared!
For the longest time we have been unable to travel to the famed Coral Island. I wonder who or what caused the clouds to dissipate?
Regardless of the reason, perhaps you should go pay a visit to the island and see what's new.
dialogsAccept: Many years ago a skilled blacksmith from Darken City named BoBu traveled through the fog in search for rare materials. Go seek out Coral Island and see if BoBu managed to survive.
dialogsDecline: I understand hero, Coral Island has been uncharted territory for many years... Come back to me if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Hello there traveler, I didn't expect to see one of you so soon after the clouds around Coral Island were lifted...

19452.name: Cave Diving
19452.description: Enter the Leren Chasm, then kill 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and 20 Cavern Larva.
dialogsBegin: After unblocking the entrance to Leren Chasm, strange creatures have started coming out, causing havoc in the Leren Mountains.
Go inside the Leren Chasm and clear out the creatures that have been causing us problems.
dialogsAccept: Please speak to me when you are ready to enter the Leren Chasm. Inside you will find the Masquerpets I speak of.
dialogsDecline: These unknown creatures are terribly dangerous. Do not approach them if you feel unprepared.
dialogsComplete: Hopefully we will have less disturbences in the Leren Mountains now, thanks to you.
dialogsFail: Eliminate 20 Deep Cave Gorilla and Cavern Larva.

19510.name: Nippy Waters
19510.description: You may find delicious $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Kingsters in shallow waters around the island.
19510.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ cackles with glee! Soon their inventions will become a reality.
dialogsBegin: All this inventing has me famished! Could you go get me some of the Kingster's $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$? We'll eat like kings! Don't worry, I'll share...
dialogsAccept: You may find delicious $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from Kingsters in shallow waters around the island.
dialogsDecline: Please, don't make me go collect $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ all on my own... I'm too busy dreaming up new inventions!
dialogsComplete: Thank you for collecting all those $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$, adventurer! We're going to be so full! Eat up, it's time to feast!
dialogsFail: That isn't nearly enough $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ for me to build one of my grand inventions... come back with more!

19561.name: YaoRin's Trust
dialogsBegin: I see... you wish to see my powers of the mind. Well, the MewMew people are not very trusting of outsiders.
If you really want to have a fortune read you will need permission from the leader of the MewMew clan, Locku. Before I will allow you to speak to Locku, you must prove yourself to me.
dialogsAccept: Prove your worth by bringing me the Hearts of Red Otem who reside in the Iblis Dungeon. If you can do that, then I will let you speak with our leader.
dialogsDecline: If you cannot do a simple task then you are not worthy of to speak to the MewMew clan leader...
dialogsComplete: We distrust you humans, but I see you have helped YaoRin in eliminating our mortal enemies, the Otems.
dialogsFail: Go find Hearts of the Red Otem in the Iblis Dungeon.

19617.name: Pandora's Box
19617.description: Collect a Corrupted Symbol of Shade from a Violet masquerpet in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin: *Psst* Hey, you! Can you come help an old box like me?

I haven't seen an adventurer here in years, you must be tough. I was turned into this box a long time ago by an annoying clown... Could you help return me to my original form? I can help you become so much stronger if you do...
dialogsAccept: *Cackle* Wonderful hahahaha! You can start by releasing the magic chains that bind me to this location. Collect a Corrupted Symbol of Shade from a Violet monster in Darkon 1.
dialogsDecline: FOOL! You ignore the gifts of someone like me!? You will regret this...
dialogsComplete: Ahhh... I feel the first binding being released. One down, three to go.
dialogsFail: Your incompetence is pathetic... GO! Defeat a Violet masquerpet to release the first binding.

19649.name: Master Grade (3)
dialogsBegin: The last time you finished your task in no time. What do you think? Let’s go back?
The rules are not changing, so what are we waiting for?
This time, it will be from level 80 to 90! So, shall we go?
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

19740.name: Rankashu's Request
19740.description: Find and speak with Mawrang in Azria Village.
dialogsBegin: I don't know why I am telling you this... but sometimes I think back to the mighty beast Clockworks that us Dwarpets built to protect Madrigal long ago.

You are a powerful warrior... you may have even fought Clockworks at its prison in Darken City. But did you know Clockworks was once used to defend all life from the evils of the Goddess Shade? Shade corrupted our creation, turning the Clockworks against the world for her own desires.
My family is long gone now... but they always told tales about how Clockworks was built from mechanical parts formed in the mines around Madrigal.

It's a long shot, but I want to try and seek out any lost parts from back then that may have been left behind in the mines. I haven't been successful in finding anything during my stay here at the Dekane Mine, but I've heard there is a mine deep in the mountains of Azria...
I think there may be lost technology hidden in the Azria Mine that may allow us to create something that could one day rid the world of Shade's cursed creatures, the masquerpets.
dialogsAccept: Thank you for helping me... it's rare that I work with humans who are so willing. Please go to the Azria Village and find someone who knows about the Azria Mine.
dialogsDecline: I'm not surprised... humans were never good to us Dwarpets anyway.
dialogsComplete: Hello warrior, so you want to know more about the mines here in Azria?
dialogsFail: Speak to someone in Azria Village who knows about the Azria Mine.

19821.name: Tale of Tanuki
19821.description: Defeat 60 Tanuki Enforcer and the Tanuki Protector.
dialogsBegin: The fight through the Wilds has only just begun. Armed with your newfound experience in the Wilds, you're ready to confront something even more perilous.
dialogsAccept: Return to the Wilds and face the army of Tanuki warriors who stand as guardians of the King's lush garden.
dialogsDecline: The last fight certainly tested your mettle. Rest for a while, and let me know when you are ready to proceed.
dialogsComplete: The King's army has begun to dwindle! Only the most powerful of his guardians remain to defend him.
dialogsFail: You're so close to victory adventurer, do not give up hope. Defeat the Tanuki, and march ever closer to the King's chambers.

19912.name: Font of Power
19912.description: Visit the Atlar of Violet in Darkon 1.
dialogsBegin: I can feel my power slowly returning... HAHAHAHAHA! Yes... yes... time for another binding to be released!
dialogsAccept: Take the cup from inside my chest and fill it with the powers from the nearby Altar of Violet.
dialogsDecline: You could have had all the power... and now you will have nothing!
dialogsComplete: Ahhhh... Ahahahahaha... the weakness brought on from these bindings is finally being released. Just one binding left...
dialogsFail: You're wasting time! Go to the Altar of Violet, now!!

19916.name: Heart of Iron (1)
19916.description: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fifth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsBegin: Welcome hero! Another request has come in to clear out $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ from the Forsaken Tower. Could you please slay 50 $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$, and return to me once you are done?
dialogsAccept: The $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ has been spotted on the fifth floor of the Forsaken Tower.
dialogsDecline: The Tower is filled with dangerous masquerpets. I understand if you do not wish to take the risk.
dialogsComplete: Thank you hero, the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ threat has been eliminated.
dialogsFail: You haven't defeated the $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ yet? That's okay, just return once you have.

19991.name: Bear's Endurance
dialogsBegin: There has been a disturbance in the flow of Madrigal's magic lately... I've heard rumors that an unsuspecting adventurer released the Black Magician from their prison.

The current Black Magician named Lapranche is also sometimes known as the Purple Magician. She has an incredible power that is lost to all of today's magicians, including myself. Lapranche can summon the will of Shade to cast Purple Magic, recreating parts of the world in Shade's image.

As of now we stand no chance in a battle with Lapranche... even I have grown too weak to defeat her, my former pupil. She is certainly in a weakened state, so there is time to prepare. Expect Lapranche to bide her time by causing choas around Madrigal. For now we must build our strength.
dialogsAccept: Before we move forward with the plan... I need you to prove that you are strong enough to fend for yourself. Bring me 50 Bearnerky Fang, then we can move forward with preparations.
dialogsDecline: If we are not prepared, Lapranche could unleash evil more terrible than us mortals could ever hope to face.
dialogsComplete: I hope you understand my hesitance... the power of Purple Magic is nothing to play with. We may start work on the plan now.
dialogsFail: Go defeat Bearnerky until you have collected 50 Bearnerky Fang.

20290.name: The Skulls of the Hundur Sharpfoot
20290.description: Excellent! The Muran are counting on you. Go gather 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and return once you have enough. You can find them on the Hundur Sharpfoot.
20290.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: The Hundur Sharpfoot gather near Kaillun’s borders, and their skulls bear strange markings. The Muran need them to decipher the secrets behind their rituals.
dialogsAccept: Excellent! The Muran are counting on you. Go gather 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ and return once you have enough. You can find them on the Hundur Sharpfoot.
dialogsDecline: I see… but these creatures are growing more aggressive. Come back if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Perfect! These skulls will be of great use to us. Kaillun thanks you for your determination.
dialogsFail: You haven't gathered enough skulls yet… Keep going, each specimen is important to us.

20359.name: Herneos: The Golden Legacy
20359.description: Check if the treasure is still there
dialogsBegin: Listen, you should check if the treasure is still there! What treasure?! The treasure of Herneos, of course! You can’t miss it: gold, jewels, valuable items... a true legend!
dialogsAccept: Yes! I knew you wouldn’t pass up a chance like this. The treasure of Herneos is the stuff of legends if it’s still there, it could be a discovery of a lifetime! Go quickly, and make sure you get there before Shade does. Good luck!
dialogsDecline: You’re… refusing? Are you serious?! This is the legendary treasure of Herneos! Opportunities like this don’t come around twice, you know. Fine, but don’t say I didn’t give you the chance to be part of something unforgettable.
dialogsComplete: The treasure is still there?! Great news! But… it’s possible that all is not lost, if we act quickly. Very quickly.
dialogsFail: So, what are you waiting for? Hurry before Shade gets her hands on it!

20720.name: Territorial Cats
20720.description: Kill 11 Captain Hundur Sharpfoots and bring 1 Piece of Hundur Bone
dialogsBegin: That’s still not enough to convince me. I don’t even know who you really are. If you want to live alongside our village, you’ll need to prove yourself with your strength. Then at least we can rely on each other.
dialogsAccept: If you’re serious about proving yourself, defeat Captain Hundur Sharpfoot and bring me proof.
dialogsDecline: At your current level, it might be difficult. I understand.
dialogsComplete: (Seriously…?) You’re struggling with just those? Hah… well, I guess you tried. Go on, someone will guide you inside.
dialogsFail: Still not done? When exactly do you plan to enter the village?

20779.name: Guard’s Request 2
dialogsBegin: Samosets have been swarming the grasslands lately, making patrols difficult. Could you thin them out a bit?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. You know where to find them, don’t you?
dialogsDecline: If you’ve got other priorities, we understand. We’ll manage.
dialogsComplete: I knew I could rely on you. You’ve made our work much easier. Truly, thank you.
dialogsFail: This should be an easy job for you.

21139.name: Trapped in the Maze
21139.description: Meet with the Mayor of Flarine
dialogsBegin: Well… I don’t know much, but lately the mayor of Flaris has been visiting his house quite often. Why don’t you try talking to Flarine?
dialogsAccept: You know the way, right?
dialogsDecline: You’re the one asking, and yet… If it’s nothing important, could you step aside?
dialogsComplete: Hmm? It’s been a while. What brings you here?
dialogsFail: That’s all I know. Go see Flarine.

21765.name: Rumble from the Depths
21765.description: Find the location of the events and see what’s happening there
dialogsBegin: (H-Hiii…!) T-tremors... w-waves... taller than a Clockworks... (Gulp) A... a deafening noise... Wh-what’s going on?!
What?! You’re not aware??! But where have you been?! Honestly… We can never count on you to keep an eye on our precious world…
Well… listen. It doesn’t matter, I’ll need you. I have no idea what happened, or even where exactly… (hesitation) But I feel like the deafening noise came from the Krakens side.

I would have gone myself, but you see… (looking away) I still have a lot to do, and there are other adventurers I need to take care of… (coughs) And don’t think I’m scared, okay! It has nothing to do with that, absolutely nothing!
dialogsAccept: Ah! Finally, someone reliable! I knew I could count on you. Go quickly, check near the Krakens side, and come back to tell me what you find. I’m sure you’ll do an excellent job! But… be careful, alright? That rumble wasn’t normal...
dialogsDecline: What?! You’re not going?! Really… We can’t count on anyone… Fine, do as you wish, but remember that this world needs protectors, not cowards. And don’t come complaining if things get worse without you!
dialogsComplete: Starfish… coral… and all kinds of little sea things coming together to form… a portal?! This is insane… How could this be possible?!
dialogsFail: You’re back already? But… don’t tell me you haven’t checked out the source of that noise yet! We need to know what’s happening on the Krakens side. Go on, get moving! The world’s not going to protect itself, you know!

22310.name: Let’s Find the Real Clue
dialogsBegin: Oh… this has nothing to do with awakening.
It says that long ago, all continents were connected, and many races lived together.
This is exactly the kind of thing the Strange Collector in Saint City loves. He’d be thrilled if you brought it to him.
Now then… shall we speak about your awakening?
dialogsAccept: True strength awakens when you fight with your life on the line. It’s always been that way.
Enter the instance dungeon and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s to test your limits.
dialogsDecline: Is there another way? Maybe. It’s worth trying whatever you can. If you change your mind, come find me.
dialogsComplete: Well done. But you still haven’t awakened? How strange…
I know someone who can definitely help—if you’re willing to meet them.
Here, take this letter of introduction.
dialogsFail: You haven’t finished yet? Hmm… I thought you’d be done by now.

22399.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Psykeeper Master] Cylor.
She’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
