dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Magician Master] Hee.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? She’s expecting you.

22475.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.
dialogsComplete:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you finally awakened?
This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.
So, what happened?

I see. So that’s how it went.
You may not have become a transcendent, but I’ll give you a small gift to celebrate your new strength.
dialogsFail: I said you may go now.

22516.name: About Muran
22516.description: Bring “All About Muran!” to the Strange Collector
dialogsBegin: Thinking of all the chaos that traitor caused… honestly. Anyway, it seems your name has spread. A lot of people around the village have been asking to meet you. Once you’re done with your own business, why not visit them?
dialogsAccept: Of course, take care of your matters first.
dialogsDecline: Hmm… you have more admirers in the village than you realize.
dialogsComplete: Oh, so you’ve learned something about the natives? A book written by the village elder himself… May I see it? I see… very nice work. If you learn anything else, be sure to share it.
dialogsFail: I’ve narrowed it down to three or four people for now.

22717.name: Lost in the Fog
dialogsBegin: I thought I could decipher it, but there are unknown characters mixed in. I’ve heard rumors of someone who might understand this sort of thing. Would you be willing to find him?
dialogsAccept: There’s a large island near Flarine. He should be somewhere around there.
dialogsDecline: Unfortunately, I can’t think of any better option.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while. What brings you here? You found this in Kaillun? I’m Muran as well, though I left my tribe long ago. I can’t say much, but will you hand that over? It’s about summoning a god and speeding up the tower’s completion. Take this as thanks.
dialogsFail: I don’t know the exact location myself—just what I’ve heard.

23345.name: Under Shade's Command
23345.description: Kill $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s, $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT,2$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME,2$s, $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT,3$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME,3$s and return talk to Sovann.
dialogsBegin: What?! Monsters? Whole hordes?! Listen… Shade must already be at work, and if she’s there, she won’t waste any time.
I’ll need you to return there. Observe, fight, assess their strengths… If these creatures are really under Shade’s control, we need to know what awaits us.
When you’ve dealt with the monsters, return to see Dr. Estly. He should have finished the analysis of the water by then, and we’ll finally know if this submerged city is indeed Herneos…
dialogsAccept: Excellent! I knew I could count on you. The creatures under Shade’s command won’t go down easily, but with your skills, I’m confident you can handle them. Go, and show them that we won’t back down! Once you've dealt with them, check back with Sovann.
dialogsDecline: What?! You’re refusing?! Don’t you see how serious this is? Shade’s forces won’t stop they’ll only get stronger if we ignore them. Fine, if you’re not willing to help, I’ll find someone who is up to the challenge. But don’t forget you might regret standing by if Shade succeeds.
dialogsComplete: You did it! I knew you could handle those monsters! Thank you for stepping up when we needed it the most.
dialogsFail: You’re back again? But… have you not dealt with those monsters yet? We need to know what we’re up against! Shade’s forces are growing stronger every moment you delay. Go back and finish the job! Time is of the essence, and the fate of Herneos depends on it!

23392.name: Traitor
dialogsBegin: Our operation was a success as well, but… some soldiers say they saw the jarl in the enemy’s camp, retreating with them. Now their morale is shaken.
I knew he was scheming, but to see him betray his own people… This will be our next move.
dialogsAccept: The soldiers will never fight at full strength while that traitor is free. You must track him down. There will be Lycans along his escape route, including Captain Taiaha, but I doubt they’ll be a problem for you.
dialogsDecline: Hmm… I may have to send the soldiers instead. If you change your mind, come back.
dialogsComplete: Thank you for your efforts, sir. I’m Merk, a scout ordered to track the traitor by the Elder.
dialogsFail: I’m counting on you. I trust you with this mission.

23410.name: Searching for Clues… 1
dialogsBegin: It turned out to be just a simple sailing logbook. There’s nothing special written in it. Are you still looking for more clues?
dialogsAccept: Actually, after reading it, Amadolka decided to search the Darken mountains again to see if anything else turns up. You should meet him before heading back to Saint City.
dialogsDecline: If you’re too busy, I understand. Take care of yourself.
dialogsComplete: Inisis sent you?
dialogsFail: You haven’t left yet?

23643.name: Elder’s Request 2
dialogsBegin: I don’t know why, but after you dealt with the small Kanonicus group, their main numbers started increasing. Could you help with this as well?
dialogsAccept: I can’t thank you enough for your help.
dialogsDecline: If you’re busy, I understand. We’ll manage somehow.
dialogsComplete: For now, we can finally enjoy a bit of peace. Well done, truly.
dialogsFail: I believe in you. Good luck.

23734.name: It Will Be Different This Time
dialogsBegin: He is my master. Since he’s also a transcendent, he should know how.
Because of certain circumstances, he doesn’t appear in public, so most people don’t know he exists.
I just realized I gave you the letter without even hearing your answer.
Anyway, you don’t know where he is yet, do you? Will you go meet him?
dialogsAccept: These days, my master is secretly building a tower. He should still be there.
Show him my letter. He won’t ignore it.
dialogsDecline: Even for me, this is a big favor to ask. If you feel you’re not ready, you can come back later.
dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

23861.name: Find the Old Document
23861.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

23962.name: The Expedition Is…
dialogsBegin: Did it say anything useful? Typical wolves—attack, pillage, and so on. Still, if it helps your search, that’s something.
dialogsAccept: So now… you’re heading back? That’s something you’ll need to report.
dialogsDecline: Well, returning can wait.
dialogsComplete: Oh, you’re back. How was the village?
dialogsFail: I’ll inform the villagers so you can use our village freely afterward. Safe travels.

24020.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Elementor Master] Horison even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

24030.name: Cutting Shade's Power
24030.description: Kill $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ & $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME,2$ the two generals of Shade at Herneos
dialogsBegin: I know it’s a lot to ask, but… could you start by eliminating the two generals of Shade’s army that you spotted in Herneos? (determined look) That should slow down Shade’s advance and considerably weaken her right hand.
dialogsAccept: Thank you! With Shade’s generals out of the way, we might actually stand a chance. I know it won’t be easy, but you’re the only one who can do it. Go now, and show them that we won’t let Herneos fall under Shade’s control!
dialogsDecline: What?! You’re backing out now? This is no time for hesitation! Shade’s forces are closing in, and without your help, we may not be able to hold them back. But fine, if you won’t act, we’ll have to hope someone else is up for the challenge…
dialogsComplete: What?! You did it already?! (beaming smile) I can’t believe it! It’s incredible to count on you. You’re our true savior!
dialogsFail: You’re back... but the two generals of Shade are still standing? Every moment they’re left unchecked, Herneos is at greater risk. We’re counting on you to stop them. There’s no time to lose!

24635.name: Mission Failed
dialogsBegin: It’s embarrassing to admit, but… unlike you, we failed. We tried to trap them in a tight spot and wipe them out, but a mage suddenly appeared. Those beasts shouldn’t be capable of magic.
dialogsAccept: We need to regroup our forces, so… could you handle them in our place?
dialogsDecline: I understand. If you change your mind, please come back.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work.
dialogsFail: Thank you. We’ll wait for good news.

24670.name: Magic water stone of Herneos
24670.description: Bring back a magical water stone from the discovered location and have it analyzed by Dr. Estly
24670.descriptionComplete: You have the Mine Entrance Card. Now to find out what everyone is so afraid of.
dialogsBegin: Hmm… If what you’re telling me is true, it would correspond to a well-known legend of Madrigal… Once upon a time, in the Old World, Herneos was a prosperous city where everyone dreamed of living, a true underwater paradise with magnificent architecture.

But one day, Shade pierced the glass bubble that protected Herneos from the depths of the ocean, and the city sank… along with its inhabitants. Since then, despite numerous searches, we have never found this lost city. But if you’re telling me a portal has opened…
I’m afraid Shade has finally found a way to return to the city of Herneos… For what purpose? I have no idea, but we need to ensure it is indeed the city of Herneos…

Do you think you could bring me a magical water stone from there? With an analysis of the stone, we can confirm if it truly originates from Herneos, as magical water stones can only be found in that legendary city.
dialogsAccept: Ah, thank you! I knew you’d understand the urgency. If this really is a magical water stone from Herneos, then Shade’s reach might be spreading in ways we never expected… Please, bring back a stone as soon as you can. And be careful Herneos may be more dangerous now than we imagine.
dialogsDecline: What?! You’re not interested in helping with this? You don’t understand this isn’t just some small errand! Herneos could be the key to untold mysteries… and maybe even threats. But fine, if you can’t be bothered, I’ll just have to find someone else…
dialogsComplete: Ah, you've returned with the magical water stone! Thank you! I'll begin the analysis right away to confirm its origin.
dialogsFail: Back so soon? You don’t have the magical water stone yet? We’re counting on that stone to prove if it’s truly from Herneos. Shade’s power might be stronger than we thought, so time is crucial. Please, return as soon as you have it!

24682.name: Find the Old Document
24682.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

24804.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Magician Master] Hee.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see him? He’s probably waiting impatiently.

24876.name: Hero Grade (3)
dialogsBegin: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
I need you to reach level 160 and bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$x $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$. Only a real Hero can do that!
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

24947.name: Unveiling Herneos
24947.description: Go tell Sovann it is indeed Herneos
dialogsBegin: Ah, yes, the analysis results… So, according to our archives, the water you retrieved matches 100% with that of the city of Herneos! It is indeed it You should quickly go announce this news to Sovann !
dialogsAccept: Fantastic! Thank you so much for delivering the news. Sovann will be thrilled or perhaps a bit anxious to hear it. Go quickly and let him know that Herneos has indeed resurfaced. We might be on the brink of something monumental!
dialogsDecline: Wait… you’re not going to tell him? This is crucial information! Herneos is real, and Sovann needs to know. Fine, if you won’t go, but don’t say I didn’t warn you… Discoveries like this don’t come every day, and neither does the chance to be part of history.
dialogsComplete: What?? It’s really the lost city of Herneos?! (in awe) It’s incredible to see this iconic city again!
dialogsFail: Oh, you’re back… but you still haven’t told Sovann? This is monumental news... Herneos has been confirmed! Please, don’t delay any longer. Sovann must hear this right away; the implications are too important to keep to ourselves!

25112.name: Seeking the Truth of Herneos
25112.description: Take the analysis result to Martinyc the historian of Flarine
dialogsBegin: I’m afraid I don’t have the knowledge necessary to interpret the results correctly.

Listen, take this sample and bring it to Martinyc the historian of Flarine. Only she has the archives and the skills to compare and tell you what’s going on! If this water is really connected to Herneos, she’ll know.
I’m afraid I don’t have the knowledge necessary to interpret the results correctly.
dialogsAccept: Thank you! I knew you’d understand the importance of this. Martinyc is our best hope for interpreting these results. Take the sample to her right away, and let’s hope she can shed some light on this mystery! The fate of Herneos could depend on it!
dialogsDecline: What? You’re turning this down? This is vital information that could unlock the secrets of Herneos! If you won’t help now, I don’t know what we’ll do. Fine, but don’t forget that knowledge is power, and you might regret passing on this opportunity!
dialogsComplete: Hello, who are you?... Oh, you must be the adventurer Estly told me about! Nice to meet you. How can I assist you?
Oh, you want me to interpret the results of this analysis to check, using the archives, if this water is indeed from the city of Herneos?
(Smirking) But nothing comes for free, you know! I heard there are all-new monsters, never seen before, over there…
dialogsFail: You’re back? But… have you not delivered the sample to Martinyc yet? We need her expertise to understand what the analysis reveals! Time is running out, and if this water is connected to Herneos, we need to act quickly. Go now, before it’s too late!

25277.name: Scars of the Battlefield
25277.description: Retrieve a War Scar to add authenticity to the novelist’s story.
dialogsBegin: Adventurer! I just had a stroke of genius! My story is missing something… something raw, something real! A true relic of battle, a War Scar! I know it’s risky, but imagine the credibility it would add to my novel!
If you could bring me a piece of one, my story would be legendary! What do you say?
dialogsAccept: You will? Incredible! I knew you had the heart of a true adventurer! Be careful, though, War Scars are not easily found, and I fear the journey won’t be safe. But if anyone can do it, it’s you! Good luck, and may fate be on your side!
dialogsDecline: Oh… I see. I can’t blame you; this is not an easy task. But what a shame… my story will lack that raw authenticity. If you ever change your mind, please let me know. Some risks are worth taking for the sake of greatness!
dialogsComplete: You did it! You actually did it! Let me see… This… This is incredible! The texture, the scars of battle engraved upon it… This is exactly what I needed! You have no idea what this means for my novel! Thank you, adventurer, this will be the heart of my greatest story yet!
dialogsFail: Still no sign of a War Scar? I know it’s dangerous, but I can’t get this idea out of my head! Without it, my novel will feel… incomplete. If you find the courage, please, I’d be forever grateful!

25526.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Assist Master] Maki.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see him? He’s probably waiting impatiently.

25616.name: Peace at Last?
25616.description: Meet with the Mayor of Saint City
dialogsBegin: Incredible. It may not have been a fully summoned demon, but you still defeated it. The jarl had a family? He lost his wife ages ago and never had any children.

Whatever the truth, you’ve saved this land from the demon and those filthy beasts. You have my deepest thanks. Trade with your continent? Of course. I fully support it. I’ll guarantee free passage for anyone coming to our village. Take this approval token.
dialogsAccept: I’m looking forward to it. I wonder what kind of heroes will come next.
dialogsDecline: Still, some formalities must be followed, don’t you think?
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while. How goes your exploration of the New Continent? You’ve really been through a lot. You didn’t just chart new lands—you saved an entire town and secured official permission for trade. I’ll see that you’re properly rewarded. Well done.
dialogsFail: Haha. You’re free to use the village facilities whenever you like.

25733.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.
dialogsComplete:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you finally awakened?
This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.
So, what happened?

I see. So that’s how it went.
You may not have become a transcendent, but I’ll give you a small gift to celebrate your new strength.
dialogsFail: I said you may go now.

26407.name: Bad News
26407.description: Kill 1 Chief Keokuk and obtain “Chief Keokuk’s Notebook”
dialogsBegin: The Lycan forces keep growing, and their numbers make it hard to get close. I… lost sight of the target. This area is under Chief Keokuk’s direct control, so getting any closer is almost impossible.
The fact that the traitor went this far suggests they’re more closely allied than we thought. In any case, we’ll have to defeat this enemy to uncover any proof.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. Once you secure evidence, I think you should return to the Elder.
dialogsDecline: This is the best plan I can think of. Do you have a better one?
dialogsComplete: Aside from the jarl, this war is finally over. With that stinking giant defeated, the fighting is truly finished. It took far too long. Thank you for bringing this war to an end.
dialogsFail: I’ll be waiting.

26417.name: Hero Grade (2)
dialogsBegin: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
I need you to reach level 140 and bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$x $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$. Only a real Hero can do that!
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

26453.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Mercenary Master] Andy.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see him? He’s probably waiting impatiently.

26996.name: Conflicted Orders
dialogsBegin: Ah, you must be the adventurer. What brings you here? Reinforcements? I never sent such a request. Who told you that?
dialogsAccept: (Wolf howls) What was that? Is someone out there?
dialogsDecline: What is that man thinking…? He’s always been suspicious.
dialogsComplete: No, outside…! A whole group of Lycan mages appeared out of nowhere.
dialogsFail: Why aren’t you checking the situation outside? What’s going on?

27128.name: The Claws of the Kyouchish
27128.description: Good! Their claws are poisoning our scouts. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Kyouchish.
27128.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: The Kyouchish have been injuring many Muran scouts with their corrosive strikes. Their claws are needed to craft a protective remedy.
dialogsAccept: Good! Their claws are poisoning our scouts. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Kyouchish.
dialogsDecline: I understand… but we're running out of remedies. Return if you wish to help.
dialogsComplete: Excellent! With these claws, our healers can prepare a proper antidote.
dialogsFail: You're still missing some. The Kyouchish are dangerous, stay careful.

27335.name: An Incident! 5
dialogsBegin: (Lycan) Damn it… how did you figure it out? I thought I’d fooled all these clueless cats, thanks to the Scroll of Skrolls our god gave me.
dialogsAccept: (Lycan) You’ve ruined too many of our plans already. Don’t think you’ll get away so easily. We’ll meet again.
dialogsDecline: (Lycan) You think we’d just let you walk away after uncovering our secret?
dialogsComplete: Magic disguises… I never thought they were real. Belia taught our children—who knows what would’ve happened if that Lycan had stayed hidden. Thank you. I’ll report this to the elder.
dialogsFail: What… I don’t remember the past few days at all. Are you saying they did that to me? Adventurer, you saved me. Thank you so much.

27339.name: Gratitude of the Mayor
27339.description: A rumor says a great reward awaits you... Go speak to the mayor of Flarine!
dialogsBegin: Rumor has it that the mayor of Flarine is eager to personally reward you for your recent achievement! You should definitely pay him a visit
dialogsAccept: That's awesome! Hurry and go see the mayor!
dialogsDecline: What do you mean, no?! You've already done everything.. You just need to claim your reward from the mayor of Flarine!
dialogsComplete: (Incredulous look) You did it… You really defeated Shade’s right hand?! (sigh of relief) I can’t believe it, this is incredible!
Thanks to you, we finally have real hope to repel the darkness threatening Madrigal. You accomplished the impossible, where so many others would have failed.
Take this… It’s a well-deserved reward. As the Mayor of Flaris, I thank you from the bottom of my heart for your courage and bravery!
dialogsFail: Oh, you’re back… but you still haven’t told Sovann? This is monumental news... Herneos has been confirmed! Please, don’t delay any longer. Sovann must hear this right away; the implications are too important to keep to ourselves!

27568.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Billposter Master] Ride even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

27711.name: It Will Be Different This Time
dialogsBegin: He is my master. Since he’s also a transcendent, he should know how.
Because of certain circumstances, he doesn’t appear in public, so most people don’t know he exists.
I just realized I gave you the letter without even hearing your answer.
Anyway, you don’t know where he is yet, do you? Will you go meet him?
dialogsAccept: These days, my master is secretly building a tower. He should still be there.
Show him my letter. He won’t ignore it.
dialogsDecline: Even for me, this is a big favor to ask. If you feel you’re not ready, you can come back later.
dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

27724.name: Return to Dr. Estly
27724.description: It’s time to return to Dr. Estly. The analysis should be complete by now, and with it, we might finally learn the truth about Herneos. Head back to her as soon as you can!
dialogsBegin: Now, go see Dr. Estly; he should have finished the analysis of the water by now. We’re one step closer to uncovering the truth about Herneos!
dialogsAccept: Excellent! The analysis should reveal invaluable information about Herneos. Head to Dr. Estly right away, and let’s finally uncover the secrets that lie within this legendary city!
dialogsDecline: Really? You’re choosing not to follow up on this? Dr. Estly’s analysis could be the key to understanding Herneos and possibly even stopping Shade. But if you won’t go, we’ll have to hope someone else steps up to the task.
dialogsComplete: The analysis is complete, but... (annoyed look)
dialogsFail: You haven’t visited Dr. Estly yet? The analysis of the water might hold crucial answers about Herneos! Time is ticking, and we need that information to understand what Shade might be planning. Please, head to him as soon as possible.

27780.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.
dialogsComplete:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you finally awakened?
This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.
So, what happened?

I see. So that’s how it went.
You may not have become a transcendent, but I’ll give you a small gift to celebrate your new strength.
dialogsFail: I said you may go now.

27961.name: Reporting Back to Sovann
27961.description: Go back to Sovann and report that you have delivered the magical water stone to Dr. Estly and encountered Shade's forces along the way.
dialogsBegin: It may take a little time, though, so while I work, you might want to head back and speak with Captain Sovann. I’m sure he’ll have more for you to do in the meantime.
dialogsAccept: Very well! You’re truly dedicated to uncovering the mysteries of Herneos. Report back to Sovann with the details it’s crucial he knows about Shade’s forces. Thank you for stepping up; your bravery will be invaluable in this journey!
dialogsDecline: What?! You’re turning back now? Reporting this information to Sovann is essential if we’re to understand Shade’s reach! But fine, if you’re not willing… Just remember, this discovery could change everything. Don’t let this chance slip by.
dialogsComplete: Ah, you’re back! Did you manage to deliver the magical water stone to Dr. Estly? And what did you find along the way? Any signs of Shade’s forces?
Thank you for reporting back to me. If Shade is behind these creatures, we need to assess the situation carefully. Go now and prepare yourself I fear this may only be the beginning.
dialogsFail: You didn’t deliver the message yet? We need to be fully aware of what’s happening in Herneos. Hurry back and let Sovann know what you encountered.

28235.name: Captain’s Test 3
28235.description: Kill 10 Captain Samosets and bring 1 Piece of Samoset Bone
dialogsBegin: There are even more reinforcements gathering. Sadly, our troops are tied up elsewhere and can’t handle them right now. This is the last task—teach them a lesson.
dialogsAccept: Defeat Captain Samoset and bring back proof. Then I’ll grant you permission to stay.
dialogsDecline: You’d better decide before they launch an attack.
dialogsComplete: Well done. I’ll issue your residency permit.
dialogsFail: Still not finished? Hmm…

28426.name: The Final Battle for Herneos
28426.description: Kill $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$ and return back to me.
dialogsBegin: Now that you’ve weakened the boss by taking out the two generals of Shade’s army, it would be wise for you to face her right hand before he regains his full power.
Me, go with you?!? (nervous laugh) Oh no, no… they always say not to change a winning team, and our way of teaming up is simply perfect, don’t you think?
And if you succeed, don’t forget to stop by the mayor of Flarine, he will surely reward you generously for this achievement!
dialogsAccept: Amazing! I knew I could count on you to see this through. Facing Shade’s right hand won’t be easy, but if anyone can do it, it’s you. Just remember if you succeed, don’t forget to see the mayor in Flarine. I’m sure he’ll have a worthy reward for you. Good luck, hero!
dialogsDecline: What?! You’re refusing? After all we’ve done to get this far? This is the final step! If you don’t finish this, Shade’s influence will only grow stronger. But… if you won’t go, we’ll just have to hope someone else has the courage. I only hope it’s not too late.
dialogsComplete: You did it! You've defeated Shade’s right hand! This is a monumental victory for Madrigal that will be remembered for ages. You’ve truly saved Herneos and brought hope back to our people.
dialogsFail: Back already? But Shade’s right hand is still out there, gathering strength! This is our final chance to stop her influence from spreading through Herneos. Please finish what you started. All of Madrigal is depending on you!

28593.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Elementor Master] Horison.
She’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Magician Master] Hee.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? She’s expecting you.

28658.name: Let’s Find the Real Clue
dialogsBegin: Oh… this has nothing to do with awakening.
It says that long ago, all continents were connected, and many races lived together.
This is exactly the kind of thing the Strange Collector in Saint City loves. He’d be thrilled if you brought it to him.
Now then… shall we speak about your awakening?
dialogsAccept: True strength awakens when you fight with your life on the line. It’s always been that way.
Enter the instance dungeon and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s to test your limits.
dialogsDecline: Is there another way? Maybe. It’s worth trying whatever you can. If you change your mind, come find me.
dialogsComplete: Well done. But you still haven’t awakened? How strange…
I know someone who can definitely help—if you’re willing to meet them.
Here, take this letter of introduction.
dialogsFail: You haven’t finished yet? Hmm… I thought you’d be done by now.

28701.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Jester Master] Lorein.
She’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Acrobat Master] Pyre.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? She’s expecting you.

28717.name: New Survivor of the Expedition? 2
28717.description: Meet with the Mayor of Saint City
dialogsBegin: No matter how I look at it, those tracks aren’t ours, and they don’t match those wolf fiends either.
dialogsAccept: I don’t think there’s much more I can tell you. Maybe ask someone who actually knows about the expedition. See if anyone recognizes this.
dialogsDecline: I doubt anyone in this village could help.
dialogsComplete: Was something like this among the expedition supplies?
dialogsFail: Do you have someone in mind?

28864.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Magician Master] Hee.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see him? He’s probably waiting impatiently.

29370.name: Find the Old Document
29370.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

29662.name: Scout Party
dialogsBegin: Thanks to what you brought back, I convinced the other investors, and we’ve decided to organize a second expedition. But considering the first expedition vanished and their ship crashed…
If we send another group out without understanding what happened, we risk the same disaster. That’s why we plan to send a scouting team first to investigate. Will you take on that role?
dialogsAccept: After reviewing the logbook, it seems we need to go even farther north, beyond the Gouthan Mountains of Darkon. It looks like there’s some kind of docking point there, so if you arrive safely, you should be able to land.
dialogsDecline: No matter how I look at it, you’re the only one fit for this job. I’ll be waiting for your answer.
dialogsComplete: Finally… I’m saved! I survived!
dialogsFail: Good luck, adventurer. May your flight be a safe one.

29663.name: Trophies from the Depths
dialogsBegin: While I compare the results, could you bring me samples or souvenirs from each creature? That would allow me to enrich our archives on these strange appearances.
dialogsAccept: Ah, wonderful! I knew you’d be up for the task. These new creatures are unlike anything we've documented, so any samples you bring will be invaluable. While you’re collecting them, I’ll start the comparison. Come back once you have the items, and we’ll see what these archives reveal about Herneos.
dialogsDecline: Really? You’re refusing? (Sighs) I suppose not everyone appreciates the importance of history… But fine, go ahead just remember that these discoveries are rare. Who knows if you'll get another chance to contribute to our knowledge of Herneos.
dialogsComplete: Ohhh, thank you for these souvenirs! I can finally… continue my collection... uh, enrich the city archives! (clears throat) Yes, of course, the archives!
dialogsFail: Ah, you’re back? But… I don’t see any of the samples I asked for. These souvenirs from the creatures are essential to my research, you know! Please, gather them quickly and return. The archives await your findings!

29714.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.
dialogsComplete:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you finally awakened?
This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.
So, what happened?

I see. So that’s how it went.
You may not have become a transcendent, but I’ll give you a small gift to celebrate your new strength.
dialogsFail: I said you may go now.

30375.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Assist Master] Maki.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see him? He’s probably waiting impatiently.

30633.name: Friend’s Testimony
dialogsBegin: Actually… something like this was found in western Flaris.
Look at this Saint City logo. I thought I should let him know, so I brought it to him.
But more pieces like this keep turning up, so I’ve been visiting him often.
He was shocked when he saw it, took it away, and told me not to speak of it to anyone. Do you want this?
dialogsAccept: As far as I know, these pieces came from the central region of the Leren Mountains. Fortunately for him, powerful masquerpets wander the area, keeping people away and stopping any rumors from spreading. But that shouldn’t be a problem for you.
dialogsDecline: Hmm? You don’t need it? Well, I can’t give you this piece, but if you need another one, feel free to ask.
dialogsComplete: Wait… this is…! How did you get this?
dialogsFail: I’ve already told you where it is, haven’t I? Someone like you shouldn’t have any trouble handling the monsters there and finding what you need.

31079.name: The Bloodstained Fangs of the Hellhound
31079.description: Perfect! Their blood-soaked fangs are deadly. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Hellhounds to us for forging.
31079.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: Hellhounds roam dangerously close to Kaillun, and their bloodied fangs leave lingering wounds. The Muran need them to forge weapons capable of driving these beasts back.
dialogsAccept: Perfect! Their blood-soaked fangs are deadly. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Hellhounds to us for forging.
dialogsDecline: Very well… but the Hellhounds still lurk around Kaillun.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work! Thanks to you, we can forge weapons worthy of the finest Muran warriors.
dialogsFail: You don’t have enough. Their fangs are essential to forge weapons that can repel them.

31391.name: Reunion 2
dialogsBegin: Did you enjoy meeting [Eillun Guard] Gard? I wonder who’s waiting for you next.
dialogsAccept: This time it’s Kaela. I don’t know exactly what she’s planning, but I’d say you’re in for something interesting.
dialogsDecline: No need to rush—take your time.
dialogsComplete: Ugh, I’ve stopped causing trouble for Mom and Dad, so stop looking at me like that.
dialogsFail: Have you met her yet? Honestly, I have no idea what she’s up to.

32223.name: Where Is the Mole
32223.description: Get 50 Stolen Supplies and 1 Secret Letter
dialogsBegin: Thanks to you, life in the village—and even the war—has become a bit more manageable. I should answer your questions as thanks, but… I have one more thing to ask.
dialogsAccept: We suspect there’s a Lycan spy in a high position. Our operations keep getting sabotaged, and supplies for one squad were stolen. Can you investigate and, if possible, get them back?
dialogsDecline: I hate to burden you, but there’s no one else I can trust with this.
dialogsComplete: He… he was the spy?
dialogsFail: The last known location was here. If they’re acting as they usually do, they shouldn’t be far.

32504.name: Guard’s Request 3
dialogsBegin: Those Captain Samosets keep slipping into the forest. Could you clear some of them out?
dialogsAccept: We’re grateful for your help. You know the area well enough to track them, right?
dialogsDecline: If you don’t have time, we’ll deal with it somehow.
dialogsComplete: I knew I could count on you. You’ve helped us a lot. Thanks.
dialogsFail: This should be a simple task for you.

32946.name: Honor of a Warrior 2
dialogsBegin: For a seasoned warrior, the real challenge is Captain Hundur Sharpfoot. Think you’re ready?
dialogsAccept: You already know how this works. No need for me to explain.
dialogsDecline: If you’re busy, that’s fine. The challenge isn’t going anywhere.
dialogsComplete: I knew I judged you correctly. From now on, you’re an elite warrior of our village.
dialogsFail: I’ll be looking forward to seeing what you can do.

32988.name: Elder’s Request 1
dialogsBegin: It looks like a group of Small Kanonicus are swarming somewhere in the forest. I’ve received complaints from the townsfolk. Could you lend a hand?
dialogsAccept: As always, thank you.
dialogsDecline: If you have other things to do, I’ll have to send a guard instead.
dialogsComplete: You did a great job. Now I can finally tell everyone they’re safe.
dialogsFail: You know where it is, don’t you?

33134.name: Prelude to the Counterattack
dialogsBegin: Thanks to you, we were finally able to breathe. And those Lycans… they never imagined an adventurer would appear, so now they’re on the back foot. This is our chance. Will you help us?
dialogsAccept: Before we start a full-scale battle, I need you to deal with the Kanonicus.
dialogsDecline: I have to admit, your strength is impressive. We can’t afford to let you go just yet.
dialogsComplete: Hahaha! The war against the Lycans is ours to win now. We owe you a great deal.
dialogsFail: The enemy’s gathering point is here.

33204.name: Meeting with Elders
dialogsBegin: Oh? You want to know more about us?
dialogsAccept: Then you should speak with the jarl or one of the elders. They’ve lived long and know our history well. However, it won’t be easy for an outsider to meet the jarl. I’ll introduce you to my superior, one of the elders. I’ll tell him in advance so you can go straight to him.
dialogsDecline: Well… you could try finding them on your own too.
dialogsComplete: So, you’re the one the captain mentioned.
dialogsFail: The elder is busy, so if you want to meet him quickly, you should hurry.

33575.name: Searching for Parents 1
dialogsBegin: Do you have a moment? I’ve seen how much you’ve helped the village, so I was hoping you could help me too.
dialogsAccept: My grandfather is the jarl, but my father was exiled and sent on a mission… he never returned. I fear they sent him to die. Please help me find his remains.
dialogsDecline: I see… then I’ll have to go alone. Thank you for at least listening.
dialogsComplete: Father… in the end…
dialogsFail: His last known destination… was there.

33878.name: Guard’s Request 4
dialogsBegin: Small Kyouchish are getting out of control and causing trouble. We could really use your help cutting their numbers.
dialogsAccept: I appreciate it. You won’t have any trouble finding them, right?
dialogsDecline: If you’re busy with something else, don’t worry. We’ll handle it.
dialogsComplete: I was right to trust you. You’ve made our job much easier. Thank you.
dialogsFail: This should be no challenge for you.

33930.name: Back to Town
dialogsBegin: The Lycans resisted fiercely, so the jarl has returned to town for now.
dialogsAccept: Let’s go back as well. I was ordered to wait here and report to you when you returned.
dialogsDecline: If you have other business, feel free to handle it first. Nothing around here is a real threat to you anymore.
dialogsComplete: I can’t thank you enough for everything.
dialogsFail: The jarl? He’s probably back at the town quarters.

33996.name: Reunion 3
dialogsBegin: Hope you had fun with Kaela. Who do you think is next?
dialogsAccept: Now it’s Livia’s turn. I’m not sure what she has planned either, but I’m sure it’ll be something special.
dialogsDecline: There’s no hurry. Go when you’re ready.
dialogsComplete: So in the end, that turned out to be something completely different… In any case, I can only imagine how much you’ve endured for us, even though we aren’t of the same kind. This is just a small token of our gratitude. Please accept it.
dialogsFail: Have you met her yet? I really have no idea what’s coming next.

34059.name: The Skulls of the Samoset
34059.description: Thank you! The Samoset spirits are becoming unstable. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Samoset so we can analyze their unrest.
34059.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: The Samoset spirits have grown increasingly aggressive in the plains. The sages of Kaillun seek their skulls to understand the source of their unusual unrest.
dialogsAccept: Thank you! The Samoset spirits are becoming unstable. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Samoset so we can analyze their unrest.
dialogsDecline: Very well… but their unrest intensifies each day. Return if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Perfect! These skulls will help us uncover the truth. Thank you for your help.
dialogsFail: You still don't have enough… Keep going, we must understand what's disturbing them.

34353.name: Guard’s Request 1
dialogsBegin: Small Samosets are pests that constantly bother our guards. Can you handle them and lighten our workload?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. You know where they are, right?
dialogsDecline: If you’re busy, we’ll figure something out on our own.
dialogsComplete: I knew you were the right one to ask. Our work just got much easier thanks to you. I really appreciate it.
dialogsFail: For someone like you, this should be nothing.

34630.name: It Will Be Different This Time
dialogsBegin: He is my master. Since he’s also a transcendent, he should know how.
Because of certain circumstances, he doesn’t appear in public, so most people don’t know he exists.
I just realized I gave you the letter without even hearing your answer.
Anyway, you don’t know where he is yet, do you? Will you go meet him?
dialogsAccept: These days, my master is secretly building a tower. He should still be there.
Show him my letter. He won’t ignore it.
dialogsDecline: Even for me, this is a big favor to ask. If you feel you’re not ready, you can come back later.
dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

34697.name: Let’s Find the Real Clue
dialogsBegin: Oh… this has nothing to do with awakening.
It says that long ago, all continents were connected, and many races lived together.
This is exactly the kind of thing the Strange Collector in Saint City loves. He’d be thrilled if you brought it to him.
Now then… shall we speak about your awakening?
dialogsAccept: True strength awakens when you fight with your life on the line. It’s always been that way.
Enter the instance dungeon and defeat $QUEST_END_KILL_COUNT$ $QUEST_END_KILL_NAME$s to test your limits.
dialogsDecline: Is there another way? Maybe. It’s worth trying whatever you can. If you change your mind, come find me.
dialogsComplete: Well done. But you still haven’t awakened? How strange…
I know someone who can definitely help—if you’re willing to meet them.
Here, take this letter of introduction.
dialogsFail: You haven’t finished yet? Hmm… I thought you’d be done by now.

34762.name: An Incident! 3
dialogsBegin: Hmm… well, the air feels different.
dialogsAccept: Only Myurang and adventurers live here, but I’ve caught a faint whiff of those wolf fiends. It was stronger near the southern outskirts. Maybe ask Artin? He’s a skilled hunter—he might have noticed more.
dialogsDecline: Other than that? Hmm, let me think…
dialogsComplete: Something strange lately? Hmm…
dialogsFail: If you’re looking for Artin, head farther south.

34996.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Blade Master] Corel.
He’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Mercenary Master] Andy.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? He’s expecting you.

dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

35461.name: Reunion 4
dialogsBegin: Well, I think this will be your final visitor. Any guesses who?
dialogsAccept: Taila is next. Whatever happens, I have a feeling it will be something meaningful.
dialogsDecline: Don’t feel pressured. Go at your own pace.
dialogsComplete: Thanks to you, adventurer, I found my parents’ hidden will. My father exposed the jarl’s crimes, and my grandfather had him killed. Branded a traitor, he was nearly murdered. Please avenge them. Take this, and let it fuel your revenge.
dialogsFail: Did you meet her? I still don’t know what she’s planning.

35514.name: Pursuit
dialogsBegin: Thanks to your work, we launched a surprise attack and sent them running. We even found some who couldn’t keep up. Would you finish them off and send them to their gods?
dialogsAccept: We’re moving to chase down the main force.
dialogsDecline: But we don’t have spare troops to deal with the stragglers.
dialogsComplete: Oh, you did it?
dialogsFail: Perfect. We’ll leave them to you and continue the pursuit.

35551.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.

This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.

I see. So that’s how it went.

I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Knight Master] Karandur.
He’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.

Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? He’s expecting you.

36291.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Blade Master] Corel even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

37470.name: Guard’s Request 5
dialogsBegin: Our guards are worn down dealing with Kyouchish. If you could defeat a few, it’d be a huge help.
dialogsAccept: Thank you. You know how to find them, right?
dialogsDecline: If you’ve got other plans, it’s alright. We’ll make do.
dialogsComplete: I knew you’d handle it. You’ve made our lives much easier. Truly, thank you.
dialogsFail: This should be simple work for someone of your skill.

37543.name: The Ever-Turning Vicious Cycle of Blood
dialogsBegin: Chief Keokuk had this? What madness. So this war was just a game played by him and the traitor…
The Lycans worship the demon Ankou as their god. The traitor must have made a deal, selling us out to fuel this war. To fully summon a demon, a great amount of blood is required.
According to the note you brought, they’ve already attempted the summoning, but it’s incomplete. Their final goal must be to complete that abomination.
At the edge of the continent lies Ankou’s sealed asylum. If the traitor is there, it’s up to you whether to kill him or bring him back. Please, put an end to this insanity.
dialogsAccept: You are a hero of Muran. You must finish this. If this continues, the whole continent will be soaked in blood.
dialogsDecline: You’ve already done so much, but if I may, I’d like to ask you once more.
dialogsComplete: So… you’ve come all the way here.
dialogsFail: I pray this ends without more tragedy.

dialogsFail: You haven’t finished yet? Hmm… I thought you’d be done by now.

37960.name: Climax
dialogsBegin: Do I look pathetic to you? A traitor, betrayed and left to die… What would an outsider like you understand? Do you have any idea how much torment I’ve endured to get this far? No, explaining is pointless. In the end, we all meet the same fate.
dialogsAccept: Go on. Ankou will give you peace. My granddaughter wanted revenge? Ha. I lost my wife long ago and never had a child—how could I have a granddaughter? Kuhuhu… so even you… (dies)
dialogsDecline: What’s wrong? Are you afraid now that you have to face a demon? It’s too late for that.
dialogsComplete: What happened? Is Ankou defeated? The handwriting on this page… so the traitor is gone as well.
dialogsFail: (He’s dead.)

38547.name: Proficiency Test
dialogsBegin: Oy! Halt! Who are you? …That’s quite a story. Suspicious. Are you a Lycan spy? If not, prove it.
dialogsAccept: Defeat 20 Hundur Sharpfoots, and then I’ll believe you.
dialogsDecline: Hmph! I knew it. You must be a spy!
dialogsComplete: (Hmm… seems stronger than me…)
dialogsFail: What? You can’t even handle that? Pathetic. There’s no way I can let you into the village like this.

38563.name: New Survivor of the Expedition? 1
dialogsBegin: Oh, adventurer, do you have a moment? You’re looking for traces of the vanished expedition, right?
While hunting, I found tracks that didn’t belong to Myurang or Lycan. Interested?
dialogsAccept: Here, I’ll mark the spot for you.
dialogsDecline: No worries. I’ll keep a record of it, so come back whenever you want the location again.
dialogsComplete: Did you forget where it is?
dialogsFail: Well… that’s not exactly what I saw, but…

39118.name: The Gear Begins to Turn Again
dialogsBegin: So that’s how it was… What on earth happened to the crew of that ship? For now, let me examine this strange material.
I can use it to calm the investors. With this logbook, we might even be able to send a follow-up expedition. Hmm… Could you show the logbook and this material to the Strange Collector?
dialogsAccept: He should be the first to know. Thank you.
dialogsDecline: Well, if you change your mind, you can come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: Welcome back. How did it go? I knew it—my research wasn’t wrong after all. I truly owe you. It’s not much, but please accept this as my thanks. Things are going to get busy from here on…
dialogsFail: Have you shown it to him yet? Don’t worry, I’m not rushing you.

39440.name: To the Jarl
dialogsBegin: So, you’re that adventurer. Thanks to you, the village is finally settling down. Because of that—or maybe because he suddenly has time—the jarl wants to meet you. I’ll put in a good word, so go see him when you can.
dialogsAccept: If your people want to form ties with our village, you’ll need his approval anyway.
dialogsDecline: Well then, come back when you’re free.
dialogsComplete: So, you’re the adventurer I’ve heard so much about.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone? He may be an old man with little to do, but you should probably hurry.

39964.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Ranger Master] Eliff.
She’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Acrobat Master] Pyre.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? She’s expecting you.

40294.name: The Devil’s Teeth
40294.description: Be brave! The Devil Spirits are growing in number. Their teeth must be sealed. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Devil Spirits.
40294.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: A strange corruption spreads through Kaillun as Devil Spirits multiply. Their teeth contain a demonic essence the sages wish to seal away.
dialogsAccept: Be brave! The Devil Spirits are growing in number. Their teeth must be sealed. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Devil Spirits.
dialogsDecline: I understand… but their influence spreads further each night. Return carefully.
dialogsComplete: Very good! These teeth will be purified and neutralized. You’ve done us a great service.
dialogsFail: Not enough teeth to contain the demonic energy yet. Keep gathering.

40353.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Mercenary Master] Andy.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see him? He’s probably waiting impatiently.

40837.name: A Taste of Inspiration
40837.description: Deliver a special gift to the novelist to lift his spirits and help him continue writing.
dialogsBegin: Oh, hello there, young adventurer! What a pleasure to meet you! Say, could you do me a favor?
There's a novelist in our lovely town whose work I deeply admire, but it seems he's feeling a bit down lately, which is delaying his next masterpiece.
Would you be so kind as to deliver this to him on my behalf? I believe it might lift his spirits!
dialogsAccept: Oh, wonderful! I knew I could count on you! This small gesture might be just what he needs to find inspiration again. Please, deliver it to him as soon as you can, and let me know how he reacts! Thank you, brave adventurer!
dialogsDecline: Oh… I see. That’s unfortunate. I was really hoping you could help… but I understand. If you ever change your mind, please let me know. His words have brought joy to so many, and it pains me to see him struggling.
dialogsComplete: Huh? What’s this...?" (opens the package, raises an eyebrow, then bursts into laughter)
Two pizzas and… milk? Haha! She really knows me too well! Just the sight of this is enough to bring back my motivation! There’s nothing like a good meal to get the creative juices flowing!
(takes a more serious but grateful tone)
dialogsFail: Oh, adventurer! You haven’t delivered the gift yet? The poor novelist must still be struggling with his writer’s block... Please, don’t keep him waiting too long! A little kindness can go a long way, and I know this will cheer him up!

40956.name: A Good Friend Is… 2
40956.description: Kill 5 Captain Kyouchish and obtain 1 “Lycan Orders”
dialogsBegin: Ha, they barely know me better than some stranger, and now they suddenly care? Huh… Outside? Did I say something about that? No… I don’t remember.
dialogsAccept: Ugh, fine, whatever. Yeah, I’ve been hanging out with the wolves. The other kids here don’t get me, and this village is doomed sooner or later. What’s the point? If you want to drag me back, then deal with all my friends first.
dialogsDecline: Hah! Chickened out already?
dialogsComplete: I-I’m sorry… Just… please don’t hurt me…
dialogsFail: If you can’t do it, just pretend you never saw me and walk away.

41131.name: The Truth of the Expedition
dialogsBegin: Ah, I see. Did the Strange Collector send you?
dialogsAccept: I have nothing to tell you about that. Just go back.
dialogsDecline: Hmm? If not, then why did you come to me?
dialogsComplete: Hmm? Do I know anything about the mayor?
dialogsFail: Even for you, I have nothing more to say.

41379.name: Covering Fire
dialogsBegin: I know you just got back, but could I ask a favor? An elder leading our retreat requested reinforcements. Can you go help them escape safely?
dialogsAccept: That’s a relief. Thank you.
dialogsDecline: It won’t be easy, but you’re the only one I can send. It’s troubling.
dialogsComplete: The elder should be waiting for you there.
dialogsFail: Who’s there? Come out and identify yourself!

41698.name: Where Did the Expedition Go 2
41698.description: Kill 25 Small Kyouchish and get 1 Lycan Operation Plan
dialogsBegin: This is Kyouchish fur. Kyouchish are elite Lycan warriors.
It seems they attacked and wiped out the remaining members of that expedition. Since their territory was invaded by that large group, they’re probably still on high alert around there.
dialogsAccept: If you defeat some Small Kyouchish and bring back any written orders or notes, I’ll translate them for you.
dialogsDecline: Do you have a better lead than this?
dialogsComplete: Ah, you got it. Let me see…
dialogsFail: You remember the place, right?

41940.name: It Will Be Different This Time
dialogsBegin: He is my master. Since he’s also a transcendent, he should know how.
Because of certain circumstances, he doesn’t appear in public, so most people don’t know he exists.
I just realized I gave you the letter without even hearing your answer.
Anyway, you don’t know where he is yet, do you? Will you go meet him?
dialogsAccept: These days, my master is secretly building a tower. He should still be there.
Show him my letter. He won’t ignore it.
dialogsDecline: Even for me, this is a big favor to ask. If you feel you’re not ready, you can come back later.
dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

42011.name: It Will Be Different This Time
dialogsBegin: He is my master. Since he’s also a transcendent, he should know how.
Because of certain circumstances, he doesn’t appear in public, so most people don’t know he exists.
I just realized I gave you the letter without even hearing your answer.
Anyway, you don’t know where he is yet, do you? Will you go meet him?
dialogsAccept: These days, my master is secretly building a tower. He should still be there.
Show him my letter. He won’t ignore it.
dialogsDecline: Even for me, this is a big favor to ask. If you feel you’re not ready, you can come back later.
dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

42491.name: What is Lifestyle?
dialogsBegin: Welcome. There are times when you want to achieve different type of strengths. Do you wish to try something new that’s not related to hunting monsters?
dialogsAccept: Good choice. I have something to give you so speak to me again.
dialogsDecline: Come back when you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Currently I have 8 techniques to teach you. If you follow my lead you’ll soon learn them. This will help you when you try them out.

42710.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Jester Master] Lorein even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

42959.name: Reunion 1
dialogsBegin: If we’d tried to hold them off from inside, they probably would’ve broken through. With their forces this weakened, they shouldn’t have many left.
Once things calm down, we’re planning a counterattack. Would you help us again? Oh, and before that, some villagers have been looking for you. They want to thank you personally.
dialogsAccept: Why don’t you visit [Eillun Guard] Gard first? I heard you helped him a lot—and he might be preparing something big for you.
dialogsDecline: You’ve done more than enough, so don’t feel pressured.
dialogsComplete: You’ve worked incredibly hard. Every battle was tough, but I’m sure you’ll bring us victory again. This isn’t much, but please accept it.
dialogsFail: Have you met them yet? Even I don’t know what they’ve prepared for you.

43157.name: Searching for Parents 2
dialogsBegin: But… was that all? He loved writing things down. There must be something more.
dialogsAccept: Thank you so much. Anything you can find—no matter how small—would mean the world to me.
dialogsDecline: It’s alright. You’ve already done a lot. But if you ever change your mind, please come back.
dialogsComplete: This handwriting… it’s definitely my father’s. Thank you so much. It looks like he tried to write in code. I need to decode it right away.
dialogsFail: There’s really nothing else? Ah…

43804.name: Straggler
dialogsBegin: Good to meet you. I’m Beck from Saint City. I… well, I was part of the expedition. Beasts attacked us, and I got separated from the others.
Our captain didn’t even check if everyone was on board before taking off. When the attack started, I just happened to be wasting time in the forest. Thanks to that, I survived.
A second expedition? That’s a relief. I’ll join them and go home as soon as they arrive. But… could I ask you for a favor?
dialogsAccept: I lost my serial number chain while fleeing from those beasts. I searched where I dropped it, but it was gone. It might still be somewhere nearby. Could you go and look for it? Please, I’m counting on you.
dialogsDecline: If you change your mind, please come back.
dialogsComplete: I can’t thank you enough for your help. While you were gone, some beastmen—different from the ones that attacked me—showed up. They gave me food and pointed out a place before leaving. Eat something, then head over there.
dialogsFail: Those creatures went that way!

45035.name: Captain’s Test 1
dialogsBegin: A hairless outsider in our village… What were the guards doing? So, you want to stay here? We’re at war with the Lycans. For all I know, you might be one of their spies. I can’t allow you to stay without proof.
dialogsAccept: Kill 25 Small Samosets. That’ll at least get us talking.
dialogsDecline: If you can’t handle something that simple, I can’t let you in.
dialogsComplete: Already done? Alright. I can say you’re not one of those dog spies.
dialogsFail: If you finish quickly, you’ll be able to use the village facilities sooner.

45758.name: Lost your chain again?
45758.description: Kill 50 Small Hundur Sharpfoots and obtain 1 Abandoned Serial Number Chain
dialogsBegin: Could you help me, sir? That thing stole my belongings again. I’ll be punished if I don’t get my serial number chain back. Please help me.
dialogsAccept: Oh gods, thank you.
dialogsDecline: Think of it as helping the dead, just this once… Please, I beg you.
dialogsComplete: I can’t thank you enough.
dialogsFail: Have you retrieved it yet? Ah, not yet, I see.

45933.name: Where Did the Expedition Go 1
45933.description: Search the forest and obtain “Unknown Fur Ball”
dialogsBegin: So, what brought you all the way here? Hmm… I don’t remember seeing anything like that. I rarely leave the forest, so I wouldn’t know.
Wait… yes, there were reports of several loud explosions from the east. I’m not sure if it’s related, but do you want to check it out?
dialogsAccept: It’s not far, but it’s Lycan territory. We haven’t been able to investigate. If you find anything, bring it to me. I’ll help you examine it.
dialogsDecline: You might find other clues elsewhere too. Don’t worry if you want to follow your own leads.
dialogsComplete: Did you find what you were looking for? You found this there?
dialogsFail: You should be fine, but stay careful.

46485.name: New Survivor of the Expedition? 3
dialogsBegin: No… I’ve never seen anything like this. Everything that was on the ship is listed here, and there’s nothing even close to this strange object.
dialogsAccept: Hmm… this doesn’t look ordinary. You should ask a historian.
dialogsDecline: Let’s see… Who might know about something like this…
dialogsComplete: Where did you find this? The seal is still intact, so that’s good—but this artifact is dangerous. For now, you’re not ready to know more. Get stronger, and I’ll tell you when the time is right.
dialogsFail: It looks like the expedition really was wiped out. There’s nothing left of them.

46514.name: Find the Old Document
46514.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

46662.name: Find the Old Document
46662.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

46740.name: The Kanonicus Antidote
46740.description: Thank you! Their natural antidote is vital for our wounded soldiers. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Kanonicus.
46740.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: The Kanonicus carry a natural antidote within their dorsal glands. Kaillun urgently needs it to heal warriors poisoned by the Lycans.
dialogsAccept: Thank you! Their natural antidote is vital for our wounded soldiers. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Kanonicus.
dialogsDecline: A shame… several warriors are still waiting to be treated.
dialogsComplete: Perfect! Thanks to you, we can finally treat our wounded.
dialogsFail: You don’t have enough yet. Hurry, every drop counts.

46797.name: Find the Old Document
46797.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
