dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

46947.name: The Writer’s Legacy
46947.description: Find a copy of the Book of Techniques at the Fountain of the Departed for the novelist’s final chapter.
dialogsBegin: Adventurer, your help has been invaluable! Thanks to you, my novel is shaping up to be something truly extraordinary. But before I finish, I need one last piece of inspiration… something legendary.

At the Fountain of the Departed, there is said to be a copy of the Book of Techniques, an ancient manuscript filled with lost knowledge. If you could retrieve an example of it for me, I promise to help you take the next step in your own journey. What do you say?
dialogsAccept: You will? That’s incredible! This book holds secrets that could bring my story to life like never before! But be careful, such knowledge does not rest unguarded. I have no doubt you’ll succeed, though. Return to me as soon as you find it!
dialogsDecline: Oh… I see. I won’t lie, I had high hopes. This book could be the key to my masterpiece… But I understand. If you change your mind, the offer still stands. And remember, I could help you in ways no ordinary teacher could.
dialogsComplete: You found it? Let me see… This is… astonishing! The pages, the ink, the wisdom held within… It’s more than I ever imagined! With this, my novel will be remembered for generations! And as promised, I will help you take your next step. You’ve done so much for me it’s only fair that I return the favor!
dialogsFail: Still no sign of the Book of Techniques? I understand, it must be difficult to retrieve. But I assure you, this is no ordinary task. If you succeed, both of our fates could change forever. I believe in you, adventurer!

47055.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.
dialogsComplete:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you finally awakened?
This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.
So, what happened?

I see. So that’s how it went.
You may not have become a transcendent, but I’ll give you a small gift to celebrate your new strength.
dialogsFail: I said you may go now.

47122.name: New Town Life?
dialogsBegin: Welcome, stranger. You’re now in Eillun Town, the refuge of the Myurangs. Wait, you defeated Captain Hundur Sharpfoot? Ah, so you fell for his trick. I only sent him out for training because he’s always slacking off.
Don’t worry, I’ll give him a much harsher assignment next time. To stay in this village, you’ll need the captain’s approval. He’s strict, so expect more tests.
dialogsAccept: You can find him over there. Go talk to him yourself.
dialogsDecline: What will he ask you to do? No idea.
dialogsComplete: Who are you?
dialogsFail: Just know that without his approval, you won’t be able to do much in this village.

47145.name: Back to the New World
dialogsBegin: I was certain, but… to think my research really was correct. I’d love to visit that continent myself, but I need to stay here and handle preparations. Can you go ahead and investigate further?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. I hope we meet again there soon.
dialogsDecline: You know you’re the only one suited for this. If you change your mind, let me know. I’ll make it worth your while.
dialogsComplete: Back again? What’s going on this time?
dialogsFail: You’re still here… When do you think you’ll leave?

47817.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Ringmaster Master] Ellend even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

48649.name: Captain’s Test 2
dialogsBegin: But staying in town is a different matter. We’ve received reports that the enemies you defeated are gathering in one place.
dialogsAccept: I’ll tell you where. Go there and take them out before they can plan anything.
dialogsDecline: It’s your choice, but if you want to stay, you’ll have to deal with them eventually.
dialogsComplete: Impressive. I underestimated you. My apologies.
dialogsFail: We need to crush them before they attack the village. That’s what matters.

48752.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Knight Master] Karandur even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

49712.name: A Good Friend Is… 3
dialogsBegin: W-What? I said I was wrong already. What now? You want me to read this?
dialogsAccept: Fine, hand it over.
dialogsDecline: What do you want now?
dialogsComplete: “Find a foolish child, play along, and turn them into a perfect puppet to sow chaos in the village.” So I was just a piece in their stupid game…? Ugh… I can’t believe I fell for it. You want me to go home and apologize to my parents? Tch, I already know that much.
dialogsFail: Alright, alright, I’m reading it.

50508.name: An Incident! 4
dialogsBegin: Oh, the wolf scent? I’m used to it from the forest, but… now that you mention it, yeah, I’ve noticed it too. sniff Hmm… will you believe me?
dialogsAccept: I know it sounds crazy, but… Belia smells like a wolf. Could you check on her for me? I… I just can’t do it myself.
dialogsDecline: I don’t have the courage to see my friend turn out to be a traitor…
dialogsComplete: Huh? You’re saying I smell like what? What kind of nonsense is that?
dialogsFail: Belia… please…

50527.name: Find the Old Document
50527.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

50560.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Knight Master] Karandur.
He’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Assist Master] Maki.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? He’s expecting you.

51598.name: Toward the Final Battle
dialogsBegin: Leave the rest to us.
dialogsAccept: Elder Ayr is urgently looking for you, so you should go see him.
dialogsDecline: We can clean up what’s left on our own.
dialogsComplete: Welcome back, adventurer.
dialogsFail: I didn’t catch all the details, but it sounded important.

51907.name: It Will Be Different This Time
dialogsBegin: He is my master. Since he’s also a transcendent, he should know how.
Because of certain circumstances, he doesn’t appear in public, so most people don’t know he exists.
I just realized I gave you the letter without even hearing your answer.
Anyway, you don’t know where he is yet, do you? Will you go meet him?
dialogsAccept: These days, my master is secretly building a tower. He should still be there.
Show him my letter. He won’t ignore it.
dialogsDecline: Even for me, this is a big favor to ask. If you feel you’re not ready, you can come back later.
dialogsComplete: Only a handful of people know I’m here. Who are you, and what do you want?
dialogsFail: Go meet him quickly. He’s… a busy man.

52055.name: Wisdom’s Legacy
52055.description: Deliver the Book of Techniques to the historian so its knowledge can be preserved, and claim your reward.
dialogsBegin: Adventurer, I can’t thank you enough! This book… it was exactly what I needed. I’ve taken all the notes I require, but such a treasure should not be wasted. There’s someone who would truly appreciate it, our town’s historian.

She has dedicated her life to preserving knowledge, and this book deserves a place in her archives. If you deliver it to her, I’m sure she’ll reward you well enough to take your next step… your first specialization. What do you say?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! I knew you would understand the importance of preserving knowledge. The historian will be thrilled to receive such a rare manuscript. Go, adventurer, and take this final step toward your destiny!
dialogsDecline: Oh… I see. That’s unfortunate. This book holds so much wisdom, it would be a shame to let it go to waste. If you ever change your mind, please reconsider. This could be the final key to unlocking your future.
dialogsComplete: (She carefully flips through the pages, completely fascinated.)

I will make a faithful copy to ensure this wisdom is never lost. You have done a great service to history today." She closes the book and looks at you with a grateful smile. "And of course, I won’t let your efforts go unrewarded.
Take this, consider it a token of my gratitude. With it, you should have everything you need to take the next step in your journey. May your path be filled with knowledge and greatness!
dialogsFail: The book is still with you? Hmm… I don’t mean to rush, but knowledge like this should not be kept hidden for too long. The historian is waiting, and so is your destiny. When you're ready, make sure it reaches the right hands.

52063.name: Report
dialogsBegin: There was? Then… did you find any trace of the expedition? My gods… what a disaster. At least there’s one survivor. For now, we must keep this quiet.

We can’t hide it forever, of course, but if we reveal it now, everything we’re planning will collapse. I’ll make an official announcement when we begin recruiting for the second expedition. Did you meet the Strange Collector?

Please tell them I’m alive. I’ll join the second expedition when they arrive and return home. I don’t want to stay in this land any longer. I know it’s a lot to ask, but… could you avenge my fallen comrades before you leave for Madrigal?
dialogsAccept: He’s waiting for you. You should go see him.
dialogsDecline: He’s your employer, after all. You’re probably exhausted from flying and fighting, but shouldn’t you visit him?
dialogsComplete: You’re back. Good. I can sense good news.
dialogsFail: He’s still at his usual place. You know where that is.

52671.name: The Magic Skulls of the Redcloud
52671.description: Very well! Their skulls contain a mysterious energy. We must study it. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Redcloud.
52671.descriptionComplete: $QUEST_END_NPC_NAME$ thanks you from the bottom of his heart! Glory to the Murans!
dialogsBegin: The Redcloud generate a mysterious energy within their skulls. Muran shamans want to study this magic to reinforce the city's protective wards.
dialogsAccept: Very well! Their skulls contain a mysterious energy. We must study it. Bring back 325 $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$ from the Redcloud.
dialogsDecline: Alright… but this magic could strengthen our defenses.
dialogsComplete: Excellent work! These skulls are a true source of power.
dialogsFail: You don’t have enough energy-charged skulls yet. Keep going!

52722.name: Help Muran!
52722.description: Complete 30 daily quests in Eillun Town
dialogsBegin: I don’t mind telling you about our village, but I have a favor to ask first.
dialogsAccept: As you know, we Muran are at war with the Lycans, and we’re badly outnumbered. I’ve heard you’ve already defeated quite a few of them. While you’re here, I’d like you to support our young warriors.
dialogsDecline: If you have more urgent matters, I understand. You can return when you’re free.
dialogsComplete: You’ve done an incredible job.
dialogsFail: We can continue our talk afterwards.

52968.name: Seeking the Witness… 1
dialogsBegin: Well… I don’t know anything about this shipwreck, but there is someone who might.
dialogsAccept: A High-Dwarpet named Liekyen might know something. You should go see him.
dialogsDecline: Of course, you can search elsewhere first if you prefer.
dialogsComplete: A shipwreck? Ah… you mean that one.
dialogsFail: You haven’t gone yet? That’s really all I can think of.

53108.name: The Gateway to Awakening
dialogsBegin: I see… the power inside you isn’t enough to awaken as a transcendent.
Still, you have the potential to reach a whole new realm.
[Ranger Master] Eliff even wrote you a letter of introduction just to send you to me.
But I’m not sure I want to help someone I barely know.
Can you do exactly as I say, without question? It’s nothing difficult.
dialogsAccept: See the orbs scattered around Kaillun? Choose the one that draws you and bring it to me. I need to look into your past.
dialogsDecline: I have no regrets about this choice. Think carefully.
dialogsComplete: Hmm… I believe you’ll be fine.
I’ll gladly help you open the door to a new realm.

Stay right where you are.
It’s done. I need to rest now, so you may leave.
dialogsFail: If you can’t even handle this, that sort of power would only weigh you down.

53625.name: Reignited Passion
53625.description: Meet with the Mayor of Saint City
dialogsBegin: Adventurer, you’ve come at the perfect time. We’re preparing a second expedition based on the logbook you found.
This time, we plan to send a scouting party before the main group. Would you be willing to be part of that team?
dialogsAccept: Go see the mayor of Saint City.
dialogsDecline: I don’t think anyone is better suited for this than you. But there’s still some time before we depart, so you can decide at your own pace.
dialogsComplete: Welcome, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You know where the mayor is, right?

53800.name: Counterattack
dialogsBegin: I heard from [Captain] Baron that your ambush went well. Thanks to you, the enemy is completely confused. We can’t waste this chance. We’ll launch a diversion. In the meantime, can you handle the Taiaha?
dialogsAccept: That’s reassuring.
dialogsDecline: Hmm. Do you have a different suggestion?
dialogsComplete: Excellent work.
dialogsFail: Good. I’ll be waiting for more good news.

53985.name: An Incident! 1
dialogsBegin: Ah, you’re the adventurer who’s been helping us. Even though we’re at war, the village itself has always been peaceful… but lately, something feels wrong.
We’ve heard strange howls, and there are unusual claw marks on the trees in town. If you have time, could you help us investigate?
dialogsAccept: It looks like those Kanonicus have come too close to the village. Could you deal with them?
dialogsDecline: If it’s too much trouble, I’ll try to find someone else.
dialogsComplete: Thank you for your hard work. But… even after thinning their numbers, the reports keep coming.
dialogsFail: Their usual gathering spot is the place I mentioned earlier. If you head that way, you should find something.

54080.name: Investigation Begins
dialogsBegin: Hmm, this won’t take long. In the meantime, how about hunting some Kyouchish?
dialogsAccept: They’re near the enemy camp.
dialogsDecline: If you don’t feel like it, I won’t force you. Come back if you change your mind.
dialogsComplete: Back already? The translation’s done. Here, take it.
dialogsFail: It’s best to finish this quickly. I’ll have the translation ready when you return.

54430.name: The New Beginning
dialogsBegin: It’s done. Do you feel anything?
dialogsAccept: I need to rest, so go back to the sage who sent you here.
dialogsDecline: The ritual definitely worked. Take a bit more time to reflect on yourself, then come to me again.
dialogsComplete:
Welcome, adventurer. Have you finally awakened?
This is my first time seeing a transcendent in person.

You say you haven’t awakened, yet I can clearly sense your power.
So, what happened?

I see. So that’s how it went.
You may not have become a transcendent, but I’ll give you a small gift to celebrate your new strength.
dialogsFail: I said you may go now.

54529.name: Clearing the Area
dialogsBegin: There are so many Captain Kyouchish around that I can’t rest in peace. Could you take care of them?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. I heard their howls coming from that way.
dialogsDecline: You’re the only one I can rely on.
dialogsComplete: Now I can finally rest easy until the next ship arrives. Thank you.
dialogsFail: I’m counting on you, sir.

55012.name: The Call of the Lawolf
55012.description: Defeat 5 Young Lawolfs and bring back your findings to the novelist.
dialogsBegin: You know, adventurer, now that my spirits are lifted, I can finally get back to writing!
But there’s one problem… I need inspiration for my next chapter, and I want to write about Lawolfs.
The problem is, I don’t know enough about them! Would you be willing to gather some information on these creatures for me?
dialogsAccept: Ah, fantastic! I knew I could count on you! Lawolfs are fascinating creatures, but I need accurate details to make my story truly come to life.
Go observe them, take notes, and bring me everything you learn! I can't wait to hear what you find!
dialogsDecline: Oh… I see. That’s disappointing, but I suppose I’ll have to manage without it. I just hope my story won’t end up being full of mistakes… If you change your mind, let me know!
dialogsComplete: Ah, you’re back! Let’s see what you’ve got… Hmm… Interesting! So that’s how they behave? And their fur… I never would have imagined! This is exactly what I needed!
Thank you, adventurer, you’ve been an invaluable help. Now, it’s time to turn these notes into an unforgettable story!
dialogsFail: Still no news on the Lawolfs? I don’t mean to rush you, but I’m eager to continue my novel! The more I wait, the more my ideas fade… Please, if you have time, I’d really appreciate your help!

55313.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Acrobat Master] Pyre.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see her? She’s probably waiting impatiently.

55319.name: Leave This to the Experts
dialogsBegin: So, is this your grand discovery?
I don’t know what it is either, but I know someone who might.
dialogsAccept: Go see [Billposter Master] Ride.
He’s an expert on ancient artifacts. Even if it doesn’t help your awakening, at least it’ll satisfy your curiosity.
dialogsDecline: There’s plenty of time. Once you’ve handled your urgent matters, come back. I’ll let them know in advance.
dialogsComplete: It’s been a while, adventurer. I already heard from [Assist Master] Maki.
You have something to show me, and you’re searching for clues about awakening?
Let me see the item first.
dialogsFail: What are you waiting for? She’s expecting you.

55711.name: Seeking the Witness… 2
dialogsBegin: It was deep in the mountains. I saw a shadow and thought it was a monster… but it turned out to be a ship falling from the sky.

There was no one on board, even when I searched it the first time. Not a single body. I checked around to see if there was anything useful, but all I found was a book full of strange codes. Curious what it says?
dialogsAccept: I couldn’t make heads or tails of it, so I handed it over to Inisis. If you’re interested, go talk to her.
dialogsDecline: Not curious? Well, that’s your choice.
dialogsComplete: Ah, you’ve come for the logbook?
dialogsFail: Inisis knows the details. If she finishes deciphering it, could you come back and tell me what she found?

56120.name: Hero Grade (4)
dialogsBegin: Here you are again!? The last time was too easy... What if we put it back but a notch up?
I need you to reach level 180 and bring $QUEST_END_ITEM_COUNT$x $QUEST_END_ITEM_NAME$. Only a true Hero can do that.
dialogsAccept: Great! Then I’ll wait here!
dialogsDecline: No problem, just come back!
dialogsComplete: Great! I expected no less from you. Here’s your reward.
dialogsFail: You haven’t been able to complete our arrangement? Too bad, others will!

56966.name: An Incident! 2
dialogsBegin: It seems something has already slipped into the village. Our captain must have sensed it too—he’s ordered tighter security. But with so few guards, nobody can spare time to investigate.
dialogsAccept: Could you go around and ask the villagers if they’ve noticed anything strange? Thank you, truly.
dialogsDecline: Don’t worry about me, I’ll manage.
dialogsComplete: Have I noticed anything weird lately?
dialogsFail: I’ve already given you the list, remember? Please look into it.

57180.name: Again, the Town
dialogsBegin: Thinking about it… those Lycans are mages. They might have tracked us with some kind of magic. Or… maybe the jarl really did abandon us.
One of our scouts reported a pack of Lycans heading toward the village. Please go help defend it.
dialogsAccept: I’m glad you’ve come.
dialogsDecline: We might not have much time left.
dialogsComplete: You arrived just in time. Without you, the village would have been in serious danger.
dialogsFail: I’ll follow as soon as I can.

57361.name: Chaos
dialogsBegin: We’ve been covering our tracks while retreating. There’s no way the Lycans should’ve found us. We’ll hold as long as we can. Please, report our situation to the elder.
dialogsAccept: Grr… Huh… Please hurry!
dialogsDecline: Please! We can’t last much longer alone.
dialogsComplete: The Lycans… are they swarming again?
dialogsFail: We won’t hold out for long.

58091.name: Find the Old Document
58091.description: Find a “Stale Record” from Herneos. People say they’ve seen them near the Small Dorians.
dialogsBegin: Yes, I heard everything from Radyon.
Awakening, huh… from what I can see, you’re already more than ready.
If the right opportunity comes, you might be able to awaken.
dialogsAccept: A new area was discovered deep beneath the seas of Coral Island. Adventurers are flocking there, hoping for new discoveries.
Why not dive in? You might find something unique and awaken your true potential.
dialogsDecline: I thought this would be a good chance for you, but so be it. If you change your mind, come back anytime.
dialogsComplete: It seems you couldn’t awaken this time, but you still did well. Did you find anything?
dialogsFail: You should hurry. If others get there first, there might be nothing left to find.

58115.name: Honor of a Warrior 1
dialogsBegin: If you call yourself a warrior of Kaillun, taking down Hundur Sharpfoots is just a warm-up. Want to prove yourself?
dialogsAccept: Alright, then. Take care of those beasts and come back.
dialogsDecline: If it’s too much, don’t push yourself. Cleaning up reckless fools is more work than it’s worth.
dialogsComplete: Great job. Now I can truly call you a warrior.
dialogsFail: Good. This shouldn’t take you long.

58208.name: A Hand of Compassion
58208.description: Meet with the Mayor of Saint City
dialogsBegin: I have a funny story and a favor to ask. Want to hear it?
I don’t know if you’re aware, but there are many races in this world. For some reason, I’m especially drawn to beastfolk, so I’ve been looking for information about them.
I found some clues, secured funding, formed an expedition, and sent them to a rumored location. But… I still haven’t heard anything back.

There should have been at least a letter by now. My investors keep nagging me to take responsibility, but the mayor of Saint City, who invested the most, hasn’t said a single word. Isn’t it obvious he knows something? Could you ask him about the expedition for me?
dialogsAccept: Thank you! You know where to find him.
dialogsDecline: Come back if you change your mind. I’ll be waiting.
dialogsComplete: Oh, a great adventurer. What brings you here?
dialogsFail: Did you ask him? I’d go myself, but… I’m too afraid to face him.

58726.name: The Truth
dialogsBegin: So… the others… I’m the only survivor… sniff… Are you going back to Saint City?

Please tell them I’m alive. I’ll join the second expedition when they arrive and return home. I don’t want to stay in this land any longer. I know it’s a lot to ask, but… could you avenge my fallen comrades before you leave for Madrigal?
dialogsAccept: I heard a particularly loud howl. Everything went quiet afterward, so I’m sure that was their leader. Can you defeat him?
dialogsDecline: Oh… I see. I guess it can’t be helped. Never mind, then.
dialogsComplete: Ah, you’re back. So, was there really a new continent?
dialogsFail: The howl came from that direction. I doubt it went far.

58774.name: This Is Nothing
dialogsBegin: So, you’ve met everyone now? The Lycans are moving faster than we expected. I thought they’d need more time to regroup, but they’re already organizing their forces.
If we let them gather any more, things will become much harder. Could you go ahead and disrupt their plans?
dialogsAccept: Thank you. I couldn’t ask for a more reliable ally.
dialogsDecline: If we hesitate, everything we’ve built could collapse. I’m counting on you.
dialogsComplete: You’ve done wonderfully.
dialogsFail: Here’s where we expect them to be.

59395.name: Trap
dialogsBegin: Something has gone terribly wrong. We’ve clearly walked into a trap. The jarl may be shady, but he wouldn’t abandon his own people… or would he? Where did the information leak?
dialogsAccept: For now, we need to deal with the enemies in front of us. Can I count on you?
dialogsDecline: Thank you. We’ll talk more after this is over.
dialogsComplete: If you take down a few, the rest will fall apart. Their patterns are predictable.
dialogsFail: Hmph… but we don’t really have another choice.

59539.name: Hunt the Mole
dialogsBegin: We had reports that he left the village in a hurry, but… to think a village elder would betray us. It’s tragic, but we don’t have enough soldiers to both defend the village and track him. Could you do it?
dialogsAccept: If possible, bring him back alive. If not… eliminate him. Smaller Kanonicus were carrying stolen supplies and a secret letter. He should still be nearby.
dialogsDecline: Right now, you’re the only one who can move freely. We’ll be waiting.
dialogsComplete: You did well. Here, I’ve compiled what you were looking for. Take your time reading it—you’ll learn plenty about our history.
dialogsFail: We must make an example of this traitor, or the village won’t be safe for long. Please, see it through.

59546.name: A Good Friend Is… 1
dialogsBegin: Adventurer, do you have a moment? It’s about my daughter. Lately she’s been sneaking out of the village, and she refuses to tell us anything at home.
dialogsAccept: Could you check on her? I’d be relieved if it’s nothing, but something about this feels wrong. Please, I’m begging you.
dialogsDecline: If you’re too busy, I understand. Where could she have gone this time…
dialogsComplete: My parents sent you?
dialogsFail: I’m not sure where exactly, but it looks like she’s been going outside the village.

59578.name: New Beginning
dialogsBegin: So, how was the New Continent? And this… what is it? Hmm… a document I’ve never seen before. This alone isn’t enough to understand it. Could you find more of these?
dialogsAccept: From the look of it, I’d say there are at least three more. We’ll need all of them to figure it out.
dialogsDecline: Sigh… I suppose there’s no other choice.
dialogsComplete: Hmm…
dialogsFail: He should still be there.

59765.name: Searching for Clues… 2
dialogsBegin: That sharp woman… How did she know to send you without me saying anything? Do you really need this?
dialogsAccept: Sigh… Fine, take it. You can find it right next to me. I tried to analyze that material at Erons Factory, but I couldn’t even figure out what it’s made of.
dialogsDecline: If you manage to discover anything, let me know. I guess I owe you one now.
dialogsComplete: This logbook…!
dialogsFail: So I can keep this? Tch… the more I look at it, the more uneasy I feel. Just take it and go.

59853.name: To Awakening
dialogsBegin: Welcome, adventurer. I can sense great power within you.
Oh ho… this is interesting. It seems your experiences are finally paying off.
That power is the foundation of awakening as a transcendent being.
Anyone can possess it, but few ever reach that realm.
I cannot guide you directly, but I know those who can.
dialogsAccept: Good. First, meet [Acrobat Master] Pyre.
dialogsDecline: This is the first step toward something much greater. Why hesitate? If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
dialogsComplete: Long time no see, adventurer.
dialogsFail: You still haven’t gone to see her? She’s probably waiting impatiently.
